850:// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
851:// plm (high-level interface) implementation
852:
853:struct plm_t {
854:	plm_demux_t *demux;
855:	double time;
856:	int has_ended;
857:	int loop;
858:	int has_decoders;
859:
860:	int video_enabled;
861:	int video_packet_type;
862:	plm_buffer_t *video_buffer;
863:	plm_video_t *video_decoder;
864:
865:	int audio_enabled;
866:	int audio_stream_index;
867:	int audio_packet_type;
868:	double audio_lead_time;
869:	plm_buffer_t *audio_buffer;
870:	plm_audio_t *audio_decoder;
871:
872:	plm_video_decode_callback video_decode_callback;
873:	void *video_decode_callback_user_data;
874:
875:	plm_audio_decode_callback audio_decode_callback;
876:	void *audio_decode_callback_user_data;
877:};
878:
879:int plm_init_decoders(plm_t *self);
880:void plm_handle_end(plm_t *self);
881:void plm_read_video_packet(plm_buffer_t *buffer, void *user);
882:void plm_read_audio_packet(plm_buffer_t *buffer, void *user);
883:void plm_read_packets(plm_t *self, int requested_type);
884:
885:#ifndef PLM_NO_STDIO
886:
887:plm_t *plm_create_with_filename(const char *filename) {
888:	plm_buffer_t *buffer = plm_buffer_create_with_filename(filename);
889:	if (!buffer) {
890:		return NULL;
891:	}
892:	return plm_create_with_buffer(buffer, TRUE);
893:}
894:
895:plm_t *plm_create_with_file(FILE *fh, int close_when_done) {
896:	plm_buffer_t *buffer = plm_buffer_create_with_file(fh, close_when_done);
897:	return plm_create_with_buffer(buffer, TRUE);
898:}
899:
900:#endif // PLM_NO_STDIO
901:
902:plm_t *plm_create_with_memory(uint8_t *bytes, size_t length, int free_when_done) {
903:	plm_buffer_t *buffer = plm_buffer_create_with_memory(bytes, length, free_when_done);
904:	return plm_create_with_buffer(buffer, TRUE);
905:}
906:
907:plm_t *plm_create_with_buffer(plm_buffer_t *buffer, int destroy_when_done) {
908:	plm_t *self = (plm_t *)PLM_MALLOC(sizeof(plm_t));
909:	memset(self, 0, sizeof(plm_t));
910:
911:	self->demux = plm_demux_create(buffer, destroy_when_done);
912:	self->video_enabled = TRUE;
913:	self->audio_enabled = TRUE;
914:	plm_init_decoders(self);
915:
916:	return self;
917:}
918:
919:int plm_init_decoders(plm_t *self) {
920:	if (self->has_decoders) {
921:		return TRUE;
922:	}
923:
924:	if (!plm_demux_has_headers(self->demux)) {
925:		return FALSE;
926:	}
927:
928:	if (plm_demux_get_num_video_streams(self->demux) > 0) {
929:		if (self->video_enabled) {
930:			self->video_packet_type = PLM_DEMUX_PACKET_VIDEO_1;
931:		}
932:		if (!self->video_decoder) {
933:			self->video_buffer = plm_buffer_create_with_capacity(PLM_BUFFER_DEFAULT_SIZE);
934:			plm_buffer_set_load_callback(self->video_buffer, plm_read_video_packet, self);
935:			self->video_decoder = plm_video_create_with_buffer(self->video_buffer, TRUE);
936:		}
937:	}
938:
939:	if (plm_demux_get_num_audio_streams(self->demux) > 0) {
940:		if (self->audio_enabled) {
941:			self->audio_packet_type = PLM_DEMUX_PACKET_AUDIO_1 + self->audio_stream_index;
942:		}
943:		if (!self->audio_decoder) {
944:			self->audio_buffer = plm_buffer_create_with_capacity(PLM_BUFFER_DEFAULT_SIZE);
945:			plm_buffer_set_load_callback(self->audio_buffer, plm_read_audio_packet, self);
946:			self->audio_decoder = plm_audio_create_with_buffer(self->audio_buffer, TRUE);
947:		}
948:	}
949:
950:	self->has_decoders = TRUE;
951:	return TRUE;
952:}
953:
954:void plm_destroy(plm_t *self) {
955:	if (self->video_decoder) {
956:		plm_video_destroy(self->video_decoder);
957:	}
958:	if (self->audio_decoder) {
959:		plm_audio_destroy(self->audio_decoder);
960:	}
961:
962:	plm_demux_destroy(self->demux);
963:	PLM_FREE(self);
964:}
965:
966:int plm_get_audio_enabled(plm_t *self) {
967:	return self->audio_enabled;
968:}
969:
970:int plm_has_headers(plm_t *self) {
971:	if (!plm_demux_has_headers(self->demux)) {
972:		return FALSE;
973:	}
974:	
975:	if (!plm_init_decoders(self)) {
976:		return FALSE;
977:	}
978:
979:	if (
980:		(self->video_decoder && !plm_video_has_header(self->video_decoder)) ||
981:		(self->audio_decoder && !plm_audio_has_header(self->audio_decoder))
982:	) {
983:		return FALSE;
984:	}
985:
986:	return TRUE;
987:}
988:
989:int plm_probe(plm_t *self, size_t probesize) {
990:	int found_streams = plm_demux_probe(self->demux, probesize);
991:	if (!found_streams) {
992:		return FALSE;
993:	}
994:
995:	// Re-init decoders
996:	self->has_decoders = FALSE;
997:	self->video_packet_type = 0;
998:	self->audio_packet_type = 0;
999:	return plm_init_decoders(self);
1000:}
1001:
1002:void plm_set_audio_enabled(plm_t *self, int enabled) {
1003:	self->audio_enabled = enabled;
1004:
1005:	if (!enabled) {
1006:		self->audio_packet_type = 0;
1007:		return;
1008:	}
1009:
1010:	self->audio_packet_type = (plm_init_decoders(self) && self->audio_decoder)
1011:		? PLM_DEMUX_PACKET_AUDIO_1 + self->audio_stream_index
1012:		: 0;
1013:}
1014:
1015:void plm_set_audio_stream(plm_t *self, int stream_index) {
1016:	if (stream_index < 0 || stream_index > 3) {
1017:		return;
1018:	}
1019:	self->audio_stream_index = stream_index;
1020:
1021:	// Set the correct audio_packet_type
1022:	plm_set_audio_enabled(self, self->audio_enabled);
1023:}
1024:
1025:int plm_get_video_enabled(plm_t *self) {
1026:	return self->video_enabled;
1027:}
1028:
1029:void plm_set_video_enabled(plm_t *self, int enabled) {
1030:	self->video_enabled = enabled;
1031:
1032:	if (!enabled) {
1033:		self->video_packet_type = 0;
1034:		return;
1035:	}
1036:
1037:	self->video_packet_type = (plm_init_decoders(self) && self->video_decoder)
1038:		? PLM_DEMUX_PACKET_VIDEO_1
1039:		: 0;
1040:}
1041:
1042:int plm_get_num_video_streams(plm_t *self) {
1043:	return plm_demux_get_num_video_streams(self->demux);
1044:}
1045:
1046:int plm_get_width(plm_t *self) {
1047:	return (plm_init_decoders(self) && self->video_decoder)
1048:		? plm_video_get_width(self->video_decoder)
1049:		: 0;
1050:}
1051:
1052:int plm_get_height(plm_t *self) {
1053:	return (plm_init_decoders(self) && self->video_decoder)
1054:		? plm_video_get_height(self->video_decoder)
1055:		: 0;
1056:}
1057:
1058:double plm_get_framerate(plm_t *self) {
1059:	return (plm_init_decoders(self) && self->video_decoder)
1060:		? plm_video_get_framerate(self->video_decoder)
1061:		: 0;
1062:}
1063:
1064:double plm_get_pixel_aspect_ratio(plm_t *self) {
1065:	return (plm_init_decoders(self) && self->video_decoder)
1066:		? plm_video_get_pixel_aspect_ratio(self->video_decoder)
1067:		: 0;
1068:}
1069:
1070:int plm_get_num_audio_streams(plm_t *self) {
1071:	return plm_demux_get_num_audio_streams(self->demux);
1072:}
1073:
1074:int plm_get_samplerate(plm_t *self) {
1075:	return (plm_init_decoders(self) && self->audio_decoder)
1076:		? plm_audio_get_samplerate(self->audio_decoder)
1077:		: 0;
1078:}
1079:
1080:double plm_get_audio_lead_time(plm_t *self) {
1081:	return self->audio_lead_time;
1082:}
1083:
1084:void plm_set_audio_lead_time(plm_t *self, double lead_time) {
1085:	self->audio_lead_time = lead_time;
1086:}
1087:
1088:double plm_get_time(plm_t *self) {
1089:	return self->time;
1090:}
1091:
1092:double plm_get_duration(plm_t *self) {
1093:	return plm_demux_get_duration(self->demux, PLM_DEMUX_PACKET_VIDEO_1);
1094:}
1095:
1096:void plm_rewind(plm_t *self) {
1097:	if (self->video_decoder) {
1098:		plm_video_rewind(self->video_decoder);
1099:	}
1100:
1101:	if (self->audio_decoder) {
1102:		plm_audio_rewind(self->audio_decoder);
1103:	}
1104:
1105:	plm_demux_rewind(self->demux);
1106:	self->time = 0;
1107:	self->has_ended = FALSE;
1108:}
1109:
1110:int plm_get_loop(plm_t *self) {
1111:	return self->loop;
1112:}
1113:
1114:void plm_set_loop(plm_t *self, int loop) {
1115:	self->loop = loop;
1116:}
1117:
1118:int plm_has_ended(plm_t *self) {
1119:	return self->has_ended;
1120:}
1121:
1122:void plm_set_video_decode_callback(plm_t *self, plm_video_decode_callback fp, void *user) {
1123:	self->video_decode_callback = fp;
1124:	self->video_decode_callback_user_data = user;
1125:}
1126:
1127:void plm_set_audio_decode_callback(plm_t *self, plm_audio_decode_callback fp, void *user) {
1128:	self->audio_decode_callback = fp;
1129:	self->audio_decode_callback_user_data = user;
1130:}
1131:
1132:void plm_decode(plm_t *self, double tick) {
1133:	if (!plm_init_decoders(self)) {
1134:		return;
1135:	}
1136:
1137:	int decode_video = (self->video_decode_callback && self->video_packet_type);
1138:	int decode_audio = (self->audio_decode_callback && self->audio_packet_type);
1139:
1140:	if (!decode_video && !decode_audio) {
1141:		// Nothing to do here
1142:		return;
1143:	}
1144:
1145:	int did_decode = FALSE;
1146:	int decode_video_failed = FALSE;
1147:	int decode_audio_failed = FALSE;
1148:
1149:	double video_target_time = self->time + tick;
1150:	double audio_target_time = self->time + tick + self->audio_lead_time;
1151:
1152:	do {
1153:		did_decode = FALSE;
1154:		
1155:		if (decode_video && plm_video_get_time(self->video_decoder) < video_target_time) {
1156:			plm_frame_t *frame = plm_video_decode(self->video_decoder);
1157:			if (frame) {
1158:				self->video_decode_callback(self, frame, self->video_decode_callback_user_data);
1159:				did_decode = TRUE;
1160:			}
1161:			else {
1162:				decode_video_failed = TRUE;
1163:			}
1164:		}
1165:
1166:		if (decode_audio && plm_audio_get_time(self->audio_decoder) < audio_target_time) {
1167:			plm_samples_t *samples = plm_audio_decode(self->audio_decoder);
1168:			if (samples) {
1169:				self->audio_decode_callback(self, samples, self->audio_decode_callback_user_data);
1170:				did_decode = TRUE;
1171:			}
1172:			else {
1173:				decode_audio_failed = TRUE;
1174:			}
1175:		}
1176:	} while (did_decode);
1177:	
1178:	// Did all sources we wanted to decode fail and the demuxer is at the end?
1179:	if (
1180:		(!decode_video || decode_video_failed) && 
1181:		(!decode_audio || decode_audio_failed) &&
1182:		plm_demux_has_ended(self->demux)
1183:	) {
1184:		plm_handle_end(self);
1185:		return;
1186:	}
1187:
1188:	self->time += tick;
1189:}
1190:
1191:plm_frame_t *plm_decode_video(plm_t *self) {
1192:	if (!plm_init_decoders(self)) {
1193:		return NULL;
1194:	}
1195:
1196:	if (!self->video_packet_type) {
1197:		return NULL;
1198:	}
1199:
1200:	plm_frame_t *frame = plm_video_decode(self->video_decoder);
1201:	if (frame) {
1202:		self->time = frame->time;
1203:	}
1204:	else if (plm_demux_has_ended(self->demux)) {
1205:		plm_handle_end(self);
1206:	}
1207:	return frame;
1208:}
1209:
1210:plm_samples_t *plm_decode_audio(plm_t *self) {
1211:	if (!plm_init_decoders(self)) {
1212:		return NULL;
1213:	}
1214:
1215:	if (!self->audio_packet_type) {
1216:		return NULL;
1217:	}
1218:
1219:	plm_samples_t *samples = plm_audio_decode(self->audio_decoder);
1220:	if (samples) {
1221:		self->time = samples->time;
1222:	}
1223:	else if (plm_demux_has_ended(self->demux)) {
1224:		plm_handle_end(self);
1225:	}
1226:	return samples;
1227:}
1228:
1229:void plm_handle_end(plm_t *self) {
1230:	if (self->loop) {
1231:		plm_rewind(self);
1232:	}
1233:	else {
1234:		self->has_ended = TRUE;
1235:	}
1236:}
1237:
1238:void plm_read_video_packet(plm_buffer_t *buffer, void *user) {
1239:	PLM_UNUSED(buffer);
1240:	plm_t *self = (plm_t *)user;
1241:	plm_read_packets(self, self->video_packet_type);
1242:}
1243:
1244:void plm_read_audio_packet(plm_buffer_t *buffer, void *user) {
1245:	PLM_UNUSED(buffer);
1246:	plm_t *self = (plm_t *)user;
1247:	plm_read_packets(self, self->audio_packet_type);
1248:}
1249:
1250:void plm_read_packets(plm_t *self, int requested_type) {
1251:	plm_packet_t *packet;
1252:	while ((packet = plm_demux_decode(self->demux))) {
1253:		if (packet->type == self->video_packet_type) {
1254:			plm_buffer_write(self->video_buffer, packet->data, packet->length);
1255:		}
1256:		else if (packet->type == self->audio_packet_type) {
1257:			plm_buffer_write(self->audio_buffer, packet->data, packet->length);
1258:		}
1259:
1260:		if (packet->type == requested_type) {
1261:			return;
1262:		}
1263:	}
1264:
1265:	if (plm_demux_has_ended(self->demux)) {
1266:		if (self->video_buffer) {
1267:			plm_buffer_signal_end(self->video_buffer);
1268:		}
1269:		if (self->audio_buffer) {
1270:			plm_buffer_signal_end(self->audio_buffer);
1271:		}
1272:	}
1273:}
1274:
1275:plm_frame_t *plm_seek_frame(plm_t *self, double time, int seek_exact) {
1276:	if (!plm_init_decoders(self)) {
1277:		return NULL;
1278:	}
1279:
1280:	if (!self->video_packet_type) {
1281:		return NULL;
1282:	}
1283:
1284:	int type = self->video_packet_type;
1285:
1286:	double start_time = plm_demux_get_start_time(self->demux, type);
1287:	double duration = plm_demux_get_duration(self->demux, type);
1288:
1289:	if (time < 0) {
1290:		time = 0;
1291:	}
1292:	else if (time > duration) {
1293:		time = duration;
1294:	}
1295:	
1296:	plm_packet_t *packet = plm_demux_seek(self->demux, time, type, TRUE);
1297:	if (!packet) {
1298:		return NULL;
1299:	}
1300:
1301:	// Disable writing to the audio buffer while decoding video
1302:	int previous_audio_packet_type = self->audio_packet_type;
1303:	self->audio_packet_type = 0;
1304:
1305:	// Clear video buffer and decode the found packet
1306:	plm_video_rewind(self->video_decoder);
1307:	plm_video_set_time(self->video_decoder, packet->pts - start_time);
1308:	plm_buffer_write(self->video_buffer, packet->data, packet->length);
1309:	plm_frame_t *frame = plm_video_decode(self->video_decoder);	
1310:
1311:	// If we want to seek to an exact frame, we have to decode all frames
1312:	// on top of the intra frame we just jumped to.
1313:	if (seek_exact) {
1314:		while (frame && frame->time < time) {
1315:			frame = plm_video_decode(self->video_decoder);
1316:		}
1317:	}
1318:
1319:	// Enable writing to the audio buffer again?
1320:	self->audio_packet_type = previous_audio_packet_type;
1321:
1322:	if (frame) {
1323:		self->time = frame->time;
1324:	}
1325:
1326:	self->has_ended = FALSE;
1327:	return frame;
1328:}
1329:
1330:int plm_seek(plm_t *self, double time, int seek_exact) {
1331:	plm_frame_t *frame = plm_seek_frame(self, time, seek_exact);
1332:	
1333:	if (!frame) {
1334:		return FALSE;
1335:	}
1336:
1337:	if (self->video_decode_callback) {
1338:		self->video_decode_callback(self, frame, self->video_decode_callback_user_data);	
1339:	}
1340:
1341:	// If audio is not enabled we are done here.
1342:	if (!self->audio_packet_type) {
1343:		return TRUE;
1344:	}
1345:
1346:	// Sync up Audio. This demuxes more packets until the first audio packet
1347:	// with a PTS greater than the current time is found. plm_decode() is then
1348:	// called to decode enough audio data to satisfy the audio_lead_time.
1349:
1350:	double start_time = plm_demux_get_start_time(self->demux, self->video_packet_type);
1351:	plm_audio_rewind(self->audio_decoder);
1352:
1353:	plm_packet_t *packet = NULL;
1354:	while ((packet = plm_demux_decode(self->demux))) {
1355:		if (packet->type == self->video_packet_type) {
1356:			plm_buffer_write(self->video_buffer, packet->data, packet->length);
1357:		}
1358:		else if (
1359:			packet->type == self->audio_packet_type &&
1360:			packet->pts - start_time > self->time
1361:		) {
1362:			plm_audio_set_time(self->audio_decoder, packet->pts - start_time);
1363:			plm_buffer_write(self->audio_buffer, packet->data, packet->length);
1364:			plm_decode(self, 0);
1365:			break;
1366:		}
1367:	}	
1368:	
1369:	return TRUE;
1370:}

1500:	self->capacity = capacity;

1516:#ifndef PLM_NO_STDIO
1517:	if (self->fh && self->close_when_done) {
1518:		fclose(self->fh);
1519:	}
1520:#endif
1521:	if (self->free_when_done) {
1522:		PLM_FREE(self->bytes);
1523:	}
1524:	PLM_FREE(self);
1525:}

1527:size_t plm_buffer_get_size(plm_buffer_t *self) {
1528:	return (self->mode == PLM_BUFFER_MODE_FILE)
1529:		? self->total_size
1530:		: self->length;
1531:}
1532:
1533:size_t plm_buffer_get_remaining(plm_buffer_t *self) {
1534:	return self->length - (self->bit_index >> 3);
1535:}
1536:
1537:size_t plm_buffer_write(plm_buffer_t *self, uint8_t *bytes, size_t length) {
1538:	if (self->mode == PLM_BUFFER_MODE_FIXED_MEM) {
1539:		return 0;
1540:	}
1541:
1542:	if (self->discard_read_bytes) {
1543:		// This should be a ring buffer, but instead it just shifts all unread 
1544:		// data to the beginning of the buffer and appends new data at the end. 
1545:		// Seems to be good enough.
1546:
1547:		plm_buffer_discard_read_bytes(self);
1548:		if (self->mode == PLM_BUFFER_MODE_RING) {
1549:			self->total_size = 0;
1550:		}
1551:	}
1552:
1553:	// Do we have to resize to fit the new data?
1554:	size_t bytes_available = self->capacity - self->length;
1555:	if (bytes_available < length) {
1556:		size_t new_size = self->capacity;
1557:		do {
1558:			new_size *= 2;
1559:		} while (new_size - self->length < length);
1560:		self->bytes = (uint8_t *)PLM_REALLOC(self->bytes, new_size);
1561:		self->capacity = new_size;
1562:	}
1563:
1564:	memcpy(self->bytes + self->length, bytes, length);
1565:	self->length += length;
1566:	self->has_ended = FALSE;
1567:	return length;
1568:}
1569:
1570:void plm_buffer_signal_end(plm_buffer_t *self) {
1571:	self->total_size = self->length;
1572:}
1573:
1574:void plm_buffer_set_load_callback(plm_buffer_t *self, plm_buffer_load_callback fp, void *user) {
1575:	self->load_callback = fp;
1576:	self->load_callback_user_data = user;
1577:}
1578:
1579:void plm_buffer_rewind(plm_buffer_t *self) {
1580:	plm_buffer_seek(self, 0);
1581:}
1582:
1583:void plm_buffer_seek(plm_buffer_t *self, size_t pos) {
1584:	self->has_ended = FALSE;
1585:
1586:	if (self->seek_callback) {
1587:		self->seek_callback(self, pos, self->load_callback_user_data);
1588:		self->bit_index = 0;
1589:		self->length = 0;
1590:	}
1591:	else if (self->mode == PLM_BUFFER_MODE_RING) {
1592:		if (pos != 0) {
1593:			// Seeking to non-0 is forbidden for dynamic-mem buffers
1594:			return; 
1595:		}
1596:		self->bit_index = 0;
1597:		self->length = 0;
1598:		self->total_size = 0;
1599:	}
1600:	else if (pos < self->length) {
1601:		self->bit_index = pos << 3;
1602:	}
1603:}
1604:
1605:size_t plm_buffer_tell(plm_buffer_t *self) {
1606:	return self->tell_callback
1607:		? self->tell_callback(self, self->load_callback_user_data) + (self->bit_index >> 3) - self->length
1608:		: self->bit_index >> 3;
1609:}
1610:
1611:void plm_buffer_discard_read_bytes(plm_buffer_t *self) {
1612:	size_t byte_pos = self->bit_index >> 3;
1613:	if (byte_pos == self->length) {
1614:		self->bit_index = 0;
1615:		self->length = 0;
1616:	}
1617:	else if (byte_pos > 0) {
1618:		memmove(self->bytes, self->bytes + byte_pos, self->length - byte_pos);
1619:		self->bit_index -= byte_pos << 3;
1620:		self->length -= byte_pos;
1621:	}
1622:}
1623:
1624:#ifndef PLM_NO_STDIO
1625:
1626:void plm_buffer_load_file_callback(plm_buffer_t *self, void *user) {
1627:	PLM_UNUSED(user);
1628:	
1629:	if (self->discard_read_bytes) {
1630:		plm_buffer_discard_read_bytes(self);
1631:	}
1632:
1633:	size_t bytes_available = self->capacity - self->length;
1634:	size_t bytes_read = fread(self->bytes + self->length, 1, bytes_available, self->fh);
1635:	self->length += bytes_read;
1636:
1637:	if (bytes_read == 0) {
1638:		self->has_ended = TRUE;
1639:	}
1640:}

1645:}

1650:}

1652:#endif // PLM_NO_STDIO

1656:}
1657:
1658:int plm_buffer_has(plm_buffer_t *self, size_t count) {
1659:	if (((self->length << 3) - self->bit_index) >= count) {
1660:		return TRUE;
1661:	}
1662:
1663:	if (self->load_callback) {
1664:		self->load_callback(self, self->load_callback_user_data);
1665:		
1666:		if (((self->length << 3) - self->bit_index) >= count) {
1667:			return TRUE;
1668:		}
1669:	}	
1670:	
1671:	if (self->total_size != 0 && self->length == self->total_size) {
1672:		self->has_ended = TRUE;
1673:	}
1674:	return FALSE;
1675:}
1676:
1677:int plm_buffer_read(plm_buffer_t *self, int count) {
1678:	if (!plm_buffer_has(self, count)) {
1679:		return 0;
1680:	}
1681:
1682:	int value = 0;
1683:	while (count) {
1684:		int current_byte = self->bytes[self->bit_index >> 3];
1685:
1686:		int remaining = 8 - (self->bit_index & 7); // Remaining bits in byte
1687:		int read = remaining < count ? remaining : count; // Bits in self run
1688:		int shift = remaining - read;
1689:		int mask = (0xff >> (8 - read));
1690:
1691:		value = (value << read) | ((current_byte & (mask << shift)) >> shift);
1692:
1693:		self->bit_index += read;
1694:		count -= read;
1695:	}
1696:
1697:	return value;
1698:}
1699:
1700:void plm_buffer_align(plm_buffer_t *self) {
1701:	self->bit_index = ((self->bit_index + 7) >> 3) << 3; // Align to next byte
1702:}
1703:
1704:void plm_buffer_skip(plm_buffer_t *self, size_t count) {
1705:	if (plm_buffer_has(self, count)) {
1706:		self->bit_index += count;
1707:	}
1708:}
1709:
1710:int plm_buffer_skip_bytes(plm_buffer_t *self, uint8_t v) {
1711:	plm_buffer_align(self);
1712:	int skipped = 0;
1713:	while (plm_buffer_has(self, 8) && self->bytes[self->bit_index >> 3] == v) {
1714:		self->bit_index += 8;
1715:		skipped++;
1716:	}
1717:	return skipped;
1718:}
1719:
1720:int plm_buffer_next_start_code(plm_buffer_t *self) {
1721:	plm_buffer_align(self);
1722:
1723:	while (plm_buffer_has(self, (5 << 3))) {
1724:		size_t byte_index = (self->bit_index) >> 3;
1725:		if (
1726:			self->bytes[byte_index] == 0x00 &&
1727:			self->bytes[byte_index + 1] == 0x00 &&
1728:			self->bytes[byte_index + 2] == 0x01
1729:		) {
1730:			self->bit_index = (byte_index + 4) << 3;
1731:			return self->bytes[byte_index + 3];
1732:		}
1733:		self->bit_index += 8;
1734:	}
1735:	return -1;
1736:}
1737:
1738:int plm_buffer_find_start_code(plm_buffer_t *self, int code) {
1739:	int current = 0;
1740:	while (TRUE) {
1741:		current = plm_buffer_next_start_code(self);
1742:		if (current == code || current == -1) {
1743:			return current;
1744:		}
1745:	}
1746:	return -1;
1747:}
1748:
1749:int plm_buffer_has_start_code(plm_buffer_t *self, int code) {
1750:	size_t previous_bit_index = self->bit_index;
1751:	int previous_discard_read_bytes = self->discard_read_bytes;
1752:	
1753:	self->discard_read_bytes = FALSE;
1754:	int current = plm_buffer_find_start_code(self, code);
1755:
1756:	self->bit_index = previous_bit_index;
1757:	self->discard_read_bytes = previous_discard_read_bytes;
1758:	return current;
1759:}
1760:
1761:int plm_buffer_peek_non_zero(plm_buffer_t *self, int bit_count) {
1762:	if (!plm_buffer_has(self, bit_count)) {
1763:		return FALSE;
1764:	}
1765:
1766:	int val = plm_buffer_read(self, bit_count);
1767:	self->bit_index -= bit_count;
1768:	return val != 0;
1769:}
1770:
1771:int16_t plm_buffer_read_vlc(plm_buffer_t *self, const plm_vlc_t *table) {
1772:	plm_vlc_t state = {0, 0};
1773:	do {
1774:		state = table[state.index + plm_buffer_read(self, 1)];
1775:	} while (state.index > 0);
1776:	return state.value;
1777:}
1778:
1779:uint16_t plm_buffer_read_vlc_uint(plm_buffer_t *self, const plm_vlc_uint_t *table) {
1780:	return (uint16_t)plm_buffer_read_vlc(self, (const plm_vlc_t *)table);
1781:}

1788:static const int PLM_START_PACK = 0xBA;
1789:static const int PLM_START_END = 0xB9;
1790:static const int PLM_START_SYSTEM = 0xBB;

1793:	plm_buffer_t *buffer;
1794:	int destroy_buffer_when_done;
1795:	double system_clock_ref;
1796:
1797:	size_t last_file_size;
1798:	double last_decoded_pts;
1799:	double start_time;
1800:	double duration;
1801:

1803:	int has_pack_header;
1804:	int has_system_header;
1805:	int has_headers;
1806:
1807:	int num_audio_streams;

1819:plm_demux_t *plm_demux_create(plm_buffer_t *buffer, int destroy_when_done) {
1820:	plm_demux_t *self = (plm_demux_t *)PLM_MALLOC(sizeof(plm_demux_t));
1821:	memset(self, 0, sizeof(plm_demux_t));
1822:
1823:	self->buffer = buffer;
1824:	self->destroy_buffer_when_done = destroy_when_done;
1825:
1826:	self->start_time = PLM_PACKET_INVALID_TS;
1827:	self->duration = PLM_PACKET_INVALID_TS;

1835:	if (self->destroy_buffer_when_done) {
1836:		plm_buffer_destroy(self->buffer);
1837:	}

1841:int plm_demux_has_headers(plm_demux_t *self) {
1842:	if (self->has_headers) {
1843:		return TRUE;
1844:	}
1845:
1846:	// Decode pack header
1847:	if (!self->has_pack_header) {
1848:		if (
1849:			self->start_code != PLM_START_PACK &&
1850:			plm_buffer_find_start_code(self->buffer, PLM_START_PACK) == -1
1851:		) {
1852:			return FALSE;
1853:		}
1854:
1855:		self->start_code = PLM_START_PACK;
1856:		if (!plm_buffer_has(self->buffer, 64)) {
1857:			return FALSE;
1858:		}
1859:		self->start_code = -1;
1860:
1861:		if (plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 4) != 0x02) {
1862:			return FALSE;
1863:		}
1864:
1865:		self->system_clock_ref = plm_demux_decode_time(self);
1866:		plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 1);
1867:		plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 22); // mux_rate * 50
1868:		plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 1);
1869:
1870:		self->has_pack_header = TRUE;
1871:	}
1872:
1873:	// Decode system header
1874:	if (!self->has_system_header) {
1875:		if (
1876:			self->start_code != PLM_START_SYSTEM &&
1877:			plm_buffer_find_start_code(self->buffer, PLM_START_SYSTEM) == -1
1878:		) {
1879:			return FALSE;
1880:		}
1881:
1882:		self->start_code = PLM_START_SYSTEM;
1883:		if (!plm_buffer_has(self->buffer, 56)) {
1884:			return FALSE;
1885:		}
1886:		self->start_code = -1;
1887:
1888:		plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 16); // header_length
1889:		plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 24); // rate bound
1890:		self->num_audio_streams = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 6);
1891:		plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 5); // misc flags
1892:		self->num_video_streams = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 5);
1893:
1894:		self->has_system_header = TRUE;
1895:	}
1896:
1897:	self->has_headers = TRUE;
1898:	return TRUE;
1899:}
1900:
1901:int plm_demux_probe(plm_demux_t *self, size_t probesize) {
1902:	int previous_pos = plm_buffer_tell(self->buffer);
1903:
1904:	int video_stream = FALSE;
1905:	int audio_streams[4] = {FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE};
1906:	do {
1907:		self->start_code = plm_buffer_next_start_code(self->buffer);
1908:		if (self->start_code == PLM_DEMUX_PACKET_VIDEO_1) {
1909:			video_stream = TRUE;
1910:		}
1911:		else if (
1912:			self->start_code >= PLM_DEMUX_PACKET_AUDIO_1 && 
1913:			self->start_code <= PLM_DEMUX_PACKET_AUDIO_4
1914:		) {
1915:			audio_streams[self->start_code - PLM_DEMUX_PACKET_AUDIO_1] = TRUE;
1916:		}
1917:	} while (
1918:		self->start_code != -1 && 
1919:		plm_buffer_tell(self->buffer) - previous_pos < probesize
1920:	);
1921:
1922:	self->num_video_streams = video_stream ? 1 : 0;
1923:	self->num_audio_streams = 0;
1924:	for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
1925:		if (audio_streams[i]) {
1926:			self->num_audio_streams++;
1927:		}
1928:	}
1929:
1930:	plm_demux_buffer_seek(self, previous_pos);
1931:	return (self->num_video_streams || self->num_audio_streams);
1932:}
1933:
1934:int plm_demux_get_num_video_streams(plm_demux_t *self) {
1935:	return plm_demux_has_headers(self)
1936:		? self->num_video_streams
1937:		: 0;
1938:}

1940:int plm_demux_get_num_audio_streams(plm_demux_t *self) {
1941:	return plm_demux_has_headers(self)
1942:		? self->num_audio_streams
1943:		: 0;
1944:}

1948:	self->current_packet.length = 0;
1949:	self->next_packet.length = 0;
1950:	self->start_code = -1;

1958:	plm_buffer_seek(self->buffer, pos);
1959:	self->current_packet.length = 0;
1960:	self->next_packet.length = 0;
1961:	self->start_code = -1;

1964:double plm_demux_get_start_time(plm_demux_t *self, int type) {
1965:	if (self->start_time != PLM_PACKET_INVALID_TS) {
1966:		return self->start_time;
1967:	}
1968:
1969:	int previous_pos = plm_buffer_tell(self->buffer);
1970:	int previous_start_code = self->start_code;
1971:	
1972:	// Find first video PTS
1973:	plm_demux_rewind(self);
1974:	do {
1975:		plm_packet_t *packet = plm_demux_decode(self);
1976:		if (!packet) {
1977:			break;
1978:		}
1979:		if (packet->type == type) {
1980:			self->start_time = packet->pts;
1981:		}
1982:	} while (self->start_time == PLM_PACKET_INVALID_TS);
1983:
1984:	plm_demux_buffer_seek(self, previous_pos);
1985:	self->start_code = previous_start_code;
1986:	return self->start_time;
1987:}
1988:
1989:double plm_demux_get_duration(plm_demux_t *self, int type) {
1990:	size_t file_size = plm_buffer_get_size(self->buffer);
1991:
1992:	if (
1993:		self->duration != PLM_PACKET_INVALID_TS &&
1994:		self->last_file_size == file_size
1995:	) {
1996:		return self->duration;
1997:	}
1998:
1999:	size_t previous_pos = plm_buffer_tell(self->buffer);
2000:	int previous_start_code = self->start_code;
2001:	
2002:	// Find last video PTS. Start searching 64kb from the end and go further 
2003:	// back if needed.
2004:	long start_range = 64 * 1024;
2005:	long max_range = 4096 * 1024;
2006:	for (long range = start_range; range <= max_range; range *= 2) {
2007:		long seek_pos = file_size - range;
2008:		if (seek_pos < 0) {
2009:			seek_pos = 0;
2010:			range = max_range; // Make sure to bail after this round
2011:		}
2012:		plm_demux_buffer_seek(self, seek_pos);
2013:		self->current_packet.length = 0;
2014:
2015:		double last_pts = PLM_PACKET_INVALID_TS;
2016:		plm_packet_t *packet = NULL;
2017:		while ((packet = plm_demux_decode(self))) {
2018:			if (packet->pts != PLM_PACKET_INVALID_TS && packet->type == type) {
2019:				last_pts = packet->pts;
2020:			}
2021:		}
2022:		if (last_pts != PLM_PACKET_INVALID_TS) {
2023:			self->duration = last_pts - plm_demux_get_start_time(self, type);
2024:			break;
2025:		}
2026:	}
2027:
2028:	plm_demux_buffer_seek(self, previous_pos);
2029:	self->start_code = previous_start_code;
2030:	self->last_file_size = file_size;
2031:	return self->duration;
2032:}
2033:
2034:plm_packet_t *plm_demux_seek(plm_demux_t *self, double seek_time, int type, int force_intra) {
2035:	if (!plm_demux_has_headers(self)) {
2036:		return NULL;
2037:	}
2038:
2039:	// Using the current time, current byte position and the average bytes per
2040:	// second for this file, try to jump to a byte position that hopefully has
2041:	// packets containing timestamps within one second before to the desired 
2042:	// seek_time.
2043:
2044:	// If we hit close to the seek_time scan through all packets to find the
2045:	// last one (just before the seek_time) containing an intra frame.
2046:	// Otherwise we should at least be closer than before. Calculate the bytes
2047:	// per second for the jumped range and jump again.
2048:
2049:	// The number of retries here is hard-limited to a generous amount. Usually
2050:	// the correct range is found after 1--5 jumps, even for files with very 
2051:	// variable bitrates. If significantly more jumps are needed, there's
2052:	// probably something wrong with the file and we just avoid getting into an
2053:	// infinite loop. 32 retries should be enough for anybody.
2054:
2055:	double duration = plm_demux_get_duration(self, type);
2056:	long file_size = plm_buffer_get_size(self->buffer);
2057:	long byterate = file_size / duration;
2058:
2059:	double cur_time = self->last_decoded_pts;
2060:	double scan_span = 1;
2061:
2062:	if (seek_time > duration) {
2063:		seek_time = duration;
2064:	}
2065:	else if (seek_time < 0) {
2066:		seek_time = 0;
2067:	}
2068:	seek_time += self->start_time;
2069:
2070:	for (int retry = 0; retry < 32; retry++) {
2071:		int found_packet_with_pts = FALSE;
2072:		int found_packet_in_range = FALSE;
2073:		long last_valid_packet_start = -1;
2074:		double first_packet_time = PLM_PACKET_INVALID_TS;
2075:
2076:		long cur_pos = plm_buffer_tell(self->buffer);
2077:
2078:		// Estimate byte offset and jump to it.
2079:		long offset = (seek_time - cur_time - scan_span) * byterate;
2080:		long seek_pos = cur_pos + offset;
2081:		if (seek_pos < 0) {
2082:			seek_pos = 0;
2083:		}
2084:		else if (seek_pos > file_size - 256) {
2085:			seek_pos = file_size - 256;
2086:		}
2087:
2088:		plm_demux_buffer_seek(self, seek_pos);
2089:
2090:		// Scan through all packets up to the seek_time to find the last packet
2091:		// containing an intra frame.
2092:		while (plm_buffer_find_start_code(self->buffer, type) != -1) {
2093:			long packet_start = plm_buffer_tell(self->buffer);
2094:			plm_packet_t *packet = plm_demux_decode_packet(self, type);
2095:
2096:			// Skip packet if it has no PTS
2097:			if (!packet || packet->pts == PLM_PACKET_INVALID_TS) {
2098:				continue;
2099:			}
2100:
2101:			// Bail scanning through packets if we hit one that is outside
2102:			// seek_time - scan_span.
2103:			// We also adjust the cur_time and byterate values here so the next 
2104:			// iteration can be a bit more precise.
2105:			if (packet->pts > seek_time || packet->pts < seek_time - scan_span) {
2106:				found_packet_with_pts = TRUE;
2107:				byterate = (seek_pos - cur_pos) / (packet->pts - cur_time);
2108:				cur_time = packet->pts;
2109:				break;
2110:			}
2111:
2112:			// If we are still here, it means this packet is in close range to
2113:			// the seek_time. If this is the first packet for this jump position
2114:			// record the PTS. If we later have to back off, when there was no
2115:			// intra frame in this range, we can lower the seek_time to not scan
2116:			// this range again.
2117:			if (!found_packet_in_range) {
2118:				found_packet_in_range = TRUE;
2119:				first_packet_time = packet->pts;
2120:			}
2121:
2122:			// Check if this is an intra frame packet. If so, record the buffer
2123:			// position of the start of this packet. We want to jump back to it 
2124:			// later, when we know it's the last intra frame before desired
2125:			// seek time.
2126:			if (force_intra) {
2127:				for (size_t i = 0; i < packet->length - 6; i++) {
2128:					// Find the START_PICTURE code
2129:					if (
2130:						packet->data[i] == 0x00 &&
2131:						packet->data[i + 1] == 0x00 &&
2132:						packet->data[i + 2] == 0x01 &&
2133:						packet->data[i + 3] == 0x00
2134:					) {
2135:						// Bits 11--13 in the picture header contain the frame 
2136:						// type, where 1=Intra
2137:						if ((packet->data[i + 5] & 0x38) == 8) {
2138:							last_valid_packet_start = packet_start;
2139:						}
2140:						break;
2141:					}
2142:				}
2143:			}
2144:
2145:			// If we don't want intra frames, just use the last PTS found.
2146:			else {
2147:				last_valid_packet_start = packet_start;
2148:			}
2149:		}
2150:
2151:		// If there was at least one intra frame in the range scanned above,
2152:		// our search is over. Jump back to the packet and decode it again.
2153:		if (last_valid_packet_start != -1) {
2154:			plm_demux_buffer_seek(self, last_valid_packet_start);
2155:			return plm_demux_decode_packet(self, type);
2156:		}
2157:
2158:		// If we hit the right range, but still found no intra frame, we have
2159:		// to increases the scan_span. This is done exponentially to also handle
2160:		// video files with very few intra frames.
2161:		else if (found_packet_in_range) {
2162:			scan_span *= 2;
2163:			seek_time = first_packet_time;
2164:		}
2165:
2166:		// If we didn't find any packet with a PTS, it probably means we reached
2167:		// the end of the file. Estimate byterate and cur_time accordingly.
2168:		else if (!found_packet_with_pts) {
2169:			byterate = (seek_pos - cur_pos) / (duration - cur_time);
2170:			cur_time = duration;
2171:		}
2172:	}
2173:
2174:	return NULL;
2175:}
2176:
2177:plm_packet_t *plm_demux_decode(plm_demux_t *self) {
2178:	if (!plm_demux_has_headers(self)) {
2179:		return NULL;
2180:	}
2181:
2182:	if (self->current_packet.length) {
2183:		size_t bits_till_next_packet = self->current_packet.length << 3;
2184:		if (!plm_buffer_has(self->buffer, bits_till_next_packet)) {
2185:			return NULL;
2186:		}
2187:		plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, bits_till_next_packet);
2188:		self->current_packet.length = 0;
2189:	}
2190:
2191:	// Pending packet waiting for data?
2192:	if (self->next_packet.length) {
2193:		return plm_demux_get_packet(self);
2194:	}
2195:
2196:	// Pending packet waiting for header?
2197:	if (self->start_code != -1) {
2198:		return plm_demux_decode_packet(self, self->start_code);
2199:	}
2200:
2201:	do {
2202:		self->start_code = plm_buffer_next_start_code(self->buffer);
2203:		if (
2204:			self->start_code == PLM_DEMUX_PACKET_VIDEO_1 || 
2205:			self->start_code == PLM_DEMUX_PACKET_PRIVATE || (
2206:				self->start_code >= PLM_DEMUX_PACKET_AUDIO_1 && 
2207:				self->start_code <= PLM_DEMUX_PACKET_AUDIO_4
2208:			)
2209:		) {
2210:			return plm_demux_decode_packet(self, self->start_code);
2211:		}
2212:	} while (self->start_code != -1);
2213:
2214:	return NULL;
2215:}
2216:
2217:double plm_demux_decode_time(plm_demux_t *self) {
2218:	int64_t clock = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 3) << 30;
2219:	plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 1);
2220:	clock |= plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 15) << 15;
2221:	plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 1);
2222:	clock |= plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 15);
2223:	plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 1);
2224:	return (double)clock / 90000.0;
2225:}
2226:
2227:plm_packet_t *plm_demux_decode_packet(plm_demux_t *self, int type) {
2228:	if (!plm_buffer_has(self->buffer, 16 << 3)) {
2229:		return NULL;
2230:	}
2231:
2232:	self->start_code = -1;
2233:
2234:	self->next_packet.type = type;
2235:	self->next_packet.length = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 16);
2236:	self->next_packet.length -= plm_buffer_skip_bytes(self->buffer, 0xff); // stuffing
2237:
2238:	// skip P-STD
2239:	if (plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 2) == 0x01) {
2240:		plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 16);
2241:		self->next_packet.length -= 2;
2242:	}
2243:
2244:	int pts_dts_marker = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 2);
2245:	if (pts_dts_marker == 0x03) {
2246:		self->next_packet.pts = plm_demux_decode_time(self);
2247:		self->last_decoded_pts = self->next_packet.pts;
2248:		plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 40); // skip dts
2249:		self->next_packet.length -= 10;
2250:	}
2251:	else if (pts_dts_marker == 0x02) {
2252:		self->next_packet.pts = plm_demux_decode_time(self);
2253:		self->last_decoded_pts = self->next_packet.pts;
2254:		self->next_packet.length -= 5;
2255:	}
2256:	else if (pts_dts_marker == 0x00) {
2257:		self->next_packet.pts = PLM_PACKET_INVALID_TS;
2258:		plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 4);
2259:		self->next_packet.length -= 1;
2260:	}
2261:	else {
2262:		return NULL; // invalid
2263:	}
2264:	
2265:	return plm_demux_get_packet(self);
2266:}
2267:
2268:plm_packet_t *plm_demux_get_packet(plm_demux_t *self) {
2269:	if (!plm_buffer_has(self->buffer, self->next_packet.length << 3)) {
2270:		return NULL;
2271:	}
2272:
2273:	self->current_packet.data = self->buffer->bytes + (self->buffer->bit_index >> 3);
2274:	self->current_packet.length = self->next_packet.length;
2275:	self->current_packet.type = self->next_packet.type;
2276:	self->current_packet.pts = self->next_packet.pts;
2277:
2278:	self->next_packet.length = 0;
2279:	return &self->current_packet;
2280:}

2757:static inline uint8_t plm_clamp(int n) {
2758:	if (n > 255) {
2759:		n = 255;
2760:	}
2761:	else if (n < 0) {
2762:		n = 0;
2763:	}
2764:	return n;

2781:plm_video_t * plm_video_create_with_buffer(plm_buffer_t *buffer, int destroy_when_done) {
2782:	plm_video_t *self = (plm_video_t *)PLM_MALLOC(sizeof(plm_video_t));
2783:	memset(self, 0, sizeof(plm_video_t));
2784:	
2785:	self->buffer = buffer;
2786:	self->destroy_buffer_when_done = destroy_when_done;
2787:
2788:	// Attempt to decode the sequence header
2789:	self->start_code = plm_buffer_find_start_code(self->buffer, PLM_START_SEQUENCE);
2790:	if (self->start_code != -1) {
2791:		plm_video_decode_sequence_header(self);
2792:	}
2793:	return self;
2794:}

2796:void plm_video_destroy(plm_video_t *self) {
2797:	if (self->destroy_buffer_when_done) {
2798:		plm_buffer_destroy(self->buffer);
2799:	}
2800:
2801:	if (self->has_sequence_header) {
2802:		PLM_FREE(self->frames_data);
2803:	}
2804:
2805:	PLM_FREE(self);
2806:}

2857:plm_frame_t *plm_video_decode(plm_video_t *self) {
2858:	if (!plm_video_has_header(self)) {
2859:		return NULL;
2860:	}
2861:	
2862:	plm_frame_t *frame = NULL;
2863:	do {
2864:		if (self->start_code != PLM_START_PICTURE) {
2865:			self->start_code = plm_buffer_find_start_code(self->buffer, PLM_START_PICTURE);
2866:			
2867:			if (self->start_code == -1) {
2868:				// If we reached the end of the file and the previously decoded
2869:				// frame was a reference frame, we still have to return it.
2870:				if (
2871:					self->has_reference_frame &&
2872:					!self->assume_no_b_frames &&
2873:					plm_buffer_has_ended(self->buffer) && (
2874:						self->picture_type == PLM_VIDEO_PICTURE_TYPE_INTRA ||
2875:						self->picture_type == PLM_VIDEO_PICTURE_TYPE_PREDICTIVE
2876:					)
2877:				) {
2878:					self->has_reference_frame = FALSE;
2879:					frame = &self->frame_backward;
2880:					break;
2881:				}
2882:
2883:				return NULL;
2884:			}
2885:		}
2886:
2887:		// Make sure we have a full picture in the buffer before attempting to
2888:		// decode it. Sadly, this can only be done by seeking for the start code
2889:		// of the next picture. Also, if we didn't find the start code for the
2890:		// next picture, but the source has ended, we assume that this last
2891:		// picture is in the buffer.
2892:		if (
2893:			plm_buffer_has_start_code(self->buffer, PLM_START_PICTURE) == -1 &&
2894:			!plm_buffer_has_ended(self->buffer)
2895:		) {
2896:			return NULL;
2897:		}
2898:		plm_buffer_discard_read_bytes(self->buffer);
2899:		
2900:		plm_video_decode_picture(self);
2901:
2902:		if (self->assume_no_b_frames) {
2903:			frame = &self->frame_backward;
2904:		}
2905:		else if (self->picture_type == PLM_VIDEO_PICTURE_TYPE_B) {
2906:			frame = &self->frame_current;
2907:		}
2908:		else if (self->has_reference_frame) {
2909:			frame = &self->frame_forward;
2910:		}
2911:		else {
2912:			self->has_reference_frame = TRUE;
2913:		}
2914:	} while (!frame);
2915:	
2916:	frame->time = self->time;
2917:	self->frames_decoded++;
2918:	self->time = (double)self->frames_decoded / self->framerate;
2919:	
2920:	return frame;
2921:}
2922:
2923:int plm_video_has_header(plm_video_t *self) {
2924:	if (self->has_sequence_header) {
2925:		return TRUE;
2926:	}
2927:
2928:	if (self->start_code != PLM_START_SEQUENCE) {
2929:		self->start_code = plm_buffer_find_start_code(self->buffer, PLM_START_SEQUENCE);
2930:	}
2931:	if (self->start_code == -1) {
2932:		return FALSE;
2933:	}
2934:	
2935:	if (!plm_video_decode_sequence_header(self)) {
2936:		return FALSE;
2937:	}
2938:
2939:	return TRUE;
2940:}
2941:
2942:int plm_video_decode_sequence_header(plm_video_t *self) {
2943:	int max_header_size = 64 + 2 * 64 * 8; // 64 bit header + 2x 64 byte matrix
2944:	if (!plm_buffer_has(self->buffer, max_header_size)) {
2945:		return FALSE;
2946:	}
2947:
2948:	self->width = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 12);
2949:	self->height = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 12);
2950:
2951:	if (self->width <= 0 || self->height <= 0) {
2952:		return FALSE;
2953:	}
2954:
2955:	// Get pixel aspect ratio
2956:	int pixel_aspect_ratio_code;
2957:	pixel_aspect_ratio_code = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 4);
2958:	pixel_aspect_ratio_code -= 1;
2959:	if (pixel_aspect_ratio_code < 0) {
2960:		pixel_aspect_ratio_code = 0;
2961:	}
2962:	int par_last = (sizeof(PLM_VIDEO_PIXEL_ASPECT_RATIO) /
2963:			sizeof(PLM_VIDEO_PIXEL_ASPECT_RATIO[0]) - 1);
2964:	if (pixel_aspect_ratio_code > par_last) {
2965:		pixel_aspect_ratio_code = par_last;
2966:	}
2967:	self->pixel_aspect_ratio =
2968:		PLM_VIDEO_PIXEL_ASPECT_RATIO[pixel_aspect_ratio_code];
2969:
2970:	// Get frame rate
2971:	self->framerate = PLM_VIDEO_PICTURE_RATE[plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 4)];
2972:
2973:	// Skip bit_rate, marker, buffer_size and constrained bit
2974:	plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 18 + 1 + 10 + 1);
2975:
2976:	// Load custom intra quant matrix?
2977:	if (plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 1)) { 
2978:		for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
2979:			int idx = PLM_VIDEO_ZIG_ZAG[i];
2980:			self->intra_quant_matrix[idx] = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 8);
2981:		}
2982:	}
2983:	else {
2984:		memcpy(self->intra_quant_matrix, PLM_VIDEO_INTRA_QUANT_MATRIX, 64);
2985:	}
2986:
2987:	// Load custom non intra quant matrix?
2988:	if (plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 1)) { 
2989:		for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
2990:			int idx = PLM_VIDEO_ZIG_ZAG[i];
2991:			self->non_intra_quant_matrix[idx] = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 8);
2992:		}
2993:	}
2994:	else {
2995:		memcpy(self->non_intra_quant_matrix, PLM_VIDEO_NON_INTRA_QUANT_MATRIX, 64);
2996:	}
2997:
2998:	self->mb_width = (self->width + 15) >> 4;
2999:	self->mb_height = (self->height + 15) >> 4;
3000:	self->mb_size = self->mb_width * self->mb_height;
3001:
3002:	self->luma_width = self->mb_width << 4;
3003:	self->luma_height = self->mb_height << 4;
3004:
3005:	self->chroma_width = self->mb_width << 3;
3006:	self->chroma_height = self->mb_height << 3;
3007:
3008:
3009:	// Allocate one big chunk of data for all 3 frames = 9 planes
3010:	size_t luma_plane_size = self->luma_width * self->luma_height;
3011:	size_t chroma_plane_size = self->chroma_width * self->chroma_height;
3012:	size_t frame_data_size = (luma_plane_size + 2 * chroma_plane_size);
3013:
3014:	self->frames_data = (uint8_t*)PLM_MALLOC(frame_data_size * 3);
3015:	plm_video_init_frame(self, &self->frame_current, self->frames_data + frame_data_size * 0);
3016:	plm_video_init_frame(self, &self->frame_forward, self->frames_data + frame_data_size * 1);
3017:	plm_video_init_frame(self, &self->frame_backward, self->frames_data + frame_data_size * 2);
3018:
3019:	self->has_sequence_header = TRUE;
3020:	return TRUE;
3021:}

3023:void plm_video_init_frame(plm_video_t *self, plm_frame_t *frame, uint8_t *base) {
3024:	size_t luma_plane_size = self->luma_width * self->luma_height;
3025:	size_t chroma_plane_size = self->chroma_width * self->chroma_height;
3026:
3027:	frame->width = self->width;
3028:	frame->height = self->height;
3029:	frame->y.width = self->luma_width;
3030:	frame->y.height = self->luma_height;
3031:	frame->y.data = base;
3032:
3033:	frame->cr.width = self->chroma_width;
3034:	frame->cr.height = self->chroma_height;
3035:	frame->cr.data = base + luma_plane_size;
3036:
3037:	frame->cb.width = self->chroma_width;
3038:	frame->cb.height = self->chroma_height;
3039:	frame->cb.data = base + luma_plane_size + chroma_plane_size;
3040:}

3042:void plm_video_decode_picture(plm_video_t *self) {
3043:	plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 10); // skip temporalReference
3044:	self->picture_type = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 3);
3045:	plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 16); // skip vbv_delay
3046:
3047:	// D frames or unknown coding type
3048:	if (self->picture_type <= 0 || self->picture_type > PLM_VIDEO_PICTURE_TYPE_B) {
3049:		return;
3050:	}
3051:
3052:	// Forward full_px, f_code
3053:	if (
3054:		self->picture_type == PLM_VIDEO_PICTURE_TYPE_PREDICTIVE ||
3055:		self->picture_type == PLM_VIDEO_PICTURE_TYPE_B
3056:	) {
3057:		self->motion_forward.full_px = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 1);
3058:		int f_code = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 3);
3059:		if (f_code == 0) {
3060:			// Ignore picture with zero f_code
3061:			return;
3062:		}
3063:		self->motion_forward.r_size = f_code - 1;
3064:	}
3065:
3066:	// Backward full_px, f_code
3067:	if (self->picture_type == PLM_VIDEO_PICTURE_TYPE_B) {
3068:		self->motion_backward.full_px = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 1);
3069:		int f_code = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 3);
3070:		if (f_code == 0) {
3071:			// Ignore picture with zero f_code
3072:			return;
3073:		}
3074:		self->motion_backward.r_size = f_code - 1;
3075:	}
3076:
3077:	plm_frame_t frame_temp = self->frame_forward;
3078:	if (
3079:		self->picture_type == PLM_VIDEO_PICTURE_TYPE_INTRA ||
3080:		self->picture_type == PLM_VIDEO_PICTURE_TYPE_PREDICTIVE
3081:	) {
3082:		self->frame_forward = self->frame_backward;
3083:	}
3084:
3085:
3086:	// Find first slice start code; skip extension and user data
3087:	do {
3088:		self->start_code = plm_buffer_next_start_code(self->buffer);
3089:	} while (
3090:		self->start_code == PLM_START_EXTENSION || 
3091:		self->start_code == PLM_START_USER_DATA
3092:	);
3093:
3094:	// Decode all slices
3095:	while (PLM_START_IS_SLICE(self->start_code)) {
3096:		plm_video_decode_slice(self, self->start_code & 0x000000FF);
3097:		if (self->macroblock_address >= self->mb_size - 1) {
3098:			break;
3099:		}
3100:		self->start_code = plm_buffer_next_start_code(self->buffer);
3101:	}
3102:
3103:	// If this is a reference picture rotate the prediction pointers
3104:	if (
3105:		self->picture_type == PLM_VIDEO_PICTURE_TYPE_INTRA ||
3106:		self->picture_type == PLM_VIDEO_PICTURE_TYPE_PREDICTIVE
3107:	) {
3108:		self->frame_backward = self->frame_current;
3109:		self->frame_current = frame_temp;
3110:	}
3111:}
3112:
3113:void plm_video_decode_slice(plm_video_t *self, int slice) {
3114:	self->slice_begin = TRUE;
3115:	self->macroblock_address = (slice - 1) * self->mb_width - 1;
3116:
3117:	// Reset motion vectors and DC predictors
3118:	self->motion_backward.h = self->motion_forward.h = 0;
3119:	self->motion_backward.v = self->motion_forward.v = 0;
3120:	self->dc_predictor[0] = 128;
3121:	self->dc_predictor[1] = 128;
3122:	self->dc_predictor[2] = 128;
3123:
3124:	self->quantizer_scale = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 5);
3125:
3126:	// Skip extra
3127:	while (plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 1)) {
3128:		plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 8);
3129:	}
3130:
3131:	do {
3132:		plm_video_decode_macroblock(self);
3133:	} while (
3134:		self->macroblock_address < self->mb_size - 1 &&
3135:		plm_buffer_peek_non_zero(self->buffer, 23)
3136:	);
3137:}
3138:
3139:void plm_video_decode_macroblock(plm_video_t *self) {
3140:	// Decode increment
3141:	int increment = 0;
3142:	int t = plm_buffer_read_vlc(self->buffer, PLM_VIDEO_MACROBLOCK_ADDRESS_INCREMENT);
3143:
3144:	while (t == 34) {
3145:		// macroblock_stuffing
3146:		t = plm_buffer_read_vlc(self->buffer, PLM_VIDEO_MACROBLOCK_ADDRESS_INCREMENT);
3147:	}
3148:	while (t == 35) {
3149:		// macroblock_escape
3150:		increment += 33;
3151:		t = plm_buffer_read_vlc(self->buffer, PLM_VIDEO_MACROBLOCK_ADDRESS_INCREMENT);
3152:	}
3153:	increment += t;
3154:
3155:	// Process any skipped macroblocks
3156:	if (self->slice_begin) {
3157:		// The first increment of each slice is relative to beginning of the
3158:		// previous row, not the previous macroblock
3159:		self->slice_begin = FALSE;
3160:		self->macroblock_address += increment;
3161:	}
3162:	else {
3163:		if (self->macroblock_address + increment >= self->mb_size) {
3164:			return; // invalid
3165:		}
3166:		if (increment > 1) {
3167:			// Skipped macroblocks reset DC predictors
3168:			self->dc_predictor[0] = 128;
3169:			self->dc_predictor[1] = 128;
3170:			self->dc_predictor[2] = 128;
3171:
3172:			// Skipped macroblocks in P-pictures reset motion vectors
3173:			if (self->picture_type == PLM_VIDEO_PICTURE_TYPE_PREDICTIVE) {
3174:				self->motion_forward.h = 0;
3175:				self->motion_forward.v = 0;
3176:			}
3177:		}
3178:
3179:		// Predict skipped macroblocks
3180:		while (increment > 1) {
3181:			self->macroblock_address++;
3182:			self->mb_row = self->macroblock_address / self->mb_width;
3183:			self->mb_col = self->macroblock_address % self->mb_width;
3184:
3185:			plm_video_predict_macroblock(self);
3186:			increment--;
3187:		}
3188:		self->macroblock_address++;
3189:	}
3190:
3191:	self->mb_row = self->macroblock_address / self->mb_width;
3192:	self->mb_col = self->macroblock_address % self->mb_width;
3193:
3194:	if (self->mb_col >= self->mb_width || self->mb_row >= self->mb_height) {
3195:		return; // corrupt stream;
3196:	}
3197:
3198:	// Process the current macroblock
3199:	const plm_vlc_t *table = PLM_VIDEO_MACROBLOCK_TYPE[self->picture_type];
3200:	self->macroblock_type = plm_buffer_read_vlc(self->buffer, table);
3201:
3202:	self->macroblock_intra = (self->macroblock_type & 0x01);
3203:	self->motion_forward.is_set = (self->macroblock_type & 0x08);
3204:	self->motion_backward.is_set = (self->macroblock_type & 0x04);
3205:
3206:	// Quantizer scale
3207:	if ((self->macroblock_type & 0x10) != 0) {
3208:		self->quantizer_scale = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 5);
3209:	}
3210:
3211:	if (self->macroblock_intra) {
3212:		// Intra-coded macroblocks reset motion vectors
3213:		self->motion_backward.h = self->motion_forward.h = 0;
3214:		self->motion_backward.v = self->motion_forward.v = 0;
3215:	}
3216:	else {
3217:		// Non-intra macroblocks reset DC predictors
3218:		self->dc_predictor[0] = 128;
3219:		self->dc_predictor[1] = 128;
3220:		self->dc_predictor[2] = 128;
3221:
3222:		plm_video_decode_motion_vectors(self);
3223:		plm_video_predict_macroblock(self);
3224:	}
3225:
3226:	// Decode blocks
3227:	int cbp = ((self->macroblock_type & 0x02) != 0)
3228:		? plm_buffer_read_vlc(self->buffer, PLM_VIDEO_CODE_BLOCK_PATTERN)
3229:		: (self->macroblock_intra ? 0x3f : 0);
3230:
3231:	for (int block = 0, mask = 0x20; block < 6; block++) {
3232:		if ((cbp & mask) != 0) {
3233:			plm_video_decode_block(self, block);
3234:		}
3235:		mask >>= 1;
3236:	}
3237:}
3238:
3239:void plm_video_decode_motion_vectors(plm_video_t *self) {
3240:
3241:	// Forward
3242:	if (self->motion_forward.is_set) {
3243:		int r_size = self->motion_forward.r_size;
3244:		self->motion_forward.h = plm_video_decode_motion_vector(self, r_size, self->motion_forward.h);
3245:		self->motion_forward.v = plm_video_decode_motion_vector(self, r_size, self->motion_forward.v);
3246:	}
3247:	else if (self->picture_type == PLM_VIDEO_PICTURE_TYPE_PREDICTIVE) {
3248:		// No motion information in P-picture, reset vectors
3249:		self->motion_forward.h = 0;
3250:		self->motion_forward.v = 0;
3251:	}
3252:
3253:	if (self->motion_backward.is_set) {
3254:		int r_size = self->motion_backward.r_size;
3255:		self->motion_backward.h = plm_video_decode_motion_vector(self, r_size, self->motion_backward.h);
3256:		self->motion_backward.v = plm_video_decode_motion_vector(self, r_size, self->motion_backward.v);
3257:	}
3258:}
3259:
3260:int plm_video_decode_motion_vector(plm_video_t *self, int r_size, int motion) {
3261:	int fscale = 1 << r_size;
3262:	int m_code = plm_buffer_read_vlc(self->buffer, PLM_VIDEO_MOTION);
3263:	int r = 0;
3264:	int d;
3265:
3266:	if ((m_code != 0) && (fscale != 1)) {
3267:		r = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, r_size);
3268:		d = ((abs(m_code) - 1) << r_size) + r + 1;
3269:		if (m_code < 0) {
3270:			d = -d;
3271:		}
3272:	}
3273:	else {
3274:		d = m_code;
3275:	}
3276:
3277:	motion += d;
3278:	if (motion > (fscale << 4) - 1) {
3279:		motion -= fscale << 5;
3280:	}
3281:	else if (motion < (int)((unsigned)(-fscale) << 4)) {
3282:		motion += fscale << 5;
3283:	}
3284:
3285:	return motion;
3286:}

3288:void plm_video_predict_macroblock(plm_video_t *self) {
3289:	int fw_h = self->motion_forward.h;
3290:	int fw_v = self->motion_forward.v;
3291:
3292:	if (self->motion_forward.full_px) {
3293:		fw_h <<= 1;
3294:		fw_v <<= 1;
3295:	}
3296:
3297:	if (self->picture_type == PLM_VIDEO_PICTURE_TYPE_B) {
3298:		int bw_h = self->motion_backward.h;
3299:		int bw_v = self->motion_backward.v;
3300:
3301:		if (self->motion_backward.full_px) {
3302:			bw_h <<= 1;
3303:			bw_v <<= 1;
3304:		}
3305:
3306:		if (self->motion_forward.is_set) {
3307:			plm_video_copy_macroblock(self, &self->frame_forward, fw_h, fw_v);
3308:			if (self->motion_backward.is_set) {
3309:				plm_video_interpolate_macroblock(self, &self->frame_backward, bw_h, bw_v);
3310:			}
3311:		}
3312:		else {
3313:			plm_video_copy_macroblock(self, &self->frame_backward, bw_h, bw_v);
3314:		}
3315:	}
3316:	else {
3317:		plm_video_copy_macroblock(self, &self->frame_forward, fw_h, fw_v);
3318:	}
3319:}

3321:void plm_video_copy_macroblock(plm_video_t *self, plm_frame_t *s, int motion_h, int motion_v) {
3322:	plm_frame_t *d = &self->frame_current;
3323:	plm_video_process_macroblock(self, s->y.data, d->y.data, motion_h, motion_v, 16, FALSE);
3324:	plm_video_process_macroblock(self, s->cr.data, d->cr.data, motion_h / 2, motion_v / 2, 8, FALSE);
3325:	plm_video_process_macroblock(self, s->cb.data, d->cb.data, motion_h / 2, motion_v / 2, 8, FALSE);
3326:}
3327:
3328:void plm_video_interpolate_macroblock(plm_video_t *self, plm_frame_t *s, int motion_h, int motion_v) {
3329:	plm_frame_t *d = &self->frame_current;
3330:	plm_video_process_macroblock(self, s->y.data, d->y.data, motion_h, motion_v, 16, TRUE);
3331:	plm_video_process_macroblock(self, s->cr.data, d->cr.data, motion_h / 2, motion_v / 2, 8, TRUE);
3332:	plm_video_process_macroblock(self, s->cb.data, d->cb.data, motion_h / 2, motion_v / 2, 8, TRUE);
3333:}
3334:
3335:#define PLM_BLOCK_SET(DEST, DEST_INDEX, DEST_WIDTH, SOURCE_INDEX, SOURCE_WIDTH, BLOCK_SIZE, OP) do { \
3336:	int dest_scan = DEST_WIDTH - BLOCK_SIZE; \
3337:	int source_scan = SOURCE_WIDTH - BLOCK_SIZE; \
3338:	for (int y = 0; y < BLOCK_SIZE; y++) { \
3339:		for (int x = 0; x < BLOCK_SIZE; x++) { \
3340:			DEST[DEST_INDEX] = OP; \
3341:			SOURCE_INDEX++; DEST_INDEX++; \
3342:		} \
3343:		SOURCE_INDEX += source_scan; \
3344:		DEST_INDEX += dest_scan; \
3345:	}} while(FALSE)
3346:
3347:void plm_video_process_macroblock(
3348:	plm_video_t *self, uint8_t *s, uint8_t *d,
3349:	int motion_h, int motion_v, int block_size, int interpolate
3350:) {
3351:	int dw = self->mb_width * block_size;
3352:
3353:	int hp = motion_h >> 1;
3354:	int vp = motion_v >> 1;
3355:	int odd_h = (motion_h & 1) == 1;
3356:	int odd_v = (motion_v & 1) == 1;
3357:
3358:	unsigned int si = ((self->mb_row * block_size) + vp) * dw + (self->mb_col * block_size) + hp;
3359:	unsigned int di = (self->mb_row * dw + self->mb_col) * block_size;
3360:	
3361:	unsigned int max_address = (dw * (self->mb_height * block_size - block_size + 1) - block_size);
3362:	if (si > max_address || di > max_address) {
3363:		return; // corrupt video
3364:	}
3365:
3366:	#define PLM_MB_CASE(INTERPOLATE, ODD_H, ODD_V, OP) \
3367:		case ((INTERPOLATE << 2) | (ODD_H << 1) | (ODD_V)): \
3368:			PLM_BLOCK_SET(d, di, dw, si, dw, block_size, OP); \
3369:			break
3370:
3371:	switch ((interpolate << 2) | (odd_h << 1) | (odd_v)) {
3372:		PLM_MB_CASE(0, 0, 0, (s[si]));
3373:		PLM_MB_CASE(0, 0, 1, (s[si] + s[si + dw] + 1) >> 1);
3374:		PLM_MB_CASE(0, 1, 0, (s[si] + s[si + 1] + 1) >> 1);
3375:		PLM_MB_CASE(0, 1, 1, (s[si] + s[si + 1] + s[si + dw] + s[si + dw + 1] + 2) >> 2);
3376:
3377:		PLM_MB_CASE(1, 0, 0, (d[di] + (s[si]) + 1) >> 1);
3378:		PLM_MB_CASE(1, 0, 1, (d[di] + ((s[si] + s[si + dw] + 1) >> 1) + 1) >> 1);
3379:		PLM_MB_CASE(1, 1, 0, (d[di] + ((s[si] + s[si + 1] + 1) >> 1) + 1) >> 1);
3380:		PLM_MB_CASE(1, 1, 1, (d[di] + ((s[si] + s[si + 1] + s[si + dw] + s[si + dw + 1] + 2) >> 2) + 1) >> 1);
3381:	}
3382:
3383:	#undef PLM_MB_CASE
3384:}
3385:
3386:void plm_video_decode_block(plm_video_t *self, int block) {
3387:
3388:	int n = 0;
3389:	uint8_t *quant_matrix;
3390:
3391:	// Decode DC coefficient of intra-coded blocks
3392:	if (self->macroblock_intra) {
3393:		int predictor;
3394:		int dct_size;
3395:
3396:		// DC prediction
3397:		int plane_index = block > 3 ? block - 3 : 0;
3398:		predictor = self->dc_predictor[plane_index];
3399:		dct_size = plm_buffer_read_vlc(self->buffer, PLM_VIDEO_DCT_SIZE[plane_index]);
3400:
3401:		// Read DC coeff
3402:		if (dct_size > 0) {
3403:			int differential = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, dct_size);
3404:			if ((differential & (1 << (dct_size - 1))) != 0) {
3405:				self->block_data[0] = predictor + differential;
3406:			}
3407:			else {
3408:				self->block_data[0] = predictor + (-(1 << dct_size) | (differential + 1));
3409:			}
3410:		}
3411:		else {
3412:			self->block_data[0] = predictor;
3413:		}
3414:
3415:		// Save predictor value
3416:		self->dc_predictor[plane_index] = self->block_data[0];
3417:
3418:		// Dequantize + premultiply
3419:		self->block_data[0] <<= (3 + 5);
3420:
3421:		quant_matrix = self->intra_quant_matrix;
3422:		n = 1;
3423:	}
3424:	else {
3425:		quant_matrix = self->non_intra_quant_matrix;
3426:	}
3427:
3428:	// Decode AC coefficients (+DC for non-intra)
3429:	int level = 0;
3430:	while (TRUE) {
3431:		int run = 0;
3432:		uint16_t coeff = plm_buffer_read_vlc_uint(self->buffer, PLM_VIDEO_DCT_COEFF);
3433:
3434:		if ((coeff == 0x0001) && (n > 0) && (plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 1) == 0)) {
3435:			// end_of_block
3436:			break;
3437:		}
3438:		if (coeff == 0xffff) {
3439:			// escape
3440:			run = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 6);
3441:			level = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 8);
3442:			if (level == 0) {
3443:				level = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 8);
3444:			}
3445:			else if (level == 128) {
3446:				level = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 8) - 256;
3447:			}
3448:			else if (level > 128) {
3449:				level = level - 256;
3450:			}
3451:		}
3452:		else {
3453:			run = coeff >> 8;
3454:			level = coeff & 0xff;
3455:			if (plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 1)) {
3456:				level = -level;
3457:			}
3458:		}
3459:
3460:		n += run;
3461:		if (n < 0 || n >= 64) {
3462:			return; // invalid
3463:		}
3464:
3465:		int de_zig_zagged = PLM_VIDEO_ZIG_ZAG[n];
3466:		n++;
3467:
3468:		// Dequantize, oddify, clip
3469:		level = (unsigned)level << 1;
3470:		if (!self->macroblock_intra) {
3471:			level += (level < 0 ? -1 : 1);
3472:		}
3473:		level = (level * self->quantizer_scale * quant_matrix[de_zig_zagged]) >> 4;
3474:		if ((level & 1) == 0) {
3475:			level -= level > 0 ? 1 : -1;
3476:		}
3477:		if (level > 2047) {
3478:			level = 2047;
3479:		}
3480:		else if (level < -2048) {
3481:			level = -2048;
3482:		}
3483:
3484:		// Save premultiplied coefficient
3485:		self->block_data[de_zig_zagged] = level * PLM_VIDEO_PREMULTIPLIER_MATRIX[de_zig_zagged];
3486:	}
3487:
3488:	// Move block to its place
3489:	uint8_t *d;
3490:	int dw;
3491:	int di;
3492:
3493:	if (block < 4) {
3494:		d = self->frame_current.y.data;
3495:		dw = self->luma_width;
3496:		di = (self->mb_row * self->luma_width + self->mb_col) << 4;
3497:		if ((block & 1) != 0) {
3498:			di += 8;
3499:		}
3500:		if ((block & 2) != 0) {
3501:			di += self->luma_width << 3;
3502:		}
3503:	}
3504:	else {
3505:		d = (block == 4) ? self->frame_current.cb.data : self->frame_current.cr.data;
3506:		dw = self->chroma_width;
3507:		di = ((self->mb_row * self->luma_width) << 2) + (self->mb_col << 3);
3508:	}
3509:
3510:	int *s = self->block_data;
3511:	int si = 0;
3512:	if (self->macroblock_intra) {
3513:		// Overwrite (no prediction)
3514:		if (n == 1) {
3515:			int clamped = plm_clamp((s[0] + 128) >> 8);
3516:			PLM_BLOCK_SET(d, di, dw, si, 8, 8, clamped);
3517:			s[0] = 0;
3518:		}
3519:		else {
3520:			plm_video_idct(s);
3521:			PLM_BLOCK_SET(d, di, dw, si, 8, 8, plm_clamp(s[si]));
3522:			memset(self->block_data, 0, sizeof(self->block_data));
3523:		}
3524:	}
3525:	else {
3526:		// Add data to the predicted macroblock
3527:		if (n == 1) {
3528:			int value = (s[0] + 128) >> 8;
3529:			PLM_BLOCK_SET(d, di, dw, si, 8, 8, plm_clamp(d[di] + value));
3530:			s[0] = 0;
3531:		}
3532:		else {
3533:			plm_video_idct(s);
3534:			PLM_BLOCK_SET(d, di, dw, si, 8, 8, plm_clamp(d[di] + s[si]));
3535:			memset(self->block_data, 0, sizeof(self->block_data));
3536:		}
3537:	}
3538:}
3539:
3540:void plm_video_idct(int *block) {
3541:	int
3542:		b1, b3, b4, b6, b7, tmp1, tmp2, m0,
3543:		x0, x1, x2, x3, x4, y3, y4, y5, y6, y7;
3544:
3545:	// Transform columns
3546:	for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
3547:		b1 = block[4 * 8 + i];
3548:		b3 = block[2 * 8 + i] + block[6 * 8 + i];
3549:		b4 = block[5 * 8 + i] - block[3 * 8 + i];
3550:		tmp1 = block[1 * 8 + i] + block[7 * 8 + i];
3551:		tmp2 = block[3 * 8 + i] + block[5 * 8 + i];
3552:		b6 = block[1 * 8 + i] - block[7 * 8 + i];
3553:		b7 = tmp1 + tmp2;
3554:		m0 = block[0 * 8 + i];
3555:		x4 = ((b6 * 473 - b4 * 196 + 128) >> 8) - b7;
3556:		x0 = x4 - (((tmp1 - tmp2) * 362 + 128) >> 8);
3557:		x1 = m0 - b1;
3558:		x2 = (((block[2 * 8 + i] - block[6 * 8 + i]) * 362 + 128) >> 8) - b3;
3559:		x3 = m0 + b1;
3560:		y3 = x1 + x2;
3561:		y4 = x3 + b3;
3562:		y5 = x1 - x2;
3563:		y6 = x3 - b3;
3564:		y7 = -x0 - ((b4 * 473 + b6 * 196 + 128) >> 8);
3565:		block[0 * 8 + i] = b7 + y4;
3566:		block[1 * 8 + i] = x4 + y3;
3567:		block[2 * 8 + i] = y5 - x0;
3568:		block[3 * 8 + i] = y6 - y7;
3569:		block[4 * 8 + i] = y6 + y7;
3570:		block[5 * 8 + i] = x0 + y5;
3571:		block[6 * 8 + i] = y3 - x4;
3572:		block[7 * 8 + i] = y4 - b7;
3573:	}
3574:
3575:	// Transform rows
3576:	for (int i = 0; i < 64; i += 8) {
3577:		b1 = block[4 + i];
3578:		b3 = block[2 + i] + block[6 + i];
3579:		b4 = block[5 + i] - block[3 + i];
3580:		tmp1 = block[1 + i] + block[7 + i];
3581:		tmp2 = block[3 + i] + block[5 + i];
3582:		b6 = block[1 + i] - block[7 + i];
3583:		b7 = tmp1 + tmp2;
3584:		m0 = block[0 + i];
3585:		x4 = ((b6 * 473 - b4 * 196 + 128) >> 8) - b7;
3586:		x0 = x4 - (((tmp1 - tmp2) * 362 + 128) >> 8);
3587:		x1 = m0 - b1;
3588:		x2 = (((block[2 + i] - block[6 + i]) * 362 + 128) >> 8) - b3;
3589:		x3 = m0 + b1;
3590:		y3 = x1 + x2;
3591:		y4 = x3 + b3;
3592:		y5 = x1 - x2;
3593:		y6 = x3 - b3;
3594:		y7 = -x0 - ((b4 * 473 + b6 * 196 + 128) >> 8);
3595:		block[0 + i] = (b7 + y4 + 128) >> 8;
3596:		block[1 + i] = (x4 + y3 + 128) >> 8;
3597:		block[2 + i] = (y5 - x0 + 128) >> 8;
3598:		block[3 + i] = (y6 - y7 + 128) >> 8;
3599:		block[4 + i] = (y6 + y7 + 128) >> 8;
3600:		block[5 + i] = (x0 + y5 + 128) >> 8;
3601:		block[6 + i] = (y3 - x4 + 128) >> 8;
3602:		block[7 + i] = (y4 - b7 + 128) >> 8;
3603:	}
3604:}
3605:
3606:// YCbCr conversion following the BT.601 standard:
3607:// https://infogalactic.com/info/YCbCr#ITU-R_BT.601_conversion
3608:
3609:#define PLM_PUT_PIXEL(RI, GI, BI, Y_OFFSET, DEST_OFFSET) \
3610:	y = ((frame->y.data[y_index + Y_OFFSET]-16) * 76309) >> 16; \
3611:	dest[d_index + DEST_OFFSET + RI] = plm_clamp(y + r); \
3612:	dest[d_index + DEST_OFFSET + GI] = plm_clamp(y - g); \
3613:	dest[d_index + DEST_OFFSET + BI] = plm_clamp(y + b);
3614:
3615:#define PLM_DEFINE_FRAME_CONVERT_FUNCTION(NAME, BYTES_PER_PIXEL, RI, GI, BI) \
3616:	void NAME(plm_frame_t *frame, uint8_t *dest, int stride) { \
3617:		int cols = frame->width >> 1; \
3618:		int rows = frame->height >> 1; \
3619:		int yw = frame->y.width; \
3620:		int cw = frame->cb.width; \
3621:		for (int row = 0; row < rows; row++) { \
3622:			int c_index = row * cw; \
3623:			int y_index = row * 2 * yw; \
3624:			int d_index = row * 2 * stride; \
3625:			for (int col = 0; col < cols; col++) { \
3626:				int y; \
3627:				int cr = frame->cr.data[c_index] - 128; \
3628:				int cb = frame->cb.data[c_index] - 128; \
3629:				int r = (cr * 104597) >> 16; \
3630:				int g = (cb * 25674 + cr * 53278) >> 16; \
3631:				int b = (cb * 132201) >> 16; \
3632:				PLM_PUT_PIXEL(RI, GI, BI, 0,      0); \
3633:				PLM_PUT_PIXEL(RI, GI, BI, 1,      BYTES_PER_PIXEL); \
3634:				PLM_PUT_PIXEL(RI, GI, BI, yw,     stride); \
3635:				PLM_PUT_PIXEL(RI, GI, BI, yw + 1, stride + BYTES_PER_PIXEL); \
3636:				c_index += 1; \
3637:				y_index += 2; \
3638:				d_index += 2 * BYTES_PER_PIXEL; \
3639:			} \
3640:		} \
3641:	}
3642:
3643:PLM_DEFINE_FRAME_CONVERT_FUNCTION(plm_frame_to_rgb,  3, 0, 1, 2)
3644:PLM_DEFINE_FRAME_CONVERT_FUNCTION(plm_frame_to_bgr,  3, 2, 1, 0)
3645:PLM_DEFINE_FRAME_CONVERT_FUNCTION(plm_frame_to_rgba, 4, 0, 1, 2)
3646:PLM_DEFINE_FRAME_CONVERT_FUNCTION(plm_frame_to_bgra, 4, 2, 1, 0)
3647:PLM_DEFINE_FRAME_CONVERT_FUNCTION(plm_frame_to_argb, 4, 1, 2, 3)
3648:PLM_DEFINE_FRAME_CONVERT_FUNCTION(plm_frame_to_abgr, 4, 3, 2, 1)
3649:
3650:
3651:#undef PLM_PUT_PIXEL
3652:#undef PLM_DEFINE_FRAME_CONVERT_FUNCTION

3788:// Quantizer lookup, step 2: bitrate class, sample rate -> B2 table idx, sblimit
3789:#define PLM_AUDIO_QUANT_TAB_A (27 | 64)   // Table 3-B.2a: high-rate, sblimit = 27

3956:plm_samples_t *plm_audio_decode(plm_audio_t *self) {
3957:	// Do we have at least enough information to decode the frame header?
3958:	if (!self->next_frame_data_size) {
3959:		if (!plm_buffer_has(self->buffer, 48)) {
3960:			return NULL;
3961:		}
3962:		self->next_frame_data_size = plm_audio_decode_header(self);
3963:	}
3964:
3965:	if (
3966:		self->next_frame_data_size == 0 ||
3967:		!plm_buffer_has(self->buffer, self->next_frame_data_size << 3)
3968:	) {
3969:		return NULL;
3970:	}
3971:
3972:	plm_audio_decode_frame(self);
3973:	self->next_frame_data_size = 0;
3974:	
3975:	self->samples.time = self->time;
3976:
3977:	self->samples_decoded += PLM_AUDIO_SAMPLES_PER_FRAME;
3978:	self->time = (double)self->samples_decoded / 
3979:		(double)PLM_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE[self->samplerate_index];
3980:	
3981:	return &self->samples;
3982:}

3984:int plm_audio_find_frame_sync(plm_audio_t *self) {
3985:	size_t i;
3986:	for (i = self->buffer->bit_index >> 3; i < self->buffer->length-1; i++) {
3987:		if (
3988:			self->buffer->bytes[i] == 0xFF &&
3989:			(self->buffer->bytes[i+1] & 0xFE) == 0xFC
3990:		) {
3991:			self->buffer->bit_index = ((i+1) << 3) + 3;
3992:			return TRUE;
3993:		}
3994:	}
3995:	self->buffer->bit_index = (i + 1) << 3;
3996:	return FALSE;
3997:}
3998:
3999:int plm_audio_decode_header(plm_audio_t *self) {
4000:	if (!plm_buffer_has(self->buffer, 48)) {
4001:		return 0;
4002:	}
4003:
4004:	plm_buffer_skip_bytes(self->buffer, 0x00);
4005:	int sync = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 11);
4006:
4007:
4008:	// Attempt to resync if no syncword was found. This sucks balls. The MP2 
4009:	// stream contains a syncword just before every frame (11 bits set to 1).
4010:	// However, this syncword is not guaranteed to not occur elsewhere in the
4011:	// stream. So, if we have to resync, we also have to check if the header 
4012:	// (samplerate, bitrate) differs from the one we had before. This all
4013:	// may still lead to garbage data being decoded :/
4014:
4015:	if (sync != PLM_AUDIO_FRAME_SYNC && !plm_audio_find_frame_sync(self)) {
4016:		return 0;
4017:	}
4018:
4019:	self->version = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 2);
4020:	self->layer = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 2);
4021:	int hasCRC = !plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 1);
4022:
4023:	if (
4024:		self->version != PLM_AUDIO_MPEG_1 ||
4025:		self->layer != PLM_AUDIO_LAYER_II
4026:	) {
4027:		return 0;
4028:	}
4029:
4030:	int bitrate_index = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 4) - 1;
4031:	if (bitrate_index > 13) {
4032:		return 0;
4033:	}
4034:
4035:	int samplerate_index = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 2);
4036:	if (samplerate_index == 3) {
4037:		return 0;
4038:	}
4039:
4040:	int padding = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 1);
4041:	plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 1); // f_private
4042:	int mode = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 2);
4043:
4044:	// If we already have a header, make sure the samplerate, bitrate and mode
4045:	// are still the same, otherwise we might have missed sync.
4046:	if (
4047:		self->has_header && (
4048:			self->bitrate_index != bitrate_index ||
4049:			self->samplerate_index != samplerate_index ||
4050:			self->mode != mode
4051:		)
4052:	) {
4053:		return 0;
4054:	}
4055:
4056:	self->bitrate_index = bitrate_index;
4057:	self->samplerate_index = samplerate_index;
4058:	self->mode = mode;
4059:	self->has_header = TRUE;
4060:
4061:	// Parse the mode_extension, set up the stereo bound
4062:	if (mode == PLM_AUDIO_MODE_JOINT_STEREO) {
4063:		self->bound = (plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 2) + 1) << 2;
4064:	}
4065:	else {
4066:		plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 2);
4067:		self->bound = (mode == PLM_AUDIO_MODE_MONO) ? 0 : 32;
4068:	}
4069:
4070:	// Discard the last 4 bits of the header and the CRC value, if present
4071:	plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 4); // copyright(1), original(1), emphasis(2)
4072:	if (hasCRC) {
4073:		plm_buffer_skip(self->buffer, 16);
4074:	}
4075:
4076:	// Compute frame size, check if we have enough data to decode the whole
4077:	// frame.
4078:	int bitrate = PLM_AUDIO_BIT_RATE[self->bitrate_index];
4079:	int samplerate = PLM_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE[self->samplerate_index];
4080:	int frame_size = (144000 * bitrate / samplerate) + padding;
4081:	return frame_size - (hasCRC ? 6 : 4);
4082:}

4084:void plm_audio_decode_frame(plm_audio_t *self) {
4085:	// Prepare the quantizer table lookups
4086:	int tab3 = 0;
4087:	int sblimit = 0;
4088:	
4089:	int tab1 = (self->mode == PLM_AUDIO_MODE_MONO) ? 0 : 1;
4090:	int tab2 = PLM_AUDIO_QUANT_LUT_STEP_1[tab1][self->bitrate_index];
4091:	tab3 = QUANT_LUT_STEP_2[tab2][self->samplerate_index];
4092:	sblimit = tab3 & 63;
4093:	tab3 >>= 6;
4094:
4095:	if (self->bound > sblimit) {
4096:		self->bound = sblimit;
4097:	}
4098:
4099:	// Read the allocation information
4100:	for (int sb = 0; sb < self->bound; sb++) {
4101:		self->allocation[0][sb] = plm_audio_read_allocation(self, sb, tab3);
4102:		self->allocation[1][sb] = plm_audio_read_allocation(self, sb, tab3);
4103:	}
4104:
4105:	for (int sb = self->bound; sb < sblimit; sb++) {
4106:		self->allocation[0][sb] =
4107:			self->allocation[1][sb] =
4108:			plm_audio_read_allocation(self, sb, tab3);
4109:	}
4110:
4111:	// Read scale factor selector information
4112:	int channels = (self->mode == PLM_AUDIO_MODE_MONO) ? 1 : 2;
4113:	for (int sb = 0; sb < sblimit; sb++) {
4114:		for (int ch = 0; ch < channels; ch++) {
4115:			if (self->allocation[ch][sb]) {
4116:				self->scale_factor_info[ch][sb] = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 2);
4117:			}
4118:		}
4119:		if (self->mode == PLM_AUDIO_MODE_MONO) {
4120:			self->scale_factor_info[1][sb] = self->scale_factor_info[0][sb];
4121:		}
4122:	}
4123:
4124:	// Read scale factors
4125:	for (int sb = 0; sb < sblimit; sb++) {
4126:		for (int ch = 0; ch < channels; ch++) {
4127:			if (self->allocation[ch][sb]) {
4128:				int *sf = self->scale_factor[ch][sb];
4129:				switch (self->scale_factor_info[ch][sb]) {
4130:					case 0:
4131:						sf[0] = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 6);
4132:						sf[1] = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 6);
4133:						sf[2] = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 6);
4134:						break;
4135:					case 1:
4136:						sf[0] = 
4137:						sf[1] = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 6);
4138:						sf[2] = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 6);
4139:						break;
4140:					case 2:
4141:						sf[0] = 
4142:						sf[1] = 
4143:						sf[2] = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 6);
4144:						break;
4145:					case 3:
4146:						sf[0] = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 6);
4147:						sf[1] = 
4148:						sf[2] = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, 6);
4149:						break;
4150:				}
4151:			}
4152:		}
4153:		if (self->mode == PLM_AUDIO_MODE_MONO) {
4154:			self->scale_factor[1][sb][0] = self->scale_factor[0][sb][0];
4155:			self->scale_factor[1][sb][1] = self->scale_factor[0][sb][1];
4156:			self->scale_factor[1][sb][2] = self->scale_factor[0][sb][2];
4157:		}
4158:	}
4159:
4160:	// Coefficient input and reconstruction
4161:	int out_pos = 0;
4162:	for (int part = 0; part < 3; part++) {
4163:		for (int granule = 0; granule < 4; granule++) {
4164:
4165:			// Read the samples
4166:			for (int sb = 0; sb < self->bound; sb++) {
4167:				plm_audio_read_samples(self, 0, sb, part);
4168:				plm_audio_read_samples(self, 1, sb, part);
4169:			}
4170:			for (int sb = self->bound; sb < sblimit; sb++) {
4171:				plm_audio_read_samples(self, 0, sb, part);
4172:				self->sample[1][sb][0] = self->sample[0][sb][0];
4173:				self->sample[1][sb][1] = self->sample[0][sb][1];
4174:				self->sample[1][sb][2] = self->sample[0][sb][2];
4175:			}
4176:			for (int sb = sblimit; sb < 32; sb++) {
4177:				self->sample[0][sb][0] = 0;
4178:				self->sample[0][sb][1] = 0;
4179:				self->sample[0][sb][2] = 0;
4180:				self->sample[1][sb][0] = 0;
4181:				self->sample[1][sb][1] = 0;
4182:				self->sample[1][sb][2] = 0;
4183:			}
4184:
4185:			// Synthesis loop
4186:			for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++) {
4187:				// Shifting step
4188:				self->v_pos = (self->v_pos - 64) & 1023;
4189:
4190:				for (int ch = 0; ch < 2; ch++) {
4191:					plm_audio_idct36(self->sample[ch], p, self->V[ch], self->v_pos);
4192:
4193:					// Build U, windowing, calculate output
4194:					memset(self->U, 0, sizeof(self->U));
4195:
4196:					int d_index = 512 - (self->v_pos >> 1);
4197:					int v_index = (self->v_pos % 128) >> 1;
4198:					while (v_index < 1024) {
4199:						for (int i = 0; i < 32; ++i) {
4200:							self->U[i] += self->D[d_index++] * self->V[ch][v_index++];
4201:						}
4202:
4203:						v_index += 128 - 32;
4204:						d_index += 64 - 32;
4205:					}
4206:
4207:					d_index -= (512 - 32);
4208:					v_index = (128 - 32 + 1024) - v_index;
4209:					while (v_index < 1024) {
4210:						for (int i = 0; i < 32; ++i) {
4211:							self->U[i] += self->D[d_index++] * self->V[ch][v_index++];
4212:						}
4213:
4214:						v_index += 128 - 32;
4215:						d_index += 64 - 32;
4216:					}
4217:
4218:					// Output samples
4219:					#ifdef PLM_AUDIO_SEPARATE_CHANNELS
4220:						float *out_channel = ch == 0
4221:							? self->samples.left
4222:							: self->samples.right;
4223:						for (int j = 0; j < 32; j++) {
4224:							out_channel[out_pos + j] = self->U[j] / -1090519040.0f;
4225:						}
4226:					#else
4227:						for (int j = 0; j < 32; j++) {
4228:							self->samples.interleaved[((out_pos + j) << 1) + ch] = 
4229:								self->U[j] / -1090519040.0f;
4230:						}
4231:					#endif
4232:				} // End of synthesis channel loop
4233:				out_pos += 32;
4234:			} // End of synthesis sub-block loop
4235:
4236:		} // Decoding of the granule finished
4237:	}
4238:
4239:	plm_buffer_align(self->buffer);
4240:}
4241:
4242:const plm_quantizer_spec_t *plm_audio_read_allocation(plm_audio_t *self, int sb, int tab3) {
4243:	int tab4 = PLM_AUDIO_QUANT_LUT_STEP_3[tab3][sb];
4244:	int qtab = PLM_AUDIO_QUANT_LUT_STEP_4[tab4 & 15][plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, tab4 >> 4)];
4245:	return qtab ? (&PLM_AUDIO_QUANT_TAB[qtab - 1]) : 0;
4246:}
4247:
4248:void plm_audio_read_samples(plm_audio_t *self, int ch, int sb, int part) {
4249:	const plm_quantizer_spec_t *q = self->allocation[ch][sb];
4250:	int sf = self->scale_factor[ch][sb][part];
4251:	int *sample = self->sample[ch][sb];
4252:	int val = 0;
4253:
4254:	if (!q) {
4255:		// No bits allocated for this subband
4256:		sample[0] = sample[1] = sample[2] = 0;
4257:		return;
4258:	}
4259:
4260:	// Resolve scalefactor
4261:	if (sf == 63) {
4262:		sf = 0;
4263:	}
4264:	else {
4265:		int shift = (sf / 3) | 0;
4266:		sf = (PLM_AUDIO_SCALEFACTOR_BASE[sf % 3] + ((1 << shift) >> 1)) >> shift;
4267:	}
4268:
4269:	// Decode samples
4270:	int adj = q->levels;
4271:	if (q->group) {
4272:		// Decode grouped samples
4273:		val = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, q->bits);
4274:		sample[0] = val % adj;
4275:		val /= adj;
4276:		sample[1] = val % adj;
4277:		sample[2] = val / adj;
4278:	}
4279:	else {
4280:		// Decode direct samples
4281:		sample[0] = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, q->bits);
4282:		sample[1] = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, q->bits);
4283:		sample[2] = plm_buffer_read(self->buffer, q->bits);
4284:	}
4285:
4286:	// Postmultiply samples
4287:	int scale = 65536 / (adj + 1);
4288:	adj = ((adj + 1) >> 1) - 1;
4289:
4290:	val = (adj - sample[0]) * scale;
4291:	sample[0] = (val * (sf >> 12) + ((val * (sf & 4095) + 2048) >> 12)) >> 12;
4292:
4293:	val = (adj - sample[1]) * scale;
4294:	sample[1] = (val * (sf >> 12) + ((val * (sf & 4095) + 2048) >> 12)) >> 12;
4295:
4296:	val = (adj - sample[2]) * scale;
4297:	sample[2] = (val * (sf >> 12) + ((val * (sf & 4095) + 2048) >> 12)) >> 12;
4298:}
4299:

1:#ifndef _POLL_H
2:#define _POLL_H
3:
4:/*
5: * Minimal POSIX <poll.h> for the OS1 userspace libc.
6: *
7: * OS1 has no pollable fd set; IPC is checked with try_recv() (os1.h). poll()
8: * (lib.c) returns 0 (timeout, no fd ready), matching base-nexs's own
9: * baremetal libc behaviour, so non-blocking poll(...,0) callers fall through
10: * to their try_recv path. Implemented in the libc layer, NOT as an OS1 syscall.
11: */
12:
13:typedef unsigned long nfds_t;
14:
15:struct pollfd {
16:  int fd;
17:  short events;
18:  short revents;
19:};
20:
21:#define POLLIN  0x0001
22:#define POLLPRI 0x0002
23:#define POLLOUT 0x0004
24:#define POLLERR 0x0008
25:#define POLLHUP 0x0010
26:#define POLLNVAL 0x0020
27:
28:int poll(struct pollfd *fds, nfds_t nfds, int timeout);
29:
30:#endif /* _POLL_H */
