399:/* C4 — the native read and the stream read of a whole file must be identical
400: * byte for byte.  This is the direct statement that the POSIX personality does
401: * not change what the layer beneath it says. */
402:static void t_native_and_stream_agree(void) {
403:  const char *name = "layers/native-equals-stream";
404:  static char payload[5000];
405:  for (int i = 0; i < (int)sizeof(payload); i++)
406:    payload[i] = (char)(i * 7 + (i >> 5));
407:  CHECK(name, write_file(TMP, payload, sizeof(payload)) == 0,
408:        "fixture write failed");
409:
410:  static char via_native[sizeof(payload)];
411:  CHECK(name,
412:        OS1_fs_read(TMP, via_native, sizeof(via_native), 0) ==
413:            (int)sizeof(payload),
414:        "native read short");
415:
416:  static char via_stream[sizeof(payload)];
417:  FILE *f = fopen(TMP, "r");
418:  CHECK(name, f != NULL, "fopen failed");
419:  size_t got = fread(via_stream, 1, sizeof(via_stream), f);
420:  fclose(f);
421:  CHECK(name, got == sizeof(payload), "stream read short");
422:  CHECK(name, memcmp(via_native, via_stream, sizeof(payload)) == 0,
423:        "the two layers returned different bytes");
424:  ok(name);
425:}
426:
427:/* ---------- group D: the CAUSE of a failure, not merely the fact ---------- */
428:
429:/*
430: * D1 — `rm`, and the `rmdir` that does not exist yet, must be able to tell WHY
431: * a removal failed.  Every cause in the ext4 driver used to collapse onto a
432: * bare -1, and -1 IS -EPERM by value, so "directory not empty" and "no such
433: * file" both surfaced as "Operation not permitted" (EXT4-ERRNO-01).
434: *
435: * It mattered twice over, because OS1_report_error classifies BY errno: a
436: * driver failure filed as EPERM raised an amber policy-denial notification
437: * whatever had actually gone wrong, while a real EIO never raised the red one.
438: *
439: * This case is also the precondition for R1b being testable at all: a verb
440: * whose refusals are indistinguishable can only be asserted zero/non-zero, so
441: * moving the verb first would have produced a new ABI with the old coverage.
442: */
443:static void t_unlink_reports_the_cause(void) {
444:  const char *name = "rm/unlink-errno-distinguishes";
445:  const char *dir = "/home/.libctest.d";
446:  const char *inner = "/home/.libctest.d/f";
447:
448:  remove(inner); /* leftovers from an interrupted earlier run */
449:  remove(dir);
450:  CHECK(name, mkdir(dir, 0755) == 0, "fixture mkdir failed");
451:  CHECK(name, write_file(inner, "x", 1) == 0, "fixture write failed");
452:
453:  errno = 0;
454:  CHECK(name, remove(dir) == -1, "removing a NON-EMPTY directory succeeded");
455:  CHECK(name, errno == ENOTEMPTY,
456:        "a non-empty directory did not report ENOTEMPTY");
457:
458:  errno = 0;
459:  CHECK(name, remove("/home/.libctest.absent") == -1,
460:        "removing a missing path succeeded");
461:  CHECK(name, errno == ENOENT, "a missing path did not report ENOENT");
462:
463:  /* Emptied, the same directory goes away: the refusal was about the CONTENTS,
464:   * not about it being a directory — the distinction a caller acts on. */
465:  CHECK(name, remove(inner) == 0, "removing the inner file failed");
466:  CHECK(name, remove(dir) == 0, "removing the emptied directory failed");
467:  ok(name);
468:}
469:
470:/*
471: * D2 — mkdir must SET errno rather than leave the previous call's value.  It
472: * returned a bare -1 without touching errno, so a caller doing the POSIX thing
473: * — check -1, then read errno — read whatever happened to be there.  A stale
474: * errno is worse than none: it is indistinguishable from a fresh one.  The
475: * sentinel below is the whole point of the case.
476: */
477:static void t_mkdir_sets_errno(void) {
478:  const char *name = "mkdir/sets-errno";
479:  const char *dir = "/home/.libctest.d2";
480:
481:  remove(dir);
482:  CHECK(name, mkdir(dir, 0755) == 0, "fixture mkdir failed");
483:
484:  errno = EBADF; /* a sentinel that the correct answer is NOT */
485:  CHECK(name, mkdir(dir, 0755) == -1, "mkdir on an existing path succeeded");
486:  CHECK(name, errno == EEXIST,
487:        "mkdir left a stale errno (did not report EEXIST)");
488:
489:  CHECK(name, remove(dir) == 0, "cleanup failed");
490:  ok(name);
491:}
492:
493:int main(void) {
494:  printf("[libctest] stdio / POSIX-over-native conformance\n");
495:
496:  t_lua_shebang_getc_then_fread();
497:  t_fread_then_getc();
498:  t_fputc_fputs_fwrite_ordering();
499:  t_interleaved_read_write();
500:  t_fseek_undoes_ungetc();
501:  t_ungetc_then_fread();
502:  t_fgets_across_buffer_boundary();
503:  t_ftell_tracks_every_path();
504:  t_eof_and_rewind();
505:  t_fread_partial_element();
506:  t_doom_savegame_roundtrip();
507:  t_append_mode();
508:
509:  t_native_descriptor_roundtrip();
510:  t_native_positional_offset();
511:
512:  t_stat_agrees_with_stream();
513:  t_stat_file_vs_dir();
514:  t_opendir_rejects_a_file();
515:  t_native_and_stream_agree();
516:
517:  t_unlink_reports_the_cause();
518:  t_mkdir_sets_errno();
519:
520:  OS1_fs_unlink(TMP);
521:  printf("[libctest] done: %d/%d passed, %d failure(s)\n", g_pass,
522:         g_pass + g_fail, g_fail);
523:  return g_fail ? 1 : 0;

170:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
171:/* XORShift PRNG                                                           */
172:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
173:static unsigned int rng_s = 0x9e3779b9u;
174:static unsigned int rng_next(void) {
175:  unsigned int x = rng_s;
176:  x ^= x << 13;
177:  x ^= x >> 17;
178:  x ^= x << 5;
179:  rng_s = x;
180:  return x;
181:}
182:static int rng_range(int lo, int hi) {
183:  if (hi <= lo)
184:    return lo;
185:  return lo + (int)(rng_next() % (unsigned)(hi - lo + 1));
186:}

285:static int dist2(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
286:  int dx = x1 - x2, dy = y1 - y2;
287:  return dx * dx + dy * dy;
288:}
289:
290:static int dist_px(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
291:  int dx = x1 - x2, dy = y1 - y2;
292:  if (dx < 0)
293:    dx = -dx;
294:  if (dy < 0)
295:    dy = -dy;
296:  /* approximate distance for speed */
297:  return dx + dy;
298:}

309:static void clamp_cam(void) {
310:  int max_x = MAP_W * TILE - WIN_W;
311:  int max_y = MAP_H * TILE - (WIN_H - HUD_H - TOP_H);
312:  if (max_x < 0)
313:    max_x = 0;
314:  if (max_y < 0)
315:    max_y = 0;
316:  if (cam_x < 0)
317:    cam_x = 0;
318:  if (cam_y < 0)
319:    cam_y = 0;
320:  if (cam_x > max_x)
321:    cam_x = max_x;
322:  if (cam_y > max_y)
323:    cam_y = max_y;

326:static int spawn_unit(int type, int owner, int px, int py) {
327:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_U; i++) {
328:    if (!units[i].active) {
329:      Unit *u = &units[i];
330:      u->active = 1;
331:      u->x = px;
332:      u->y = py;

334:      u->owner = owner;

336:      u->hp_max = UHP[type];
337:      u->state = S_IDLE;
338:      u->tx = px;
339:      u->ty = py;
340:      u->tid = -1;
341:      u->carry_type = -1;
342:      u->carry_amt = 0;
343:      u->atk_cd = 0;
344:      u->gather_t = 0;
345:      u->flash = 0;
346:      pop[owner]++;
347:      return i;
348:    }
349:  }
350:  return -1;
351:}

353:static int spawn_building(int type, int owner, int tx, int ty) {
354:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_B; i++) {
355:    if (!blds[i].active) {
356:      Building *b = &blds[i];
357:      b->active = 1;
358:      b->tx = tx;
359:      b->ty = ty;
360:      b->type = type;
361:      b->owner = owner;
362:      b->hp = 1;
363:      b->hp_max = BHP[type];
364:      b->state = (type == B_TC) ? BS_DONE : BS_BUILD;
365:      b->progress = (type == B_TC) ? 100 : 0;
366:      b->train_type = -1;
367:      b->train_timer = 0;
368:      b->sw = BSIZE_W[type];
369:      b->sh = BSIZE_H[type];
370:      b->builders = 0;
371:      /* Mark tiles */
372:      for (int dy = 0; dy < b->sh; dy++)
373:        for (int dx = 0; dx < b->sw; dx++) {
374:          int mx2 = tx + dx, my2 = ty + dy;
375:          if (mx2 < MAP_W && my2 < MAP_H)
376:            map[tile_idx(mx2, my2)].bid = i;
377:        }
378:      if (b->state == BS_DONE) {
379:        pop_cap[owner] += BPOP[type];
380:      }
381:      return i;
382:    }
383:  }
384:  return -1;
385:}

387:static void remove_building(int i) {
388:  Building *b = &blds[i];
389:  if (!b->active)
390:    return;
391:  for (int dy = 0; dy < b->sh; dy++)
392:    for (int dx = 0; dx < b->sw; dx++) {
393:      int mx2 = b->tx + dx, my2 = b->ty + dy;
394:      if (mx2 < MAP_W && my2 < MAP_H)
395:        map[tile_idx(mx2, my2)].bid = -1;
396:    }
397:  if (b->state == BS_DONE) {
398:    pop_cap[b->owner] -= BPOP[b->type];
399:    if (pop_cap[b->owner] < 0)
400:      pop_cap[b->owner] = 0;
401:  }
402:  b->active = 0;
403:}

405:static void remove_unit(int i) {
406:  if (!units[i].active)
407:    return;
408:  pop[units[i].owner]--;
409:  if (pop[units[i].owner] < 0)
410:    pop[units[i].owner] = 0;
411:  units[i].active = 0;
412:}

414:static int find_nearest_tc(int owner, int px, int py) {
415:  int best = -1, best_d = 9999999;
416:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_B; i++) {
417:    Building *b = &blds[i];
418:    if (!b->active || b->owner != owner || b->type != B_TC ||
419:        b->state != BS_DONE)
420:      continue;
421:    int bx = (b->tx + b->sw / 2) * TILE;
422:    int by = (b->ty + b->sh / 2) * TILE;
423:    int d = dist_px(px, py, bx, by);
424:    if (d < best_d) {
425:      best_d = d;
426:      best = i;
427:    }
428:  }
429:  return best;
430:}
431:
432:static int unit_at(int px, int py, int owner) {
433:  int best = -1, best_d = 256; /* 16px radius */
434:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_U; i++) {
435:    if (!units[i].active)
436:      continue;
437:    if (owner >= 0 && units[i].owner != owner)
438:      continue;
439:    int d = dist_px(px, py, units[i].x, units[i].y);
440:    if (d < best_d) {
441:      best_d = d;
442:      best = i;
443:    }
444:  }
445:  return best;
446:}

448:static int building_at_tile(int tx, int ty) {
449:  if (tx < 0 || tx >= MAP_W || ty < 0 || ty >= MAP_H)
450:    return -1;
451:  return map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].bid;
452:}

454:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
455:/* Map Generation                                                           */
456:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
457:static void generate_map(void) {
458:  int x, y, i;
459:  /* Clear */
460:  for (y = 0; y < MAP_H; y++)
461:    for (x = 0; x < MAP_W; x++) {
462:      Tile *t = &map[tile_idx(x, y)];
463:      t->terrain = T_GRASS;
464:      t->res_amt = 0;
465:      t->res_type = -1;
466:      t->bid = -1;
467:    }
468:
469:  /* River: winding from top to bottom */
470:  {
471:    int rx = 35 + rng_range(-5, 5);
472:    for (y = 0; y < MAP_H; y++) {
473:      int rw = 2 + rng_range(0, 2);
474:      for (int dx = -rw; dx <= rw; dx++) {
475:        int wx = rx + dx;
476:        if (wx >= 0 && wx < MAP_W)
477:          map[tile_idx(wx, y)].terrain = T_WATER;
478:      }
479:      rx += rng_range(-1, 1);
480:      if (rx < 20)
481:        rx = 20;
482:      if (rx > 60)
483:        rx = 60;
484:    }
485:  }
486:
487:  /* Forests */
488:  for (i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
489:    int fx = rng_range(2, MAP_W - 10);
490:    int fy = rng_range(2, MAP_H - 10);
491:    int fs = rng_range(3, 7);
492:    for (int dy = 0; dy < fs; dy++)
493:      for (int dx = 0; dx < fs; dx++) {
494:        int tx = fx + dx, ty = fy + dy;
495:        if (tx >= MAP_W || ty >= MAP_H)
496:          continue;
497:        if (map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].terrain == T_WATER)
498:          continue;
499:        if (rng_range(0, 100) < 60) {
500:          map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].terrain = T_FOREST;
501:          map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].res_amt = 100;
502:          map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].res_type = 0; /* wood */
503:        }
504:      }
505:  }
506:
507:  /* Gold mines */
508:  for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
509:    int gx = rng_range(3, MAP_W - 8);
510:    int gy = rng_range(3, MAP_H - 8);
511:    int gs = rng_range(2, 4);
512:    for (int dy = 0; dy < gs; dy++)
513:      for (int dx = 0; dx < gs; dx++) {
514:        int tx = gx + dx, ty = gy + dy;
515:        if (tx >= MAP_W || ty >= MAP_H)
516:          continue;
517:        if (map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].terrain == T_WATER)
518:          continue;
519:        map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].terrain = T_GOLD;
520:        map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].res_amt = 200;
521:        map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].res_type = 2;
522:      }
523:  }
524:
525:  /* Stone mines */
526:  for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
527:    int sx = rng_range(3, MAP_W - 7);
528:    int sy = rng_range(3, MAP_H - 7);
529:    int ss = rng_range(2, 3);
530:    for (int dy = 0; dy < ss; dy++)
531:      for (int dx = 0; dx < ss; dx++) {
532:        int tx = sx + dx, ty = sy + dy;
533:        if (tx >= MAP_W || ty >= MAP_H)
534:          continue;
535:        if (map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].terrain == T_WATER)
536:          continue;
537:        map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].terrain = T_STONE;
538:        map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].res_amt = 150;
539:        map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].res_type = 3;
540:      }
541:  }
542:
543:  /* Clear starting areas and add resources */
544:  /* Player 1: bottom-left */
545:  for (int dy = -3; dy <= 6; dy++)
546:    for (int dx = -3; dx <= 6; dx++) {
547:      int tx = 5 + dx, ty = MAP_H - 8 + dy;
548:      if (tx < 0 || tx >= MAP_W || ty < 0 || ty >= MAP_H)
549:        continue;
550:      map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].terrain = T_GRASS;
551:      map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].res_amt = 0;
552:    }
553:  /* Trees near P1 */
554:  for (i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
555:    int tx = rng_range(9, 20), ty = rng_range(MAP_H - 15, MAP_H - 5);
556:    if (tx < MAP_W && ty >= 0 && ty < MAP_H &&
557:        map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].terrain == T_GRASS) {
558:      map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].terrain = T_FOREST;
559:      map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].res_amt = 100;
560:      map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].res_type = 0;
561:    }
562:  }
563:  /* Gold near P1 */
564:  {
565:    int gx = 12, gy = MAP_H - 12;
566:    for (int dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++)
567:      for (int dx = 0; dx < 3; dx++) {
568:        if (gx + dx < MAP_W && gy + dy >= 0 && gy + dy < MAP_H) {
569:          map[tile_idx(gx + dx, gy + dy)].terrain = T_GOLD;
570:          map[tile_idx(gx + dx, gy + dy)].res_amt = 300;
571:          map[tile_idx(gx + dx, gy + dy)].res_type = 2;
572:        }
573:      }
574:  }
575:  /* Berries near P1 */
576:  for (i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
577:    int tx = rng_range(2, 6), ty = rng_range(MAP_H - 14, MAP_H - 10);
578:    if (tx >= 0 && tx < MAP_W && ty >= 0 && ty < MAP_H &&
579:        map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].terrain == T_GRASS) {
580:      map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].terrain = T_BERRY;
581:      map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].res_amt = 125;
582:      map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].res_type = 1;
583:    }
584:  }
585:
586:  /* Player 2 (AI): top-right */
587:  for (int dy = -3; dy <= 6; dy++)
588:    for (int dx = -3; dx <= 6; dx++) {
589:      int tx = MAP_W - 8 + dx, ty = 2 + dy;
590:      if (tx < 0 || tx >= MAP_W || ty < 0 || ty >= MAP_H)
591:        continue;
592:      map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].terrain = T_GRASS;
593:      map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].res_amt = 0;
594:    }
595:  for (i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
596:    int tx = rng_range(MAP_W - 22, MAP_W - 9), ty = rng_range(5, 18);
597:    if (tx >= 0 && tx < MAP_W && ty < MAP_H &&
598:        map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].terrain == T_GRASS) {
599:      map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].terrain = T_FOREST;
600:      map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].res_amt = 100;
601:      map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].res_type = 0;
602:    }
603:  }
604:  {
605:    int gx = MAP_W - 15, gy = 8;
606:    for (int dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++)
607:      for (int dx = 0; dx < 3; dx++) {
608:        if (gx + dx >= 0 && gx + dx < MAP_W && gy + dy < MAP_H) {
609:          map[tile_idx(gx + dx, gy + dy)].terrain = T_GOLD;
610:          map[tile_idx(gx + dx, gy + dy)].res_amt = 300;
611:          map[tile_idx(gx + dx, gy + dy)].res_type = 2;
612:        }
613:      }
614:  }
615:  for (i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
616:    int tx = rng_range(MAP_W - 7, MAP_W - 2), ty = rng_range(8, 14);
617:    if (tx >= 0 && tx < MAP_W && ty < MAP_H &&
618:        map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].terrain == T_GRASS) {
619:      map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].terrain = T_BERRY;
620:      map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].res_amt = 125;
621:      map[tile_idx(tx, ty)].res_type = 1;
622:    }
623:  }
624:
625:  /* Stone near both bases */
626:  {
627:    int sx = 8, sy = MAP_H - 15;
628:    for (int dy = 0; dy < 2; dy++)
629:      for (int dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
630:        if (sx + dx < MAP_W && sy + dy >= 0 && sy + dy < MAP_H) {
631:          map[tile_idx(sx + dx, sy + dy)].terrain = T_STONE;
632:          map[tile_idx(sx + dx, sy + dy)].res_amt = 200;
633:          map[tile_idx(sx + dx, sy + dy)].res_type = 3;
634:        }
635:      }
636:  }
637:  {
638:    int sx = MAP_W - 10, sy = 12;
639:    for (int dy = 0; dy < 2; dy++)
640:      for (int dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
641:        if (sx + dx >= 0 && sx + dx < MAP_W && sy + dy < MAP_H) {
642:          map[tile_idx(sx + dx, sy + dy)].terrain = T_STONE;
643:          map[tile_idx(sx + dx, sy + dy)].res_amt = 200;
644:          map[tile_idx(sx + dx, sy + dy)].res_type = 3;
645:        }
646:      }
647:  }
648:}

650:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
651:/* Game Init                                                                */
652:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
653:static void init_game(void) {
654:  int i;
655:  for (i = 0; i < MAX_U; i++)
656:    units[i].active = 0;
657:  for (i = 0; i < MAX_B; i++)
658:    blds[i].active = 0;
659:  for (i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
660:    res[i].wood = 200;
661:    res[i].food = 200;
662:    res[i].gold = 100;
663:    res[i].stone = 0;
664:    pop[i] = 0;
665:    pop_cap[i] = 0;
666:  }
667:
668:  rng_s = (unsigned int)(get_time() ^ get_pid());
669:  if (rng_s == 0)
670:    rng_s = 0x12345678u;
671:
672:  generate_map();
673:
674:  /* Player 1 town center at tile (5, MAP_H-8) */
675:  spawn_building(B_TC, 0, 5, MAP_H - 8);
676:  /* 3 villagers */
677:  spawn_unit(U_VILLAGER, 0, 7 * TILE, (MAP_H - 5) * TILE);
678:  spawn_unit(U_VILLAGER, 0, 9 * TILE, (MAP_H - 5) * TILE);
679:  spawn_unit(U_VILLAGER, 0, 7 * TILE, (MAP_H - 3) * TILE);
680:
681:  /* AI town center at tile (MAP_W-8, 2) */
682:  spawn_building(B_TC, 1, MAP_W - 8, 2);
683:  /* 3 villagers */
684:  spawn_unit(U_VILLAGER, 1, (MAP_W - 6) * TILE, 5 * TILE);
685:  spawn_unit(U_VILLAGER, 1, (MAP_W - 4) * TILE, 5 * TILE);
686:  spawn_unit(U_VILLAGER, 1, (MAP_W - 6) * TILE, 7 * TILE);
687:
688:  cam_x = 0;
689:  cam_y = (MAP_H * TILE) - WIN_H + TOP_H + HUD_H;
690:  clamp_cam();
691:
692:  sel_count = 0;
693:  sel_bid = -1;
694:  dragging = 0;
695:  place_mode = PM_NONE;
696:  frame = 0;
697:  game_time = 0;
698:  ai_timer = 0;
699:  ai_attack_sent = 0;
700:  notif_timer = 0;
701:  game_state = GS_START;
702:}

704:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
705:/* Can place building check                                                 */
706:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
707:static int can_place(int type, int owner, int tx, int ty) {
708:  int sw = BSIZE_W[type], sh = BSIZE_H[type];
709:  for (int dy = 0; dy < sh; dy++)
710:    for (int dx = 0; dx < sw; dx++) {
711:      int cx = tx + dx, cy = ty + dy;
712:      if (cx < 0 || cx >= MAP_W || cy < 0 || cy >= MAP_H)
713:        return 0;
714:      Tile *t = &map[tile_idx(cx, cy)];
715:      if (t->terrain == T_WATER)
716:        return 0;
717:      if (t->bid >= 0)
718:        return 0;
719:      if (t->terrain == T_FOREST || t->terrain == T_GOLD ||
720:          t->terrain == T_STONE || t->terrain == T_BERRY)
721:        return 0;
722:    }
723:  /* Must be near an owned building */
724:  int near = 0;
725:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_B && !near; i++) {
726:    if (!blds[i].active || blds[i].owner != owner)
727:      continue;
728:    int bx1 = blds[i].tx - 5, by1 = blds[i].ty - 5;
729:    int bx2 = blds[i].tx + blds[i].sw + 4, by2 = blds[i].ty + blds[i].sh + 4;
730:    if (tx + sw > bx1 && tx < bx2 && ty + sh > by1 && ty < by2)
731:      near = 1;
732:  }
733:  return near;
734:}
735:
736:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
737:/* Unit AI                                                                  */
738:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
739:static void update_unit(int idx) {
740:  Unit *u = &units[idx];
741:  if (!u->active)
742:    return;
743:
744:  if (u->flash > 0)
745:    u->flash--;
746:  if (u->atk_cd > 0)
747:    u->atk_cd--;
748:
749:  switch (u->state) {
750:  case S_IDLE:
751:    /* Auto-attack nearby enemies */
752:    if (u->atk_cd == 0) {
753:      int best = -1, best_d = URANGE[u->type] * TILE;
754:      best_d *= best_d;
755:      for (int i = 0; i < MAX_U; i++) {
756:        if (i == idx || !units[i].active || units[i].owner == u->owner)
757:          continue;
758:        int d = dist2(u->x, u->y, units[i].x, units[i].y);
759:        if (d < best_d) {
760:          best_d = d;
761:          best = i;
762:        }
763:      }
764:      if (best < 0) {
765:        /* Also check buildings */
766:        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_B; i++) {
767:          if (!blds[i].active || blds[i].owner == u->owner)
768:            continue;
769:          int bx = (blds[i].tx + blds[i].sw / 2) * TILE;
770:          int by = (blds[i].ty + blds[i].sh / 2) * TILE;
771:          int d = dist2(u->x, u->y, bx, by);
772:          if (d < best_d) {
773:            best_d = d;
774:            best = -(i + 1);
775:          }
776:        }
777:      }
778:      if (best >= 0) {
779:        u->state = S_ATTACK;
780:        u->tid = best;
781:      } else if (best < -1) {
782:        /* attack building: move toward it */
783:        int bi = -(best + 1);
784:        int bx = (blds[bi].tx + blds[bi].sw / 2) * TILE;
785:        int by = (blds[bi].ty + blds[bi].sh / 2) * TILE;
786:        if (dist_px(u->x, u->y, bx, by) <= URANGE[u->type] * TILE) {
787:          u->state = S_ATTACK;
788:          u->tid = best; /* negative = building index */
789:        }
790:      }
791:    }
792:    break;
793:
794:  case S_MOVE: {
795:    int dx = u->tx - u->x, dy = u->ty - u->y;
796:    int d = dist_px(u->x, u->y, u->tx, u->ty);
797:    if (d < USPD[u->type] + 1) {
798:      u->x = u->tx;
799:      u->y = u->ty;
800:      u->state = S_IDLE;
801:    } else {
802:      /* Simple normalized movement */
803:      int step = USPD[u->type];
804:      if (d > 0) {
805:        u->x += (dx * step) / d;
806:        u->y += (dy * step) / d;
807:      }
808:    }
809:    /* Clamp to map */
810:    if (u->x < 8)
811:      u->x = 8;
812:    if (u->y < 8)
813:      u->y = 8;
814:    if (u->x > (MAP_W - 1) * TILE)
815:      u->x = (MAP_W - 1) * TILE;
816:    if (u->y > (MAP_H - 1) * TILE)
817:      u->y = (MAP_H - 1) * TILE;
818:    break;
819:  }
820:
821:  case S_GATHER: {
822:    if (u->tid < 0) {
823:      u->state = S_IDLE;
824:      break;
825:    }
826:    Tile *t = &map[u->tid];
827:    if (t->res_amt <= 0) {
828:      u->state = S_IDLE;
829:      u->tid = -1;
830:      break;
831:    }
832:    /* Move to resource if not adjacent */
833:    int rx = (u->tid % MAP_W) * TILE + TILE / 2;
834:    int ry = (u->tid / MAP_W) * TILE + TILE / 2;
835:    int d = dist_px(u->x, u->y, rx, ry);
836:    if (d > TILE + 4) {
837:      u->tx = rx;
838:      u->ty = ry;
839:      /* Inline movement */
840:      int dx = u->tx - u->x, dy = u->ty - u->y;
841:      int dd = dist_px(u->x, u->y, u->tx, u->ty);
842:      if (dd > 0) {
843:        int step = USPD[u->type];
844:        u->x += (dx * step) / dd;
845:        u->y += (dy * step) / dd;
846:      }
847:    } else {
848:      /* Gather */
849:      u->gather_t++;
850:      if (u->gather_t >= GATHER_TIME) {
851:        u->gather_t = 0;
852:        int take = 10;
853:        if (take > t->res_amt)
854:          take = t->res_amt;
855:        t->res_amt -= take;
856:        u->carry_type = t->res_type;
857:        u->carry_amt += take;
858:        if (t->res_amt <= 0) {
859:          t->terrain = T_GRASS;
860:          t->res_type = -1;
861:        }
862:        /* Return to TC if at carry capacity */
863:        if (u->carry_amt >= CARRY_MAX) {
864:          u->state = S_RETURN;
865:        }
866:      }
867:    }
868:    break;
869:  }
870:
871:  case S_RETURN: {
872:    int tci = find_nearest_tc(u->owner, u->x, u->y);
873:    if (tci < 0) {
874:      u->state = S_IDLE;
875:      break;
876:    }
877:    Building *tc = &blds[tci];
878:    int bx = (tc->tx + tc->sw / 2) * TILE;
879:    int by = (tc->ty + tc->sh / 2) * TILE;
880:    int d = dist_px(u->x, u->y, bx, by);
881:    if (d > TILE * 2) {
882:      u->tx = bx;
883:      u->ty = by;
884:      int dx = u->tx - u->x, dy = u->ty - u->y;
885:      int dd = dist_px(u->x, u->y, u->tx, u->ty);
886:      if (dd > 0) {
887:        int step = USPD[u->type];
888:        u->x += (dx * step) / dd;
889:        u->y += (dy * step) / dd;
890:      }
891:    } else {
892:      /* Drop off resources */
893:      Res *r = &res[u->owner];
894:      if (u->carry_type == 0)
895:        r->wood += u->carry_amt;
896:      else if (u->carry_type == 1)
897:        r->food += u->carry_amt;
898:      else if (u->carry_type == 2)
899:        r->gold += u->carry_amt;
900:      else if (u->carry_type == 3)
901:        r->stone += u->carry_amt;
902:      u->carry_amt = 0;
903:      u->carry_type = -1;
904:      /* Go back to gathering if resource still exists */
905:      if (u->tid >= 0 && map[u->tid].res_amt > 0) {
906:        u->state = S_GATHER;
907:      } else {
908:        u->state = S_IDLE;
909:        u->tid = -1;
910:      }
911:    }
912:    break;
913:  }
914:
915:  case S_BUILD: {
916:    if (u->tid < 0) {
917:      u->state = S_IDLE;
918:      break;
919:    }
920:    Building *b = &blds[u->tid];
921:    if (!b->active || b->state != BS_BUILD) {
922:      u->state = S_IDLE;
923:      break;
924:    }
925:    /* Move to building */
926:    int bx = (b->tx + b->sw / 2) * TILE;
927:    int by = (b->ty + b->sh / 2) * TILE;
928:    int d = dist_px(u->x, u->y, bx, by);
929:    if (d > TILE * 3) {
930:      u->tx = bx;
931:      u->ty = by;
932:      int dx = u->tx - u->x, dy = u->ty - u->y;
933:      int dd = dist_px(u->x, u->y, u->tx, u->ty);
934:      if (dd > 0) {
935:        int step = USPD[u->type];
936:        u->x += (dx * step) / dd;
937:        u->y += (dy * step) / dd;
938:      }
939:    } else {
940:      /* Build */
941:      b->progress += 1;
942:      if (b->progress >= 100) {
943:        b->state = BS_DONE;
944:        b->hp = b->hp_max;
945:        pop_cap[b->owner] += BPOP[b->type];
946:        if (b->owner == 0) {
947:          char msg[64];
948:          snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "%s completato!", BNAME[b->type]);
949:          show_notif(msg);
950:        }
951:      }
952:    }
953:    break;
954:  }
955:
956:  case S_ATTACK: {
957:    if (u->atk_cd > 0)
958:      break;
959:    if (u->tid >= 0) {
960:      /* Attack unit */
961:      if (u->tid < MAX_U && !units[u->tid].active) {
962:        u->state = S_IDLE;
963:        break;
964:      }
965:      Unit *target = &units[u->tid];
966:      int d = dist_px(u->x, u->y, target->x, target->y);
967:      if (u->type == U_ARCHER) {
968:        /* Archer: stop and shoot */
969:        if (d <= URANGE[U_ARCHER] * TILE) {
970:          target->hp -= UATK[u->type];
971:          target->flash = 6;
972:          u->atk_cd = UATKCD[u->type];
973:          if (target->hp <= 0)
974:            remove_unit(u->tid);
975:          u->state = S_IDLE;
976:        } else {
977:          u->tx = target->x;
978:          u->ty = target->y;
979:          int dx = u->tx - u->x, dy = u->ty - u->y;
980:          int dd = dist_px(u->x, u->y, u->tx, u->ty);
981:          if (dd > 0) {
982:            int step = USPD[u->type];
983:            u->x += (dx * step) / dd;
984:            u->y += (dy * step) / dd;
985:          }
986:        }
987:      } else {
988:        /* Melee */
989:        if (d <= TILE + 4) {
990:          target->hp -= UATK[u->type];
991:          target->flash = 6;
992:          u->atk_cd = UATKCD[u->type];
993:          if (target->hp <= 0)
994:            remove_unit(u->tid);
995:          u->state = S_IDLE;
996:        } else {
997:          u->tx = target->x;
998:          u->ty = target->y;
999:          int dx = u->tx - u->x, dy = u->ty - u->y;
1000:          int dd = dist_px(u->x, u->y, u->tx, u->ty);
1001:          if (dd > 0) {
1002:            int step = USPD[u->type];
1003:            u->x += (dx * step) / dd;
1004:            u->y += (dy * step) / dd;
1005:          }
1006:        }
1007:      }
1008:    } else if (u->tid < 0 && u->tid != -1) {
1009:      /* Attack building (tid is -(bi+1)) */
1010:      int bi = -(u->tid + 1);
1011:      if (bi < 0 || bi >= MAX_B || !blds[bi].active) {
1012:        u->state = S_IDLE;
1013:        break;
1014:      }
1015:      Building *bld = &blds[bi];
1016:      int bx = (bld->tx + bld->sw / 2) * TILE;
1017:      int by = (bld->ty + bld->sh / 2) * TILE;
1018:      int d = dist_px(u->x, u->y, bx, by);
1019:      int range = URANGE[u->type] * TILE;
1020:      if (u->type == U_ARCHER)
1021:        range += TILE;
1022:      if (d <= range) {
1023:        bld->hp -= UATK[u->type];
1024:        u->atk_cd = UATKCD[u->type];
1025:        if (bld->hp <= 0) {
1026:          if (bld->type == B_TC) {
1027:            /* Check win/lose */
1028:            int other_tc = 0;
1029:            for (int j = 0; j < MAX_B; j++)
1030:              if (blds[j].active && blds[j].type == B_TC &&
1031:                  blds[j].owner != bld->owner)
1032:                other_tc = 1;
1033:            if (!other_tc) {
1034:              game_state = (bld->owner == 1) ? GS_WIN : GS_LOSE;
1035:              if (game_state == GS_WIN) {
1036:                wins++;
1037:                show_notif("Vittoria!");
1038:              } else {
1039:                losses++;
1040:                show_notif("Sconfitta!");
1041:              }
1042:            }
1043:          }
1044:          remove_building(bi);
1045:          if (u->owner == 0) {
1046:            char msg[64];
1047:            snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "Edificio nemico distrutto!");
1048:            show_notif(msg);
1049:          }
1050:        }
1051:        u->state = S_IDLE;
1052:      } else {
1053:        u->tx = bx;
1054:        u->ty = by;
1055:        int dx = u->tx - u->x, dy = u->ty - u->y;
1056:        int dd = dist_px(u->x, u->y, u->tx, u->ty);
1057:        if (dd > 0) {
1058:          int step = USPD[u->type];
1059:          u->x += (dx * step) / dd;
1060:          u->y += (dy * step) / dd;
1061:        }
1062:      }
1063:    }
1064:    break;
1065:  }
1066:  }
1067:}

1069:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
1070:/* Building AI (training)                                                   */
1071:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
1072:static void update_buildings(void) {
1073:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_B; i++) {
1074:    Building *b = &blds[i];
1075:    if (!b->active || b->state != BS_DONE)
1076:      continue;
1077:    if (b->train_type < 0)
1078:      continue;
1079:
1080:    b->train_timer--;
1081:    if (b->train_timer <= 0) {
1082:      /* Spawn unit near building */
1083:      int sx = (b->tx + b->sw) * TILE + 8;
1084:      int sy = (b->ty + b->sh / 2) * TILE;
1085:      if (pop[b->owner] < pop_cap[b->owner]) {
1086:        int ui = spawn_unit(b->train_type, b->owner, sx, sy);
1087:        if (ui >= 0 && b->owner == 0) {
1088:          char msg[64];
1089:          snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "%s addestrato!", UNAME[b->train_type]);
1090:          show_notif(msg);
1091:        }
1092:      }
1093:      b->train_type = -1;
1094:      b->train_timer = 0;
1095:    }
1096:  }
1097:}
1098:
1099:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
1100:/* AI Opponent                                                              */
1101:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
1102:static void ai_update(void) {
1103:  int owner = 1;
1104:  Res *r = &res[owner];
1105:  ai_timer++;
1106:
1107:  if (ai_timer % 60 == 0) {
1108:    /* Count units by type */
1109:    int villagers = 0, military = 0;
1110:    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_U; i++) {
1111:      if (!units[i].active || units[i].owner != owner)
1112:        continue;
1113:      if (units[i].type == U_VILLAGER)
1114:        villagers++;
1115:      else
1116:        military++;
1117:    }
1118:    int house_count = 0, barracks_count = 0;
1119:    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_B; i++) {
1120:      if (!blds[i].active || blds[i].owner != owner || blds[i].state != BS_DONE)
1121:        continue;
1122:      if (blds[i].type == B_HOUSE)
1123:        house_count++;
1124:      if (blds[i].type == B_BARRACKS)
1125:        barracks_count++;
1126:    }
1127:
1128:    /* Build house if near pop cap */
1129:    if (pop[owner] >= pop_cap[owner] - 2 && r->wood >= BCOST_WOOD[B_HOUSE]) {
1130:      /* Find place near TC */
1131:      int tc = -1;
1132:      for (int i = 0; i < MAX_B; i++)
1133:        if (blds[i].active && blds[i].owner == owner && blds[i].type == B_TC) {
1134:          tc = i;
1135:          break;
1136:        }
1137:      if (tc >= 0) {
1138:        Building *tcb = &blds[tc];
1139:        for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 20; attempt++) {
1140:          int tx = tcb->tx + rng_range(-4, tcb->sw + 3);
1141:          int ty = tcb->ty + rng_range(-4, tcb->sh + 3);
1142:          if (can_place(B_HOUSE, owner, tx, ty)) {
1143:            r->wood -= BCOST_WOOD[B_HOUSE];
1144:            int bi = spawn_building(B_HOUSE, owner, tx, ty);
1145:            /* Assign idle villagers to build */
1146:            for (int j = 0; j < MAX_U && blds[bi].builders < 2; j++) {
1147:              if (units[j].active && units[j].owner == owner &&
1148:                  units[j].type == U_VILLAGER && units[j].state == S_IDLE) {
1149:                units[j].state = S_BUILD;
1150:                units[j].tid = bi;
1151:                blds[bi].builders++;
1152:              }
1153:            }
1154:            break;
1155:          }
1156:        }
1157:      }
1158:    }
1159:
1160:    /* Build barracks if none */
1161:    if (barracks_count == 0 && r->wood >= BCOST_WOOD[B_BARRACKS]) {
1162:      int tc = -1;
1163:      for (int i = 0; i < MAX_B; i++)
1164:        if (blds[i].active && blds[i].owner == owner && blds[i].type == B_TC) {
1165:          tc = i;
1166:          break;
1167:        }
1168:      if (tc >= 0) {
1169:        Building *tcb = &blds[tc];
1170:        for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 20; attempt++) {
1171:          int tx = tcb->tx + rng_range(-5, tcb->sw + 4);
1172:          int ty = tcb->ty + rng_range(-5, tcb->sh + 4);
1173:          if (can_place(B_BARRACKS, owner, tx, ty)) {
1174:            r->wood -= BCOST_WOOD[B_BARRACKS];
1175:            int bi = spawn_building(B_BARRACKS, owner, tx, ty);
1176:            for (int j = 0; j < MAX_U && blds[bi].builders < 3; j++) {
1177:              if (units[j].active && units[j].owner == owner &&
1178:                  units[j].type == U_VILLAGER && units[j].state == S_IDLE) {
1179:                units[j].state = S_BUILD;
1180:                units[j].tid = bi;
1181:                blds[bi].builders++;
1182:              }
1183:            }
1184:            break;
1185:          }
1186:        }
1187:      }
1188:    }
1189:
1190:    /* Train villagers at TC */
1191:    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_B; i++) {
1192:      if (!blds[i].active || blds[i].owner != owner || blds[i].type != B_TC ||
1193:          blds[i].train_type >= 0)
1194:        continue;
1195:      if (r->food >= 50 && pop[owner] < pop_cap[owner] && villagers < 8) {
1196:        r->food -= 50;
1197:        blds[i].train_type = U_VILLAGER;
1198:        blds[i].train_timer = 150;
1199:        break;
1200:      }
1201:    }
1202:
1203:    /* Train military at barracks */
1204:    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_B; i++) {
1205:      if (!blds[i].active || blds[i].owner != owner ||
1206:          blds[i].type != B_BARRACKS || blds[i].train_type >= 0)
1207:        continue;
1208:      if (r->food >= 60 && r->gold >= 20 && pop[owner] < pop_cap[owner]) {
1209:        int utype = rng_range(1, 3);
1210:        if (utype == U_MILITIA && r->food >= 60 && r->gold >= 20) {
1211:          r->food -= 60;
1212:          r->gold -= 20;
1213:          blds[i].train_type = U_MILITIA;
1214:          blds[i].train_timer = 120;
1215:        } else if (utype == U_SPEARMAN && r->food >= 35 && r->wood >= 25) {
1216:          r->food -= 35;
1217:          r->wood -= 25;
1218:          blds[i].train_type = U_SPEARMAN;
1219:          blds[i].train_timer = 100;
1220:        } else if (r->food >= 30 && r->wood >= 40 && r->gold >= 25) {
1221:          r->food -= 30;
1222:          r->wood -= 40;
1223:          r->gold -= 25;
1224:          blds[i].train_type = U_ARCHER;
1225:          blds[i].train_timer = 140;
1226:        }
1227:        break;
1228:      }
1229:    }
1230:
1231:    /* Send idle villagers to gather */
1232:    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_U; i++) {
1233:      if (!units[i].active || units[i].owner != owner)
1234:        continue;
1235:      if (units[i].type != U_VILLAGER || units[i].state != S_IDLE)
1236:        continue;
1237:      /* Find nearest resource */
1238:      int best_t = -1, best_d = 999999;
1239:      for (int ty2 = 0; ty2 < MAP_H; ty2++)
1240:        for (int tx2 = 0; tx2 < MAP_W; tx2++) {
1241:          Tile *t = &map[tile_idx(tx2, ty2)];
1242:          if (t->res_amt <= 0)
1243:            continue;
1244:          int rx = tx2 * TILE + TILE / 2;
1245:          int ry = ty2 * TILE + TILE / 2;
1246:          int d = dist_px(units[i].x, units[i].y, rx, ry);
1247:          if (d < best_d) {
1248:            best_d = d;
1249:            best_t = tile_idx(tx2, ty2);
1250:          }
1251:        }
1252:      if (best_t >= 0) {
1253:        units[i].state = S_GATHER;
1254:        units[i].tid = best_t;
1255:        units[i].gather_t = 0;
1256:      }
1257:    }
1258:
1259:    /* Attack with military */
1260:    if (military >= 5 && !ai_attack_sent && game_time > 120) {
1261:      ai_attack_sent = 1;
1262:      /* Find player TC or nearest building */
1263:      int target_b = -1;
1264:      for (int i = 0; i < MAX_B; i++) {
1265:        if (blds[i].active && blds[i].owner == 0) {
1266:          if (blds[i].type == B_TC) {
1267:            target_b = i;
1268:            break;
1269:          }
1270:          if (target_b < 0)
1271:            target_b = i;
1272:        }
1273:      }
1274:      if (target_b >= 0) {
1275:        int bx = (blds[target_b].tx + blds[target_b].sw / 2) * TILE;
1276:        int by = (blds[target_b].ty + blds[target_b].sh / 2) * TILE;
1277:        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_U; i++) {
1278:          if (!units[i].active || units[i].owner != owner)
1279:            continue;
1280:          if (units[i].type == U_VILLAGER)
1281:            continue;
1282:          units[i].state = S_ATTACK;
1283:          units[i].tid = -(target_b + 1);
1284:        }
1285:        show_notif("Il nemico ti attacca!");
1286:      }
1287:    }
1288:
1289:    /* Reset attack flag if military drops low */
1290:    if (military < 3)
1291:      ai_attack_sent = 0;
1292:  }
1293:}

1295:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
1296:/* Rendering                                                                */
1297:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
1298:static void fill_rect(SDL_Surface *s, int x, int y, int w, int h, Uint8 r,
1299:                      Uint8 g, Uint8 b) {
1300:  if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
1301:    return;
1302:  SDL_Rect rc = {x, y, w, h};
1303:  SDL_FillRect(s, &rc, SDL_MapRGB(s->format, r, g, b));
1304:}
1305:
1306:static void draw_hp_bar(SDL_Surface *s, int x, int y, int w, int hp,
1307:                        int hp_max) {
1308:  int bar_h = 4;
1309:  if (w < 8)
1310:    w = 8;
1311:  /* Background */
1312:  fill_rect(s, x, y, w, bar_h, 40, 40, 40);
1313:  /* Fill */
1314:  int fill_w = (hp * w) / hp_max;
1315:  if (fill_w < 0)
1316:    fill_w = 0;
1317:  if (fill_w > w)
1318:    fill_w = w;
1319:  Uint8 gr, gg, gb;
1320:  int pct = (hp * 100) / hp_max;
1321:  if (pct > 60) {
1322:    gr = 40;
1323:    gg = 200;
1324:    gb = 40;
1325:  } else if (pct > 30) {
1326:    gr = 220;
1327:    gg = 200;
1328:    gb = 40;
1329:  } else {
1330:    gr = 220;
1331:    gg = 40;
1332:    gb = 40;
1333:  }
1334:  fill_rect(s, x, y, fill_w, bar_h, gr, gg, gb);
1335:}

1337:static void render_terrain(SDL_Surface *s) {
1338:  int start_tx = cam_x / TILE;
1339:  int start_ty = cam_y / TILE;
1340:  int end_tx = start_tx + (WIN_W / TILE) + 2;
1341:  int end_ty = start_ty + (VIEW_H / TILE) + 2;
1342:  if (start_tx < 0)
1343:    start_tx = 0;
1344:  if (start_ty < 0)
1345:    start_ty = 0;
1346:  if (end_tx > MAP_W)
1347:    end_tx = MAP_W;
1348:  if (end_ty > MAP_H)
1349:    end_ty = MAP_H;
1350:
1351:  for (int ty = start_ty; ty < end_ty; ty++)
1352:    for (int tx = start_tx; tx < end_tx; tx++) {
1353:      Tile *t = &map[tile_idx(tx, ty)];
1354:      int sx = tx * TILE - cam_x;
1355:      int sy = ty * TILE - cam_y + TOP_H;
1356:      Uint8 *c = TCOLOR[t->terrain];
1357:      /* Add slight variation */
1358:      Uint8 variation = (Uint8)((tx * 7 + ty * 13) % 16) - 8;
1359:      fill_rect(s, sx, sy, TILE, TILE, (Uint8)(c[0] + variation),
1360:                (Uint8)(c[1] + variation), (Uint8)(c[2] + variation));
1361:
1362:      /* Draw resource indicators */
1363:      if (t->terrain == T_FOREST && t->res_amt > 0) {
1364:        /* Tree: dark green circle with brown trunk */
1365:        int cx2 = sx + TILE / 2, cy2 = sy + TILE / 2;
1366:        fill_rect(s, cx2 - 8, cy2 - 10, 16, 14, 20, 80, 20);
1367:        fill_rect(s, cx2 - 2, cy2 + 2, 4, 8, 100, 60, 20);
1368:      } else if (t->terrain == T_GOLD && t->res_amt > 0) {
1369:        /* Gold: yellow sparkles */
1370:        fill_rect(s, sx + 6, sy + 8, 20, 16, 220, 200, 50);
1371:        fill_rect(s, sx + 10, sy + 12, 12, 8, 255, 240, 100);
1372:      } else if (t->terrain == T_STONE && t->res_amt > 0) {
1373:        /* Stone: gray rocks */
1374:        fill_rect(s, sx + 4, sy + 6, 24, 20, 120, 120, 120);
1375:        fill_rect(s, sx + 8, sy + 10, 16, 12, 160, 160, 160);
1376:      } else if (t->terrain == T_BERRY && t->res_amt > 0) {
1377:        /* Berry bush: green bush with red dots */
1378:        fill_rect(s, sx + 4, sy + 4, 24, 24, 40, 120, 40);
1379:        fill_rect(s, sx + 8, sy + 8, 4, 4, 200, 50, 50);
1380:        fill_rect(s, sx + 16, sy + 10, 4, 4, 200, 50, 50);
1381:        fill_rect(s, sx + 12, sy + 16, 4, 4, 200, 50, 50);
1382:      } else if (t->terrain == T_FARM_PLOT) {
1383:        /* Farm: brown soil with green rows */
1384:        fill_rect(s, sx + 2, sy + 4, 28, 4, 100, 160, 50);
1385:        fill_rect(s, sx + 2, sy + 14, 28, 4, 100, 160, 50);
1386:        fill_rect(s, sx + 2, sy + 24, 28, 4, 100, 160, 50);
1387:      }
1388:    }
1389:}

1391:static void render_buildings(SDL_Surface *s) {
1392:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_B; i++) {
1393:    Building *b = &blds[i];
1394:    if (!b->active)
1395:      continue;
1396:    int sx = b->tx * TILE - cam_x;
1397:    int sy = b->ty * TILE - cam_y + TOP_H;
1398:    int sw = b->sw * TILE;
1399:    int sh = b->sh * TILE;
1400:
1401:    /* Cull */
1402:    if (sx + sw < 0 || sx > WIN_W || sy + sh < TOP_H || sy > WIN_H - HUD_H)
1403:      continue;
1404:
1405:    Uint8 *c = BCOL[b->owner][b->type];
1406:    if (b->state == BS_BUILD) {
1407:      /* Darker when building */
1408:      fill_rect(s, sx, sy, sw, sh, c[0] / 2, c[1] / 2, c[2] / 2);
1409:      /* Progress bar */
1410:      fill_rect(s, sx, sy + sh + 2, sw, 3, 40, 40, 40);
1411:      fill_rect(s, sx, sy + sh + 2, (sw * b->progress) / 100, 3, 200, 200, 50);
1412:    } else {
1413:      fill_rect(s, sx, sy, sw, sh, c[0], c[1], c[2]);
1414:      /* Building detail */
1415:      if (b->type == B_TC) {
1416:        /* Town center: door and roof line */
1417:        fill_rect(s, sx + sw / 2 - 6, sy + sh - 12, 12, 12, 80, 60, 30);
1418:        fill_rect(s, sx + 2, sy + 2, sw - 4, 6, (Uint8)(c[0] * 0.7),
1419:                  (Uint8)(c[1] * 0.7), (Uint8)(c[2] * 0.7));
1420:        /* Flag */
1421:        fill_rect(s, sx + sw / 2, sy - 8, 2, 10, 60, 60, 60);
1422:        fill_rect(s, sx + sw / 2 + 2, sy - 8, 8, 6, b->owner == 0 ? 60 : 220,
1423:                  b->owner == 0 ? 120 : 60, b->owner == 0 ? 220 : 60);
1424:      } else if (b->type == B_HOUSE) {
1425:        fill_rect(s, sx + sw / 2 - 4, sy + sh - 10, 8, 10, 80, 60, 30);
1426:        fill_rect(s, sx, sy, sw, 5, (Uint8)(c[0] * 0.7), (Uint8)(c[1] * 0.7),
1427:                  (Uint8)(c[2] * 0.7));
1428:      } else if (b->type == B_BARRACKS) {
1429:        fill_rect(s, sx + 4, sy + sh - 10, sw - 8, 10, 60, 40, 20);
1430:        /* Swords crossed */
1431:        fill_rect(s, sx + sw / 2 - 1, sy + 4, 2, sh - 14, 180, 180, 180);
1432:        fill_rect(s, sx + 4, sy + sh / 2 - 1, sw - 8, 2, 180, 180, 180);
1433:      } else if (b->type == B_FARM) {
1434:        /* Already rendered as terrain */
1435:        continue;
1436:      }
1437:    }
1438:
1439:    /* HP bar */
1440:    if (b->hp < b->hp_max)
1441:      draw_hp_bar(s, sx, sy - 7, sw, b->hp, b->hp_max);
1442:
1443:    /* Selection highlight */
1444:    if (i == sel_bid) {
1445:      /* White border */
1446:      fill_rect(s, sx - 1, sy - 1, sw + 2, 2, 255, 255, 255);
1447:      fill_rect(s, sx - 1, sy + sh - 1, sw + 2, 2, 255, 255, 255);
1448:      fill_rect(s, sx - 1, sy, 2, sh, 255, 255, 255);
1449:      fill_rect(s, sx + sw - 1, sy, 2, sh, 255, 255, 255);
1450:    }
1451:
1452:    /* Training progress */
1453:    if (b->train_type >= 0) {
1454:      int pct = (b->train_timer * 100) / TRAIN_TIME[b->type][b->train_type];
1455:      pct = 100 - pct;
1456:      fill_rect(s, sx, sy + sh + (b->state == BS_BUILD ? 6 : 2), sw, 3, 40, 40,
1457:                40);
1458:      fill_rect(s, sx, sy + sh + (b->state == BS_BUILD ? 6 : 2),
1459:                (sw * pct) / 100, 3, 100, 200, 255);
1460:    }
1461:  }
1462:}

1464:static void render_units(SDL_Surface *s) {
1465:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_U; i++) {
1466:    Unit *u = &units[i];
1467:    if (!u->active)
1468:      continue;
1469:    int sx = u->x - cam_x;
1470:    int sy = u->y - cam_y + TOP_H;
1471:
1472:    /* Cull */
1473:    if (sx < -16 || sx > WIN_W + 16 || sy < TOP_H - 16 ||
1474:        sy > WIN_H - HUD_H + 16)
1475:      continue;
1476:
1477:    Uint8 *c = UCOL[u->owner][u->type];
1478:    if (u->flash > 0 && (u->flash % 2) == 0) {
1479:      /* Hit flash: white */
1480:      c = (Uint8[]){255, 255, 255};
1481:    }
1482:
1483:    int sz = 7;
1484:    switch (u->type) {
1485:    case U_VILLAGER:
1486:      /* Circle */
1487:      fill_rect(s, sx - sz + 2, sy - sz, (sz - 2) * 2, 2, c[0], c[1], c[2]);
1488:      fill_rect(s, sx - sz, sy - sz + 2, sz * 2, (sz - 2) * 2, c[0], c[1],
1489:                c[2]);
1490:      fill_rect(s, sx - sz + 2, sy + sz - 2, (sz - 2) * 2, 2, c[0], c[1], c[2]);
1491:      /* Carrying indicator */
1492:      if (u->carry_amt > 0) {
1493:        Uint8 rc[3] = {200, 180, 50}; /* gold color for carrying */
1494:        if (u->carry_type == 0) {
1495:          rc[0] = 120;
1496:          rc[1] = 80;
1497:          rc[2] = 30;
1498:        } /* wood */
1499:        else if (u->carry_type == 1) {
1500:          rc[0] = 200;
1501:          rc[1] = 60;
1502:          rc[2] = 60;
1503:        } /* food */
1504:        fill_rect(s, sx - 3, sy + sz - 1, 6, 4, rc[0], rc[1], rc[2]);
1505:      }
1506:      break;
1507:    case U_MILITIA:
1508:      /* Square */
1509:      fill_rect(s, sx - sz, sy - sz, sz * 2, sz * 2, c[0], c[1], c[2]);
1510:      /* Sword line */
1511:      fill_rect(s, sx + sz - 2, sy - sz - 3, 2, 6, 200, 200, 200);
1512:      break;
1513:    case U_SPEARMAN:
1514:      /* Triangle (approximate with rect arrangement) */
1515:      fill_rect(s, sx - 1, sy - sz, 3, sz * 2, c[0], c[1], c[2]);
1516:      fill_rect(s, sx - sz + 2, sy - 2, (sz - 2) * 2, 3, c[0], c[1], c[2]);
1517:      fill_rect(s, sx - 4, sy - 4, 8, 8, c[0], c[1], c[2]);
1518:      /* Spear */
1519:      fill_rect(s, sx + 4, sy - sz - 4, 1, sz + 4, 200, 200, 200);
1520:      break;
1521:    case U_ARCHER:
1522:      /* Diamond */
1523:      fill_rect(s, sx - 1, sy - sz, 3, sz * 2, c[0], c[1], c[2]);
1524:      fill_rect(s, sx - sz, sy - 1, sz * 2, 3, c[0], c[1], c[2]);
1525:      /* Bow */
1526:      fill_rect(s, sx + 3, sy - 6, 2, 12, 160, 120, 60);
1527:      break;
1528:    }
1529:
1530:    /* Owner indicator ring */
1531:    if (u->owner == 0)
1532:      fill_rect(s, sx - sz - 1, sy + sz, sz * 2 + 2, 1, 60, 60, 255);
1533:    else
1534:      fill_rect(s, sx - sz - 1, sy + sz, sz * 2 + 2, 1, 255, 60, 60);
1535:
1536:    /* Selection circle */
1537:    int is_sel = 0;
1538:    for (int j = 0; j < sel_count; j++)
1539:      if (sel[j] == i) {
1540:        is_sel = 1;
1541:        break;
1542:      }
1543:    if (is_sel) {
1544:      fill_rect(s, sx - sz - 2, sy - sz - 2, 1, sz * 2 + 4, 255, 255, 255);
1545:      fill_rect(s, sx + sz + 1, sy - sz - 2, 1, sz * 2 + 4, 255, 255, 255);
1546:      fill_rect(s, sx - sz - 2, sy - sz - 2, sz * 2 + 4, 1, 255, 255, 255);
1547:      fill_rect(s, sx - sz - 2, sy + sz + 1, sz * 2 + 4, 1, 255, 255, 255);
1548:    }
1549:
1550:    /* HP bar */
1551:    if (u->hp < u->hp_max)

1616:/* Simple 3-pixel-wide digit rendering */
1617:static void draw_digit(SDL_Surface *s, int d, int x, int y, Uint8 r, Uint8 g,
1618:                       Uint8 b) {
1619:  /* 3x5 pixel digits */
1620:  static const char digits[10][5][4] = {
1621:      {"111", "101", "101", "101", "111"}, {"010", "110", "010", "010", "111"},
1622:      {"111", "001", "111", "100", "111"}, {"111", "001", "111", "001", "111"},
1623:      {"101", "101", "111", "001", "001"}, {"111", "100", "111", "001", "111"},
1624:      {"111", "100", "111", "101", "111"}, {"111", "001", "001", "001", "001"},
1625:      {"111", "101", "111", "101", "111"}, {"111", "101", "111", "001", "111"},
1626:  };
1627:  for (int row = 0; row < 5; row++)
1628:    for (int col = 0; col < 3; col++)
1629:      if (digits[d][row][col] == '1')
1630:        fill_rect(s, x + col * 3, y + row * 3, 3, 3, r, g, b);
1631:}
1632:
1633:static void draw_num(SDL_Surface *s, int val, int x, int y, Uint8 r, Uint8 g,
1634:                     Uint8 b) {
1635:  char buf[8];
1636:  int n = 0;
1637:  if (val == 0) {
1638:    buf[n++] = '0';
1639:  } else {
1640:    int v = val;
1641:    while (v > 0 && n < 7) {
1642:      buf[n++] = '0' + (v % 10);
1643:      v /= 10;
1644:    }
1645:    /* Reverse */
1646:    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
1647:      char t = buf[i];
1648:      buf[i] = buf[n - 1 - i];
1649:      buf[n - 1 - i] = t;
1650:    }
1651:  }
1652:  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
1653:    draw_digit(s, buf[i] - '0', x + i * 12, y, r, g, b);
1654:  }
1655:}

1777:static void render_minimap(SDL_Surface *s) {
1778:  int mx0 = WIN_W - MINI_W - 6;
1779:  int my0 = TOP_H + 6;
1780:  /* Background */
1781:  fill_rect(s, mx0 - 1, my0 - 1, MINI_W + 2, MINI_H + 2, 20, 20, 30);
1782:
1783:  int sx = MINI_W / MAP_W;
1784:  int sy = MINI_H / MAP_H;
1785:
1786:  /* Terrain (every other tile for performance) */
1787:  for (int ty = 0; ty < MAP_H; ty += 1)
1788:    for (int tx = 0; tx < MAP_W; tx += 1) {
1789:      Tile *t = &map[tile_idx(tx, ty)];
1790:      Uint8 *c = TCOLOR[t->terrain];
1791:      fill_rect(s, mx0 + tx * sx, my0 + ty * sy, sx, sy, c[0], c[1], c[2]);
1792:    }
1793:
1794:  /* Buildings */
1795:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_B; i++) {
1796:    if (!blds[i].active)
1797:      continue;
1798:    Uint8 r2, g2, b2;
1799:    if (blds[i].owner == 0) {
1800:      r2 = 180;
1801:      g2 = 180;
1802:      b2 = 220;
1803:    } else {
1804:      r2 = 220;
1805:      g2 = 80;
1806:      b2 = 80;
1807:    }
1808:    fill_rect(s, mx0 + blds[i].tx * sx, my0 + blds[i].ty * sy, blds[i].sw * sx,
1809:              blds[i].sh * sy, r2, g2, b2);
1810:  }
1811:
1812:  /* Units */
1813:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_U; i++) {
1814:    if (!units[i].active)
1815:      continue;
1816:    int ux = units[i].x / TILE;
1817:    int uy = units[i].y / TILE;
1818:    if (units[i].owner == 0)
1819:      fill_rect(s, mx0 + ux * sx, my0 + uy * sy, 2, 2, 240, 240, 255);
1820:    else
1821:      fill_rect(s, mx0 + ux * sx, my0 + uy * sy, 2, 2, 255, 80, 80);
1822:  }
1823:
1824:  /* Camera viewport rectangle */
1825:  int vx = (cam_x * MINI_W) / (MAP_W * TILE);
1826:  int vy = (cam_y * MINI_H) / (MAP_H * TILE);
1827:  int vw = (WIN_W * MINI_W) / (MAP_W * TILE);
1828:  int vh = (VIEW_H * MINI_H) / (MAP_H * TILE);
1829:  fill_rect(s, mx0 + vx, my0 + vy, vw, vh, 0, 0, 0);
1830:  /* White border on viewport */
1831:  fill_rect(s, mx0 + vx, my0 + vy, vw, 1, 255, 255, 255);
1832:  fill_rect(s, mx0 + vx, my0 + vy + vh - 1, vw, 1, 255, 255, 255);
1833:  fill_rect(s, mx0 + vx, my0 + vy, 1, vh, 255, 255, 255);
1834:  fill_rect(s, mx0 + vx + vw - 1, my0 + vy, 1, vh, 255, 255, 255);
1835:}

1837:static void render_selection_box(SDL_Surface *s) {
1838:  if (!dragging)
1839:    return;
1840:  int x1 = drag_sx, y1 = drag_sy;
1841:  int x2 = mx, y2 = my;
1842:  if (y1 > TOP_H && y2 > TOP_H) {
1843:    if (x1 > x2) {
1844:      int t = x1;
1845:      x1 = x2;
1846:      x2 = t;
1847:    }
1848:    if (y1 > y2) {
1849:      int t = y1;
1850:      y1 = y2;
1851:      y2 = t;
1852:    }
1853:    /* Clamp to view area */
1854:    if (y1 < TOP_H)
1855:      y1 = TOP_H;
1856:    if (y2 > WIN_H - HUD_H)
1857:      y2 = WIN_H - HUD_H;
1858:    fill_rect(s, x1, y1, x2 - x1, 1, 255, 255, 255);
1859:    fill_rect(s, x1, y2 - 1, x2 - x1, 1, 255, 255, 255);
1860:    fill_rect(s, x1, y1, 1, y2 - y1, 255, 255, 255);
1861:    fill_rect(s, x2 - 1, y1, 1, y2 - y1, 255, 255, 255);
1862:  }
1863:}

1865:static void render_placement_ghost(SDL_Surface *s) {
1866:  if (place_mode == PM_NONE)
1867:    return;
1868:  int btype = -1;
1869:  if (place_mode == PM_HOUSE)
1870:    btype = B_HOUSE;
1871:  else if (place_mode == PM_BARRACKS)
1872:    btype = B_BARRACKS;
1873:  else if (place_mode == PM_FARM)
1874:    btype = B_FARM;
1875:  if (btype < 0)
1876:    return;
1877:
1878:  int tx = mwx / TILE, ty = (mwy - TOP_H + cam_y) / TILE;
1879:  int sw = BSIZE_W[btype], sh = BSIZE_H[btype];
1880:  int sx = tx * TILE - cam_x;
1881:  int sy = ty * TILE - cam_y + TOP_H;
1882:
1883:  int ok = can_place(btype, 0, tx, ty);
1884:  /* Checkerboard ghost */
1885:  for (int dy2 = 0; dy2 < sh; dy2++)
1886:    for (int dx2 = 0; dx2 < sw; dx2++) {
1887:      int chk = (dx2 + dy2) % 2;
1888:      if (ok)
1889:        fill_rect(s, sx + dx2 * TILE + chk * TILE / 2, sy + dy2 * TILE,
1890:                  TILE / 2, TILE, chk ? 100 : 150, chk ? 255 : 200,
1891:                  chk ? 100 : 150);
1892:      else
1893:        fill_rect(s, sx + dx2 * TILE + chk * TILE / 2, sy + dy2 * TILE,
1894:                  TILE / 2, TILE, chk ? 255 : 180, chk ? 80 : 50,
1895:                  chk ? 80 : 50);
1896:    }
1897:  /* Border */
1898:  Uint8 bc2 = ok ? 150 : 255;
1899:  Uint8 bg2 = ok ? 255 : 60;
1900:  Uint8 bb2 = ok ? 150 : 60;
1901:  fill_rect(s, sx, sy, sw * TILE, 2, bc2, bg2, bb2);
1902:  fill_rect(s, sx, sy + sh * TILE - 2, sw * TILE, 2, bc2, bg2, bb2);
1903:  fill_rect(s, sx, sy, 2, sh * TILE, bc2, bg2, bb2);
1904:  fill_rect(s, sx + sw * TILE - 2, sy, 2, sh * TILE, bc2, bg2, bb2);
1905:}

1940:static void do_select(int wx, int wy) {
1941:  /* Convert window to world */
1942:  int wwx = wx + cam_x;
1943:  int wwy = wy - TOP_H + cam_y;
1944:
1945:  sel_count = 0;
1946:  sel_bid = -1;
1947:
1948:  /* Try to select a player unit */
1949:  int ui = unit_at(wwx, wwy, 0);
1950:  if (ui >= 0) {
1951:    sel[0] = ui;
1952:    sel_count = 1;
1953:    return;
1954:  }
1955:
1956:  /* Try to select a player building */
1957:  int tx = wwx / TILE, ty = wwy / TILE;
1958:  int bi = building_at_tile(tx, ty);
1959:  if (bi >= 0 && blds[bi].active && blds[bi].owner == 0) {
1960:    sel_bid = bi;
1961:    return;
1962:  }
1963:}

1965:static void do_box_select(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
1966:  /* Convert to world coords */
1967:  int wx1 = x1 + cam_x, wy1 = y1 - TOP_H + cam_y;
1968:  int wx2 = x2 + cam_x, wy2 = y2 - TOP_H + cam_y;
1969:  if (wx1 > wx2) {
1970:    int t = wx1;
1971:    wx1 = wx2;
1972:    wx2 = t;
1973:  }
1974:  if (wy1 > wy2) {
1975:    int t = wy1;
1976:    wy1 = wy2;
1977:    wy2 = t;
1978:  }
1979:
1980:  sel_count = 0;
1981:  sel_bid = -1;
1982:
1983:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_U && sel_count < MAX_SEL; i++) {
1984:    if (!units[i].active || units[i].owner != 0)
1985:      continue;
1986:    if (units[i].x >= wx1 && units[i].x <= wx2 && units[i].y >= wy1 &&
1987:        units[i].y <= wy2) {
1988:      sel[sel_count++] = i;
1989:    }
1990:  }
1991:}

1993:static void do_right_click(int wx, int wy) {
1994:  if (sel_count == 0)
1995:    return;
1996:
1997:  int wwx = wx + cam_x;
1998:  int wwy = wy - TOP_H + cam_y;
1999:
2000:  /* Check if clicking on enemy unit */
2001:  int eui = unit_at(wwx, wwy, 1);
2002:  if (eui >= 0) {
2003:    for (int i = 0; i < sel_count; i++) {
2004:      Unit *u = &units[sel[i]];
2005:      u->state = S_ATTACK;
2006:      u->tid = eui;
2007:    }
2008:    return;
2009:  }
2010:
2011:  /* Check if clicking on enemy building */
2012:  int tx = wwx / TILE, ty = wwy / TILE;
2013:  int ebi = building_at_tile(tx, ty);
2014:  if (ebi >= 0 && blds[ebi].active && blds[ebi].owner == 1) {
2015:    for (int i = 0; i < sel_count; i++) {
2016:      Unit *u = &units[sel[i]];
2017:      u->state = S_ATTACK;
2018:      u->tid = -(ebi + 1);
2019:    }
2020:    return;
2021:  }
2022:
2023:  /* Check if clicking on own building under construction (to build) */
2024:  if (ebi >= 0 && blds[ebi].active && blds[ebi].owner == 0 &&
2025:      blds[ebi].state == BS_BUILD) {
2026:    for (int i = 0; i < sel_count; i++) {
2027:      if (units[sel[i]].type == U_VILLAGER) {
2028:        units[sel[i]].state = S_BUILD;
2029:        units[sel[i]].tid = ebi;
2030:        blds[ebi].builders++;
2031:      }
2032:    }
2033:    return;
2034:  }
2035:
2036:  /* Check if clicking on a resource tile (for villagers) */
2037:  if (tx >= 0 && tx < MAP_W && ty >= 0 && ty < MAP_H) {
2038:    Tile *t = &map[tile_idx(tx, ty)];
2039:    if (t->res_amt > 0) {
2040:      for (int i = 0; i < sel_count; i++) {
2041:        if (units[sel[i]].type == U_VILLAGER) {
2042:          units[sel[i]].state = S_GATHER;
2043:          units[sel[i]].tid = tile_idx(tx, ty);
2044:          units[sel[i]].gather_t = 0;
2045:          units[sel[i]].carry_amt = 0;
2046:          units[sel[i]].carry_type = -1;
2047:        }
2048:      }
2049:      return;
2050:    }
2051:  }
2052:
2053:  /* Move command */
2054:  for (int i = 0; i < sel_count; i++) {
2055:    Unit *u = &units[sel[i]];
2056:    /* Spread units slightly */
2057:    int offset_x = (i % 4 - 1) * 12;
2058:    int offset_y = (i / 4 - 1) * 12;
2059:    u->state = S_MOVE;
2060:    u->tx = wwx + offset_x;
2061:    u->ty = wwy + offset_y;
2062:    u->tid = -1;
2063:  }
2064:}
2065:
2066:static void do_place_building(int wx, int wy) {
2067:  int btype = -1;
2068:  if (place_mode == PM_HOUSE)
2069:    btype = B_HOUSE;
2070:  else if (place_mode == PM_BARRACKS)
2071:    btype = B_BARRACKS;
2072:  else if (place_mode == PM_FARM)
2073:    btype = B_FARM;
2074:  if (btype < 0)
2075:    return;
2076:
2077:  int wwx = wx + cam_x;
2078:  int wwy = wy - TOP_H + cam_y;
2079:  int tx = wwx / TILE, ty = wwy / TILE;
2080:
2081:  if (!can_place(btype, 0, tx, ty)) {
2082:    show_notif("Impossibile costruire qui!");
2083:    return;
2084:  }
2085:
2086:  /* Check resources */
2087:  if (res[0].wood < BCOST_WOOD[btype]) {
2088:    show_notif("Non abbastanza legno!");
2089:    return;
2090:  }
2091:
2092:  res[0].wood -= BCOST_WOOD[btype];
2093:  int bi = spawn_building(btype, 0, tx, ty);
2094:  if (bi >= 0) {
2095:    /* Auto-assign selected villagers to build */
2096:    for (int i = 0; i < sel_count; i++) {
2097:      if (units[sel[i]].type == U_VILLAGER) {
2098:        units[sel[i]].state = S_BUILD;
2099:        units[sel[i]].tid = bi;
2100:        blds[bi].builders++;
2101:      }
2102:    }
2103:    char msg[64];
2104:    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "%s in costruzione...", BNAME[btype]);
2105:    show_notif(msg);
2106:  }
2107:
2108:  place_mode = PM_NONE;
2109:}
2110:
2111:static void train_unit(int utype) {
2112:  if (sel_bid < 0)
2113:    return;
2114:  Building *b = &blds[sel_bid];
2115:  if (!b->active || b->owner != 0 || b->state != BS_DONE)
2116:    return;
2117:  if (b->train_type >= 0)
2118:    return; /* already training */
2119:  if (pop[0] >= pop_cap[0]) {
2120:    show_notif("Popolazione al massimo!");
2121:    return;
2122:  }
2123:
2124:  int food_cost = TRAIN_FOOD[b->type][utype];
2125:  int wood_cost = TRAIN_WOOD[b->type][utype];
2126:  int gold_cost = TRAIN_GOLD[b->type][utype];
2127:
2128:  if (res[0].food < food_cost || res[0].wood < wood_cost ||
2129:      res[0].gold < gold_cost) {
2130:    show_notif("Risorse insufficienti!");
2131:    return;
2132:  }
2133:
2134:  res[0].food -= food_cost;
2135:  res[0].wood -= wood_cost;
2136:  res[0].gold -= gold_cost;
2137:  b->train_type = utype;
2138:  b->train_timer = TRAIN_TIME[b->type][utype];
2139:
2140:  char msg[64];
2141:  snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "Addestramento %s...", UNAME[utype]);
2142:  show_notif(msg);
2143:}

2148:int main(void) {
2149:  if (SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO) != 0) {
2150:    OS1_notify_error("NexEmpire", "SDL_Init fallito");

2156:  if (!window) {
2157:    OS1_notify_error("NexEmpire", "Finestra non creata");
2158:    SDL_Quit();
2159:    exit(1);
2160:  }
2161:
2162:  SDL_Surface *surface = SDL_GetWindowSurface(window);
2163:  if (!surface) {
2164:    OS1_notify_error("NexEmpire", "Superficie non ottenuta");
2165:    SDL_DestroyWindow(window);
2166:    SDL_Quit();
2167:    exit(1);
2168:  }
2169:
2170:  int win_w = surface->w, win_h = surface->h;
2171:
2172:  /* Load stats from registry */
2173:  char reg_buf[32];
2174:  if (OS1_registry_get("nexempire_wins", reg_buf, sizeof(reg_buf)) > 0)
2175:    wins = atoi(reg_buf);
2176:  if (OS1_registry_get("nexempire_losses", reg_buf, sizeof(reg_buf)) > 0)
2177:    losses = atoi(reg_buf);
2178:
2179:  init_game();
2180:  OS1_notify_post("NexEmpire", "Clicca per iniziare!");
2181:
2182:  int running = 1;
2183:  const Uint8 *keys = SDL_GetKeyboardState(NULL);
2184:
2185:  Uint64 last_sec = SDL_GetTicks64();
2186:  int fps_frames = 0;
2187:
2188:  while (running) {
2189:    SDL_Event event;
2190:    while (SDL_PollEvent(&event)) {
2191:      if (event.type == SDL_QUIT)
2192:        running = 0;
2193:
2194:      if (event.type == SDL_WINDOWEVENT &&
2195:          event.window.event == SDL_WINDOWEVENT_SIZE_CHANGED) {
2196:        surface = SDL_GetWindowSurface(window);
2197:        if (!surface) {
2198:          running = 0;
2199:          break;
2200:        }
2201:        win_w = surface->w;
2202:        win_h = surface->h;
2203:      }
2204:
2205:      if (game_state == GS_START) {
2206:        if (event.type == SDL_MOUSEBUTTONDOWN &&
2207:            event.button.button == SDL_BUTTON_LEFT) {
2208:          game_state = GS_PLAY;
2209:        }
2210:        continue;
2211:      }
2212:
2213:      if (game_state == GS_WIN || game_state == GS_LOSE) {
2214:        if (event.type == SDL_KEYDOWN) {
2215:          if (event.key.keysym.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_R) {
2216:            /* Save stats */
2217:            char buf[32];
2218:            snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%d", wins);
2219:            OS1_registry_set("nexempire_wins", buf);
2220:            snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%d", losses);
2221:            OS1_registry_set("nexempire_losses", buf);
2222:            init_game();
2223:            game_state = GS_PLAY;
2224:          }
2225:          if (event.key.keysym.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_ESCAPE)
2226:            running = 0;
2227:        }
2228:        continue;
2229:      }
2230:
2231:      /* GS_PLAY input handling */
2232:      if (event.type == SDL_MOUSEMOTION) {
2233:        mx = event.motion.x;
2234:        my = event.motion.y;
2235:        mwx = mx + cam_x;
2236:        mwy = my - TOP_H + cam_y;
2237:
2238:        if (dragging) {
2239:          /* Continue dragging */
2240:        }
2241:      }
2242:
2243:      if (event.type == SDL_MOUSEBUTTONDOWN) {
2244:        if (event.button.button == SDL_BUTTON_LEFT) {
2245:          if (my > TOP_H && my < WIN_H - HUD_H) {
2246:            /* Check minimap click */
2247:            int mini_x0 = WIN_W - MINI_W - 6;
2248:            int mini_y0 = TOP_H + 6;
2249:            if (mx >= mini_x0 && mx <= mini_x0 + MINI_W && my >= mini_y0 &&
2250:                my <= mini_y0 + MINI_H) {
2251:              /* Move camera to minimap click */
2252:              cam_x = ((mx - mini_x0) * MAP_W * TILE) / MINI_W;
2253:              cam_y = ((my - mini_y0) * MAP_H * TILE) / MINI_H;
2254:              clamp_cam();
2255:            } else if (place_mode != PM_NONE) {
2256:              do_place_building(mx, my);
2257:            } else {
2258:              dragging = 1;
2259:              drag_sx = mx;
2260:              drag_sy = my;
2261:            }
2262:          }
2263:        } else if (event.button.button == SDL_BUTTON_RIGHT) {
2264:          if (place_mode != PM_NONE) {
2265:            place_mode = PM_NONE;
2266:          } else if (my > TOP_H && my < WIN_H - HUD_H) {
2267:            do_right_click(mx, my);
2268:          }
2269:        }
2270:      }
2271:
2272:      if (event.type == SDL_MOUSEBUTTONUP) {
2273:        if (event.button.button == SDL_BUTTON_LEFT && dragging) {
2274:          dragging = 0;
2275:          int dx = mx - drag_sx, dy = my - drag_sy;
2276:          if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 25) {
2277:            /* Single click */
2278:            do_select(mx, my);
2279:          } else {
2280:            /* Box select */
2281:            do_box_select(drag_sx, drag_sy, mx, my);
2282:          }
2283:        }
2284:      }
2285:
2286:      if (event.type == SDL_KEYDOWN) {
2287:        SDL_Scancode sc = event.key.keysym.scancode;
2288:        if (sc == SDL_SCANCODE_ESCAPE) {
2289:          if (place_mode != PM_NONE)
2290:            place_mode = PM_NONE;
2291:          else
2292:            running = 0;
2293:        }
2294:        if (sc == SDL_SCANCODE_H)
2295:          place_mode = PM_HOUSE;
2296:        if (sc == SDL_SCANCODE_B)
2297:          place_mode = PM_BARRACKS;
2298:        if (sc == SDL_SCANCODE_F)
2299:          place_mode = PM_FARM;
2300:        if (sc == SDL_SCANCODE_V)
2301:          train_unit(U_VILLAGER);
2302:        if (sc == SDL_SCANCODE_M)
2303:          train_unit(U_MILITIA);
2304:        if (sc == SDL_SCANCODE_P)
2305:          train_unit(U_SPEARMAN);
2306:        if (sc == SDL_SCANCODE_A)
2307:          train_unit(U_ARCHER);
2308:        if (sc == SDL_SCANCODE_DELETE || sc == SDL_SCANCODE_BACKSPACE) {
2309:          if (sel_bid >= 0 && blds[sel_bid].active &&
2310:              blds[sel_bid].owner == 0) {
2311:            /* Refund 50% */
2312:            res[0].wood += BCOST_WOOD[blds[sel_bid].type] / 2;
2313:            remove_building(sel_bid);
2314:            sel_bid = -1;
2315:            show_notif("Edificio eliminato");
2316:          }
2317:        }
2318:      }
2319:    }
2320:
2321:    /* Camera scrolling */
2322:    if (game_state == GS_PLAY) {
2323:      if (keys[SDL_SCANCODE_LEFT])
2324:        cam_x -= CAM_SPD;
2325:      if (keys[SDL_SCANCODE_RIGHT])
2326:        cam_x += CAM_SPD;
2327:      if (keys[SDL_SCANCODE_UP])
2328:        cam_y -= CAM_SPD;
2329:      if (keys[SDL_SCANCODE_DOWN])
2330:        cam_y += CAM_SPD;
2331:
2332:      /* Edge scrolling */
2333:      if (mx < EDGE_Z)
2334:        cam_x -= CAM_SPD;
2335:      if (mx > WIN_W - EDGE_Z)
2336:        cam_x += CAM_SPD;
2337:      if (my > TOP_H && my < TOP_H + EDGE_Z)
2338:        cam_y -= CAM_SPD;
2339:      if (my > WIN_H - HUD_H - EDGE_Z && my < WIN_H - HUD_H)
2340:        cam_y += CAM_SPD;
2341:
2342:      clamp_cam();
2343:
2344:      /* Update world */
2345:      frame++;
2346:      if (frame % 60 == 0)
2347:        game_time++;
2348:
2349:      for (int i = 0; i < MAX_U; i++)
2350:        update_unit(i);
2351:      update_buildings();
2352:      ai_update();
2353:
2354:      /* Check lose condition */
2355:      if (game_state == GS_PLAY) {
2356:        int has_units = 0, has_tc = 0;
2357:        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_U; i++)
2358:          if (units[i].active && units[i].owner == 0) {
2359:            has_units = 1;
2360:            break;
2361:          }
2362:        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_B; i++)
2363:          if (blds[i].active && blds[i].type == B_TC && blds[i].owner == 0) {
2364:            has_tc = 1;
2365:            break;
2366:          }
2367:        if (!has_tc && !has_units) {
2368:          game_state = GS_LOSE;
2369:          losses++;
2370:          show_notif("Sconfitta!");
2371:        }
2372:      }
2373:    }
2374:
2375:    /* Render */
2376:    if (surface) {
2377:      /* Clear */
2378:      fill_rect(surface, 0, 0, win_w, win_h, 0, 0, 0);
2379:
2380:      if (game_state == GS_START) {
2381:        /* Render a preview of the map */
2382:        render_terrain(surface);
2383:        render_buildings(surface);
2384:        render_units(surface);
2385:      } else {
2386:        render_terrain(surface);
2387:        render_buildings(surface);
2388:        render_units(surface);
2389:        render_selection_box(surface);
2390:        render_placement_ghost(surface);
2391:        render_hud_detailed(surface);
2392:        render_minimap(surface);
2393:      }
2394:      render_overlay(surface);
2395:
2396:      if (SDL_UpdateWindowSurface(window) != 0) {
2397:        surface = SDL_GetWindowSurface(window);
2398:        if (!surface) {
2399:          running = 0;
2400:        }
2401:      }
2402:    }
2403:
2404:    /* FPS counter */
2405:    fps_frames++;
2406:    Uint64 now = SDL_GetTicks64();
2407:    if (now - last_sec >= 1000) {
2408:      last_sec = now;
2409:      fps_frames = 0;
2410:    }
2411:
2412:    SDL_Delay(16); /* ~60 FPS */
2413:  }
2414:
2415:  /* Save stats on exit */
2416:  {
2417:    char buf[32];
2418:    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%d", wins);
2419:    OS1_registry_set("nexempire_wins", buf);
2420:    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%d", losses);
2421:    OS1_registry_set("nexempire_losses", buf);
2422:  }
2423:
2424:  SDL_DestroyWindow(window);
2425:  SDL_Quit();
2426:  printf("[NexEmpire] chiusura\n");
2427:  exit(0);
2428:  return 0;
2429:}

@@@ user/bin/nxtest.c @@@
1:/*
2: * user/bin/nxtest.c
3: * W^X user-space test (ELF-02): attempts to execute code from the stack.
4: *
5: * Expected behaviour with W^X enforced: the indirect call below takes an
6: * instruction-fetch fault (UXN on aarch64, NX on amd64), the kernel kills
7: * THIS process and the shell survives — the FAIL line below never prints.
8: * If the FAIL line appears, user stack pages are executable again.
9: */
10:#include <os1.h>
11:
12:int main(void) {
13:  /* A single return instruction, written into a stack buffer. */
14:  unsigned char code[8];
15:#ifdef __aarch64__
16:  /* ret = 0xd65f03c0 (little endian) */
17:  code[0] = 0xc0; code[1] = 0x03; code[2] = 0x5f; code[3] = 0xd6;
18:#else
19:  code[0] = 0xc3; /* ret */
20:#endif
21:
22:  printf("[nxtest] executing from the stack (expect: this process dies)\n");
23:  flush();
24:
25:  /* Object→function pointer via uintptr_t (ISO C pedantic-clean). */
26:  uintptr_t addr = (uintptr_t)code;
27:  void (*f)(void) = (void (*)(void))addr;
28:  f();
29:
30:  printf("[nxtest] FAIL: stack code executed - W^X is NOT enforced\n");
31:  return 1;
32:}

@@@ user/bin/raptor.c @@@
1:/*
2: * user/bin/raptor.c
3: * "NexRaptor" — top-down scrolling shoot-em-up, in the spirit of the classic
4: * shadow-squadron shmups of the '90s. This is the OS's hidden easter egg:
5: * a single self-contained file exercising the SDL2 port exactly like
6: * sdltest.c (SDL_GetWindowSurface software framebuffer path), plus the
7: * fixed-point math helpers from kernel/lib/math.c (sin_fp/cos_fp) already
8: * used by demo3d.c for the sine-wave enemy movement.
9: *
10: * Design goals: simple controls, procedurally generated waves so no two
11: * runs play the same, chunky bright pixel-art sprites, and a persistent
12: * high score stored in the OS registry (OS1_registry_get/set) so bragging
13: * rights survive a reboot.
14: *
15: * WEAPON SYSTEM ("raptor / call of the shadow" style):
16: *   5 weapon families, unlocked one at a time by clearing bosses:
17: *     1 NORMALE  - always available, single/twin/triple shot as it levels up
18: *     2 TRIPLO   - wide spread, unlocked after boss #1
19: *     3 MITRA    - twin-barrel rapid fire, unlocked after boss #2
20: *     4 LASER    - thin piercing beam-bullet (passes through enemies),
21: *                  unlocked after boss #3
22: *     5 MISSILI  - slow homing missile with splash damage, unlocked after
23: *                  boss #4
24: *   Number keys 1-5 switch between *unlocked* weapons at any time; picking
25: *   up a weapon powerup (blue) upgrades the *currently selected* weapon's
26: *   power level (1-3) instead of just handing out a new gun, so switching
27: *   weapons is a real tactical choice, not a strict upgrade path.
28: *   Enemies roll their own weapon from the same 5-family pool (see
29: *   spawn_enemy_of_type / enemy_fire_weapon), so ships/bosses can fire
30: *   triple-spread, mitragliatrice bursts, piercing lasers or homing
31: *   missiles right back at you. Bosses always carry two weapon families
32: *   and alternate between them over time.
33: *
34: * ENEMY TYPES: the original four fighters stay as "tipo 0..3"
35: * (STRAIGHT/SINE/DIVER/SHOOTER), plus two "astronavi" classes (FRIGATE,
36: * CRUISER - tougher hulls, better guns), METEOR (an environmental hazard
37: * that never shoots: break it for a chance at a weapon/health bonus, or
38: * let it drift past harmlessly if you dodge it) and BOSS (every 5th
39: * level, always carrying two weapon families).
40: *
41: * Everything - which enemy spawns, how tough it is, which weapon it
42: * carries, how often meteors fall - is picked by a tiny xorshift PRNG
43: * seeded from get_time()/get_pid() and scaled by the current level, so the
44: * whole run is different every time ("livelli generativi") from just a
45: * handful of rules instead of hand-authored level scripts.
46: *
47: * Controls:
48: *   Arrow keys  - move
49: *   Space       - fire (auto-repeats while held; behaviour depends on the
50: *                 selected weapon)
51: *   1-5         - switch to weapon slot N (only if already unlocked)
52: *   X / LCTRL   - smart bomb (starts with 2, earns more by clearing levels)
53: *   R           - restart after Game Over
54: *   Escape      - quit
55: *
56: * Every 5th level is a boss encounter. Everything else (enemy mix, spawn
57: * rate, enemy HP/speed/weapon) scales with the level number.
58: */
59:#include <os1.h>
60:
61:#include "SDL.h"
62:
63:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
64:/* Constants                                                               */
65:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
66:
67:#define WIN_W 480
68:#define WIN_H 360
69:#define SCALE 3 /* pixel-art block size in real pixels */
70:
71:#define MAX_ENEMIES 26
72:#define MAX_PBULLETS 30
73:#define MAX_EBULLETS 56
74:#define MAX_POWERUPS 8
75:#define MAX_PARTICLES 140
76:#define STAR_COUNT 90
77:
78:enum {
79:  ETYPE_STRAIGHT = 0, /* "tipo 0": original straight-falling fighter */
80:  ETYPE_SINE,
81:  ETYPE_DIVER,
82:  ETYPE_SHOOTER,
83:  ETYPE_FRIGATE, /* astronave leggera: sine weave + spread gun */
84:  ETYPE_CRUISER, /* astronave pesante: tanky, missiles/laser */
85:  ETYPE_METEOR,  /* environmental hazard/bonus source, never shoots */
86:  ETYPE_BOSS
87:};
88:
89:enum { PU_WEAPON = 0, PU_HEALTH, PU_BOMB, PU_TYPE_COUNT };
90:
91:enum { STATE_PLAYING = 0, STATE_LEVEL_CLEAR, STATE_GAMEOVER };
92:
93:/* Weapon families - shared pool for both the player and every enemy that
94: * can shoot, so "ogni nemico può usare un'arma diversa" falls out of one
95: * enemy_fire_weapon() switch instead of per-enemy special-casing. */
96:enum {
97:  WPN_NORMAL = 0,
98:  WPN_TRIPLE,
99:  WPN_MITRA,
100:  WPN_LASER,
101:  WPN_MISSILE,
102:  WPN_COUNT
103:};

114:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
115:/* Tiny xorshift PRNG - no libc rand() on this platform, so we roll our own
116: * the same way the rest of user-space does when it needs randomness. */
117:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
118:
119:static unsigned int rng_state = 0x9e3779b9u;
120:
121:static unsigned int rng_next(void) {
122:  unsigned int x = rng_state;
123:  x ^= x << 13;
124:  x ^= x >> 17;
125:  x ^= x << 5;
126:  rng_state = x;
127:  return x;
128:}
129:
130:static int rng_range(int lo, int hi) {
131:  if (hi <= lo)
132:    return lo;
133:  return lo + (int)(rng_next() % (unsigned)(hi - lo + 1));
134:}
135:
136:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
137:/* Pixel-art sprites. Rows may be any length (draw_sprite stops at the NUL
138: * terminator of each row independently), so the art below doesn't need to
139: * be a perfect rectangle - it's just ASCII silhouettes. */
140:/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
141:
142:typedef struct {
143:  char ch;
144:  Uint8 r, g, b;
145:} SpritePalette;
146:
147:static void fillblock(SDL_Surface *s, int x, int y, int w, int h, Uint8 r,
148:                      Uint8 g, Uint8 b) {
149:  if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
150:    return;
151:  SDL_Rect rc = {x, y, w, h};
152:  SDL_FillRect(s, &rc, SDL_MapRGB(s->format, r, g, b));
153:}
154:
155:static void draw_sprite(SDL_Surface *s, const char *const *rows, int nrows,
156:                        int x, int y, int scale, const SpritePalette *pal,
157:                        int npal) {
158:  for (int ry = 0; ry < nrows; ry++) {
159:    const char *row = rows[ry];
160:    for (int cx = 0; row[cx]; cx++) {
161:      char c = row[cx];
162:      if (c == ' ')
163:        continue;
164:      for (int p = 0; p < npal; p++) {
165:        if (pal[p].ch == c) {
166:          fillblock(s, x + cx * scale, y + ry * scale, scale, scale, pal[p].r,
167:                    pal[p].g, pal[p].b);
168:          break;
169:        }
170:      }
171:    }
172:  }
173:}

231:static const char *DIGIT_ART[10][5] = {
232:    {"111", "101", "101", "101", "111"}, {"010", "110", "010", "010", "111"},
233:    {"111", "001", "111", "100", "111"}, {"111", "001", "111", "001", "111"},
234:    {"101", "101", "111", "001", "001"}, {"111", "100", "111", "001", "111"},
235:    {"111", "100", "111", "101", "111"}, {"111", "001", "001", "001", "001"},
236:    {"111", "101", "111", "101", "111"}, {"111", "101", "111", "001", "111"}};
