238:static void draw_number(SDL_Surface *s, long value, int x, int y, int scale,
239:                        Uint8 r, Uint8 g, Uint8 b) {
240:  char buf[12];
241:  int n = 0;
242:  if (value < 0)
243:    value = 0;
244:  if (value == 0) {
245:    buf[n++] = '0';
246:  } else {
247:    while (value > 0 && n < 11) {
248:      buf[n++] = (char)('0' + (value % 10));
249:      value /= 10;
250:    }
251:  }
252:  for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
253:    char t = buf[i];
254:    buf[i] = buf[n - 1 - i];
255:    buf[n - 1 - i] = t;
256:  }
257:  SpritePalette pal[1] = {{'1', r, g, b}};
258:  int cursor = x;
259:  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
260:    int d = buf[i] - '0';
261:    draw_sprite(s, DIGIT_ART[d], 5, cursor, y, scale, pal, 1);
262:    cursor += 4 * scale;
263:  }
264:}

383:/* Removes an enemy and keeps the two "how many are still around" counters
384: * (wave_alive for the scripted wave, meteor_alive for the ambient hazard)
385: * in sync no matter which code path killed it. */
386:static void enemy_remove(Enemy *e) {
387:  if (!e->active)
388:    return;
389:  e->active = 0;
390:  if (e->type == ETYPE_METEOR)
391:    meteor_alive--;
392:  else
393:    wave_alive--;
394:}

396:static void start_wave(void) {
397:  boss_level = (level % 5 == 0);
398:  spawned = 0;
399:  wave_alive = 0;
400:  spawn_timer = 30;
401:  if (boss_level) {
402:    to_spawn = 3; /* two escorts, then the boss */
403:    spawn_interval = 60;
404:  } else {
405:    to_spawn = 5 + level * 2;
406:    if (to_spawn > 22)
407:      to_spawn = 22;
408:    spawn_interval = 55 - level * 3;
409:    if (spawn_interval < 14)
410:      spawn_interval = 14;
411:  }
412:}

414:static void reset_game(void) {
415:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_ENEMIES; i++)
416:    enemies[i].active = 0;
417:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_PBULLETS; i++)
418:    pbullets[i].active = 0;
419:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_EBULLETS; i++)
420:    ebullets[i].active = 0;
421:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_POWERUPS; i++)
422:    powerups[i].active = 0;
423:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_PARTICLES; i++)
424:    particles[i].active = 0;
425:
426:  p_x = WIN_W / 2 - PLAYER_W / 2;
427:  p_y = WIN_H - PLAYER_H - 20;
428:  p_hp_max = 100;
429:  p_hp = p_hp_max;
430:  p_lives = 3;
431:  p_weapon = WPN_NORMAL;
432:  p_weapon_unlocked = 1u << WPN_NORMAL;
433:  for (int i = 0; i < WPN_COUNT; i++)
434:    p_weapon_level[i] = 1;
435:  p_bombs = 2;
436:  p_fire_cd = 0;
437:  p_invuln = 90;
438:  p_bomb_flash = 0;
439:  score = 0;
440:  enemies_killed = 0;
441:  bosses_killed = 0;
442:  meteor_alive = 0;
443:  meteor_timer = rng_range(140, 220);
444:
445:  level = 1;
446:  state = STATE_PLAYING;
447:  state_timer = 0;
448:  start_wave();
449:}

455:static void spawn_enemy_of_type(int type) {
456:  Enemy *e = NULL;
457:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_ENEMIES; i++) {
458:    if (!enemies[i].active) {
459:      e = &enemies[i];
460:      break;
461:    }
462:  }
463:  if (!e)
464:    return;
465:
466:  e->active = 1;
467:  e->type = type;
468:  e->flash = 0;
469:  e->phase = rng_range(0, 359);
470:  e->weapon = -1;
471:  e->weapon2 = -1;
472:  e->boss_variant = 0;
473:
474:  switch (type) {
475:  case ETYPE_STRAIGHT:
476:    e->w = 7 * SCALE;
477:    e->h = 6 * SCALE;
478:    e->hp_max = 10 + level;
479:    e->vy = 2 + level / 4;
480:    e->amplitude = 0;
481:    e->shoot_timer = 999999; /* never shoots */
482:    break;
483:  case ETYPE_SINE:
484:    e->w = 7 * SCALE;
485:    e->h = 7 * SCALE;
486:    e->hp_max = 14 + level;
487:    e->vy = 2 + level / 4;
488:    e->amplitude = rng_range(30, 55);
489:    e->shoot_timer = 999999;
490:    break;
491:  case ETYPE_DIVER:
492:    e->w = 7 * SCALE;
493:    e->h = 7 * SCALE;
494:    e->hp_max = 12 + level;
495:    e->vy = 3 + level / 3;
496:    e->amplitude = 0;
497:    e->shoot_timer = 999999;
498:    break;
499:  case ETYPE_SHOOTER:
500:    e->w = 9 * SCALE;
501:    e->h = 9 * SCALE;
502:    e->hp_max = 20 + level * 2;
503:    e->vy = 1 + level / 5;
504:    e->amplitude = 0;
505:    e->shoot_timer = rng_range(40, 90);
506:    break;
507:  case ETYPE_FRIGATE:
508:    e->w = 11 * SCALE;
509:    e->h = 9 * SCALE;
510:    e->hp_max = 32 + level * 3;
511:    e->vy = 1 + level / 5;
512:    e->amplitude = rng_range(20, 45);
513:    e->shoot_timer = rng_range(55, 95);
514:    break;
515:  case ETYPE_CRUISER:
516:    e->w = 15 * SCALE;
517:    e->h = 12 * SCALE;
518:    e->hp_max = 50 + level * 4;
519:    e->vy = 1;
520:    e->amplitude = 0;
521:    e->shoot_timer = rng_range(70, 115);
522:    break;
523:  case ETYPE_METEOR:
524:    e->w = rng_range(6, 9) * SCALE;
525:    e->h = e->w;
526:    e->hp_max = 12 + level;
527:    e->vy = 2 + rng_range(0, 2);
528:    e->amplitude = 0;
529:    e->shoot_timer = 999999; /* meteors never shoot */
530:    break;
531:  case ETYPE_BOSS:
532:  default:
533:    e->w = 19 * SCALE;
534:    e->h = 11 * SCALE;
535:    e->hp_max = 160 + level * 45;
536:    e->vy = 2;
537:    e->amplitude = 70;
538:    e->shoot_timer = rng_range(50, 80);
539:    break;
540:  }
541:  if (e->vy > 6 && type != ETYPE_BOSS)
542:    e->vy = 6;
543:
544:  /* Single place that decides who carries which gun: keeps the "each
545:   * enemy/boss can use a different weapon" rule to one small table instead
546:   * of scattering it across every case above. */
547:  switch (type) {
548:  case ETYPE_SHOOTER:
549:    e->weapon = (level >= 4 && rng_range(0, 99) < 50) ? WPN_MITRA : WPN_NORMAL;
550:    break;
551:  case ETYPE_FRIGATE:
552:    e->weapon = WPN_TRIPLE;
553:    break;
554:  case ETYPE_CRUISER:
555:    e->weapon = (level >= 8 && rng_range(0, 99) < 40) ? WPN_LASER : WPN_MISSILE;
556:    break;
557:  case ETYPE_BOSS: {
558:    static const int table[3][2] = {{WPN_NORMAL, WPN_TRIPLE},
559:                                    {WPN_MITRA, WPN_MISSILE},
560:                                    {WPN_LASER, WPN_TRIPLE}};
561:    int v = rng_range(0, 2);
562:    e->boss_variant = v;
563:    e->weapon = table[v][0];
564:    e->weapon2 = table[v][1];
565:    break;
566:  }
567:  default:
568:    break; /* fighters and meteors stay weapon = -1 (never shoot) */
569:  }
570:
571:  e->hp = e->hp_max;
572:  e->base_x = rng_range(10, WIN_W - e->w - 10);
573:  e->x = e->base_x;
574:  e->y = -e->h;
575:  if (type == ETYPE_METEOR)
576:    meteor_alive++;
577:  else
578:    wave_alive++;
579:}
580:
581:static int pick_normal_type(void) {
582:  /* Higher levels weight the pool towards nastier types; astronavi only
583:   * start appearing once the player has had a few levels to get a weapon
584:   * or two upgraded. */
585:  int roll = rng_range(0, 99);
586:
587:  int cruiser_chance = (level >= 6) ? (5 + (level - 6) * 2) : 0;
588:  if (cruiser_chance > 20)
589:    cruiser_chance = 20;
590:  int frigate_chance = (level >= 3) ? (8 + (level - 3) * 2) : 0;
591:  if (frigate_chance > 28)
592:    frigate_chance = 28;
593:  int shooter_chance = 10 + level * 2;
594:  int diver_chance = 15 + level * 2;
595:  if (shooter_chance > 30)
596:    shooter_chance = 30;
597:  if (diver_chance > 30)
598:    diver_chance = 30;
599:
600:  if (roll < cruiser_chance)
601:    return ETYPE_CRUISER;
602:  roll -= cruiser_chance;
603:  if (roll < frigate_chance)
604:    return ETYPE_FRIGATE;
605:  roll -= frigate_chance;
606:  if (roll < shooter_chance)
607:    return ETYPE_SHOOTER;
608:  roll -= shooter_chance;
609:  if (roll < diver_chance)
610:    return ETYPE_DIVER;
611:  roll -= diver_chance;
612:  if (roll < 35)
613:    return ETYPE_SINE;
614:  return ETYPE_STRAIGHT;
615:}

617:static void spawn_powerup(int x, int y) {
618:  int roll = rng_range(0, 99);
619:  int type = (roll < 35) ? PU_WEAPON : (roll < 80 ? PU_HEALTH : PU_BOMB);
620:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_POWERUPS; i++) {
621:    if (!powerups[i].active) {
622:      powerups[i].active = 1;
623:      powerups[i].x = x;
624:      powerups[i].y = y;
625:      powerups[i].vy = 2;
626:      powerups[i].type = type;
627:      break;
628:    }
629:  }
630:}

636:static int aabb(int ax, int ay, int aw, int ah, int bx, int by, int bw,
637:                int bh) {
638:  return ax < bx + bw && ax + aw > bx && ay < by + bh && ay + ah > by;
639:}

660:static void spawn_ebullet(int x, int y, int vx, int vy, int dmg, int wtype,
661:                          int homing) {
662:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_EBULLETS; i++) {
663:    if (!ebullets[i].active) {
664:      ebullets[i].active = 1;
665:      ebullets[i].x = x;
666:      ebullets[i].y = y;
667:      ebullets[i].vx = vx;
668:      ebullets[i].vy = vy;
669:      ebullets[i].dmg = dmg;
670:      ebullets[i].from_player = 0;
671:      ebullets[i].wtype = wtype;
672:      ebullets[i].pierce = 0;
673:      ebullets[i].homing = homing;
674:      return;
675:    }
676:  }
677:}
678:
679:/* Every weapon family the player can carry, gated by its current power
680: * level (1-3 from PU_WEAPON pickups). */
681:static void fire_player_bullets(void) {
682:  int cx = p_x + PLAYER_W / 2;
683:  int top = p_y - 2;
684:  int lvl = p_weapon_level[p_weapon];
685:
686:  switch (p_weapon) {
687:  case WPN_NORMAL: {
688:    static const int offs1[1] = {0};
689:    static const int offs2[2] = {-4, 4};
690:    static const int offs3[3] = {-7, 0, 7};
691:    const int *offs = (lvl == 1) ? offs1 : (lvl == 2) ? offs2 : offs3;
692:    for (int i = 0; i < lvl; i++)
693:      spawn_pbullet(cx + offs[i], top, 0, -9, 9 + lvl * 2, WPN_NORMAL, 0, 0);
694:    break;
695:  }
696:  case WPN_TRIPLE: {
697:    int n = (lvl >= 3) ? 5 : 3;
698:    static const int offs5[5] = {-16, -8, 0, 8, 16};
699:    static const int vxs5[5] = {-3, -2, 0, 2, 3};
700:    static const int offs3[3] = {-8, 0, 8};
701:    static const int vxs3[3] = {-2, 0, 2};
702:    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
703:      int off = (n == 5) ? offs5[i] : offs3[i];
704:      int vx = (n == 5) ? vxs5[i] : vxs3[i];
705:      spawn_pbullet(cx + off, top, vx, -9, 6 + lvl, WPN_TRIPLE, 0, 0);
706:    }
707:    break;
708:  }
709:  case WPN_MITRA: {
710:    int side = ((frame_count / 3) & 1) ? -5 : 5;
711:    spawn_pbullet(cx + side, top, 0, -12, 4 + lvl, WPN_MITRA, 0, 0);
712:    break;
713:  }
714:  case WPN_LASER:
715:    spawn_pbullet(cx - 1, top, 0, -14, 7 + lvl * 2, WPN_LASER, 1 + lvl, 0);
716:    break;
717:  case WPN_MISSILE:
718:    spawn_pbullet(cx - 1, top, 0, -6, 16 + lvl * 4, WPN_MISSILE, 0, 1);
719:    break;
720:  }
721:}
722:
723:/* Mirror of fire_player_bullets for anything hostile that shoots. One
724: * switch covers every enemy type - fighters/frigate/cruiser/boss all just
725: * pass in whichever WPN_* they were assigned at spawn time. */
726:static void enemy_fire_weapon(Enemy *e, int weapon) {
727:  int ex = e->x + e->w / 2;
728:  int ey = e->y + e->h;
729:  int px_c = p_x + PLAYER_W / 2;
730:  int aim_vx = 0;
731:  if (px_c < ex - 4)
732:    aim_vx = -1;
733:  else if (px_c > ex + 4)
734:    aim_vx = 1;
735:
736:  switch (weapon) {
737:  case WPN_TRIPLE:
738:    spawn_ebullet(ex - 8, ey, -2, 5, 10, WPN_TRIPLE, 0);
739:    spawn_ebullet(ex - 1, ey, 0, 6, 10, WPN_TRIPLE, 0);
740:    spawn_ebullet(ex + 7, ey, 2, 5, 10, WPN_TRIPLE, 0);
741:    break;
742:  case WPN_MITRA:
743:    spawn_ebullet(ex - 5, ey, aim_vx, 7, 6, WPN_MITRA, 0);
744:    spawn_ebullet(ex + 4, ey, aim_vx, 7, 6, WPN_MITRA, 0);
745:    break;
746:  case WPN_LASER:
747:    spawn_ebullet(ex - 1, ey, 0, 8, 14, WPN_LASER, 0);
748:    break;
749:  case WPN_MISSILE:
750:    spawn_ebullet(ex - 2, ey, aim_vx, 4, 18, WPN_MISSILE, 1);
751:    break;
752:  case WPN_NORMAL:
753:  default:
754:    spawn_ebullet(ex - 1, ey, aim_vx, 5, 10, WPN_NORMAL, 0);
755:    break;
756:  }
757:}
758:
759:static void do_bomb(void) {
760:  if (p_bombs <= 0)
761:    return;
762:  p_bombs--;
763:  p_bomb_flash = 20;
764:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_EBULLETS; i++)
765:    ebullets[i].active = 0;
766:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_ENEMIES; i++) {
767:    if (!enemies[i].active)
768:      continue;
769:    spawn_particles(enemies[i].x + enemies[i].w / 2,
770:                    enemies[i].y + enemies[i].h / 2, 6, 255, 220, 120);
771:    if (enemies[i].type == ETYPE_BOSS) {
772:      enemies[i].hp -= enemies[i].hp_max / 4;
773:    } else {
774:      enemies[i].hp = 0;
775:      enemy_remove(&enemies[i]);
776:    }
777:  }
778:}
779:
780:static void update_player(const Uint8 *keys) {
781:  int speed = 4;
782:  if (keys[SDL_SCANCODE_LEFT])
783:    p_x -= speed;
784:  if (keys[SDL_SCANCODE_RIGHT])
785:    p_x += speed;
786:  if (keys[SDL_SCANCODE_UP])
787:    p_y -= speed;
788:  if (keys[SDL_SCANCODE_DOWN])
789:    p_y += speed;
790:
791:  if (p_x < 4)
792:    p_x = 4;
793:  if (p_x > WIN_W - PLAYER_W - 4)
794:    p_x = WIN_W - PLAYER_W - 4;
795:  if (p_y < WIN_H / 2 - 20)
796:    p_y = WIN_H / 2 - 20;
797:  if (p_y > WIN_H - PLAYER_H - 10)
798:    p_y = WIN_H - PLAYER_H - 10;
799:
800:  if (p_fire_cd > 0)
801:    p_fire_cd--;
802:  if (keys[SDL_SCANCODE_SPACE] && p_fire_cd == 0) {
803:    fire_player_bullets();
804:    p_fire_cd = WPN_COOLDOWN[p_weapon] - (p_weapon_level[p_weapon] - 1);
805:    if (p_fire_cd < 3)
806:      p_fire_cd = 3;
807:  }
808:
809:  if (p_invuln > 0)
810:    p_invuln--;
811:  if (p_bomb_flash > 0)
812:    p_bomb_flash--;
813:}
814:
815:static void apply_powerup(int type) {
816:  if (type == PU_WEAPON) {
817:    /* Upgrades whichever weapon is currently selected, so switching guns
818:     * with the number keys is a real choice about where to invest. */
819:    if (p_weapon_level[p_weapon] < 3) {
820:      p_weapon_level[p_weapon]++;
821:      score += 50;
822:    } else {
823:      score += 120; /* maxed out already: convert into bonus points */
824:    }
825:  } else if (type == PU_HEALTH) {
826:    p_hp += 30;
827:    if (p_hp > p_hp_max)
828:      p_hp = p_hp_max;
829:    score += 30;
830:  } else {
831:    p_bombs++;
832:    score += 40;
833:  }
834:}
835:
836:static void player_take_hit(int dmg) {
837:  if (p_invuln > 0)
838:    return;
839:  p_hp -= dmg;
840:  p_invuln = 55;
841:  if (p_hp <= 0) {
842:    p_lives--;
843:    spawn_particles(p_x + PLAYER_W / 2, p_y + PLAYER_H / 2, 20, 255, 200, 90);
844:    if (p_lives > 0) {
845:      p_hp = p_hp_max;
846:      p_invuln = 110;
847:    } else {
848:      state = STATE_GAMEOVER;
849:      state_timer = 0;
850:    }
851:  }
852:}
853:
854:/* Central "an enemy just died" handler: scoring, kill counters, particle
855: * burst, powerup drop chance and (for bosses) the weapon-unlock message
856: * all live here so bullets, missile splash damage and body-collisions all
857: * behave identically instead of duplicating the bookkeeping three times. */
858:static void on_enemy_killed(Enemy *e) {
859:  int type = e->type;
860:  int ex = e->x + e->w / 2;
861:  int ey = e->y + e->h / 2;
862:  enemy_remove(e);
863:
864:  long reward = (type == ETYPE_BOSS)
865:                    ? 500
866:                    : (type == ETYPE_METEOR ? 15 + level * 2 : 25 + level * 3);
867:  score += reward;
868:
869:  if (type == ETYPE_BOSS)
870:    bosses_killed++;
871:  else if (type != ETYPE_METEOR)
872:    enemies_killed++;
873:
874:  spawn_particles(ex, ey,
875:                  type == ETYPE_BOSS ? 40 : (type == ETYPE_METEOR ? 10 : 14),
876:                  255, 160, 60);
877:
878:  if (type != ETYPE_BOSS) {
879:    int drop = (type == ETYPE_METEOR) ? 55 : 22; /* meteors are generous */
880:    if (rng_range(0, 99) < drop)
881:      spawn_powerup(ex, ey);
882:  }
883:
884:  if (type == ETYPE_BOSS) {
885:    char msg[64];
886:    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "Boss sconfitto! Punteggio %ld", score);
887:    OS1_notify_post("NexRaptor", msg);
888:    if (bosses_killed < WPN_COUNT) {
889:      p_weapon_unlocked |= (1u << bosses_killed);
890:      char m2[64];
891:      snprintf(m2, sizeof(m2), "Nuova arma sbloccata: %s!",
892:               WEAPON_NAMES[bosses_killed]);
893:      OS1_notify_post("NexRaptor", m2);
894:    }
895:  }
896:}
897:
898:static void update_world(void) {
899:  frame_count++;
900:
901:  /* Wave spawning (scripted: to_spawn enemies, boss at the end of a boss
902:   * level). */
903:  if (spawned < to_spawn) {
904:    spawn_timer--;
905:    if (spawn_timer <= 0) {
906:      int type;
907:      if (boss_level && spawned == to_spawn - 1) {
908:        type = ETYPE_BOSS;
909:        char msg[64];
910:        snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "Livello %d: attenzione, arriva un boss!",
911:                 level);
912:        OS1_notify_post("NexRaptor", msg);
913:      } else if (boss_level) {
914:        type = rng_range(0, 1) ? ETYPE_SINE : ETYPE_STRAIGHT; /* escorts */
915:      } else {
916:        type = pick_normal_type();
917:      }
918:      spawn_enemy_of_type(type);
919:      spawned++;
920:      spawn_timer = spawn_interval;
921:    }
922:  }
923:
924:  /* Meteors: an independent, always-on hazard/bonus stream, not part of
925:   * the scripted wave (so it never blocks a level from clearing). */
926:  if (state == STATE_PLAYING) {
927:    meteor_timer--;
928:    if (meteor_timer <= 0) {
929:      spawn_enemy_of_type(ETYPE_METEOR);
930:      int cooldown = 220 - level * 4;
931:      if (cooldown < 70)
932:        cooldown = 70;
933:      meteor_timer = rng_range(cooldown, cooldown + 90);
934:    }
935:  }
936:
937:  /* Enemies */
938:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_ENEMIES; i++) {
939:    Enemy *e = &enemies[i];
940:    if (!e->active)
941:      continue;
942:
943:    if (e->flash > 0)
944:      e->flash--;
945:
946:    if (e->type == ETYPE_BOSS) {
947:      if (e->y < 40) {
948:        e->y += e->vy;
949:      } else {
950:        e->phase = (e->phase + 2) % 360;
951:        int sinv = sin_fp(DEG_TO_FP_RAD(e->phase));
952:        int offset = (e->amplitude * sinv) >> FP_SHIFT;
953:        e->x = e->base_x + offset;
954:      }
955:      e->shoot_timer--;
956:      if (e->shoot_timer <= 0) {
957:        /* Alternates between its two weapon families every ~3 seconds. */
958:        int active_wpn = ((frame_count / 180) & 1) ? e->weapon2 : e->weapon;
959:        enemy_fire_weapon(e, active_wpn);
960:        e->shoot_timer = rng_range(35, 65);
961:      }
962:    } else {
963:      e->y += e->vy;
964:      if (e->amplitude != 0) {
965:        e->phase = (e->phase + 5) % 360;
966:        int sinv = sin_fp(DEG_TO_FP_RAD(e->phase));
967:        int offset = (e->amplitude * sinv) >> FP_SHIFT;
968:        e->x = e->base_x + offset;
969:      } else if (e->type == ETYPE_DIVER) {
970:        int px_c = p_x + PLAYER_W / 2;
971:        int ex_c = e->x + e->w / 2;
972:        if (px_c < ex_c)
973:          e->x -= 2;
974:        else if (px_c > ex_c)
975:          e->x += 2;
976:      }
977:      if (e->type == ETYPE_SHOOTER || e->type == ETYPE_FRIGATE ||
978:          e->type == ETYPE_CRUISER) {
979:        e->shoot_timer--;
980:        if (e->shoot_timer <= 0) {
981:          enemy_fire_weapon(e, e->weapon);
982:          e->shoot_timer = rng_range(50, 100 - level);
983:          if (e->shoot_timer < 30)
984:            e->shoot_timer = 30;
985:        }
986:      }
987:    }
988:
989:    if (e->x < 0)
990:      e->x = 0;
991:    if (e->x > WIN_W - e->w)
992:      e->x = WIN_W - e->w;
993:
994:    if (e->y > WIN_H + 20) {
995:      enemy_remove(e);
996:      continue;
997:    }
998:
999:    /* Body collision with player */
1000:    if (p_invuln == 0 &&
1001:        aabb(p_x, p_y, PLAYER_W, PLAYER_H, e->x, e->y, e->w, e->h)) {
1002:      if (e->type == ETYPE_BOSS) {
1003:        player_take_hit(25);
1004:      } else {
1005:        int dmg = (e->type == ETYPE_METEOR) ? 20 : 15;
1006:        player_take_hit(dmg);
1007:        e->hp = 0;
1008:        on_enemy_killed(e);
1009:      }
1010:    }
1011:  }
1012:
1013:  /* Player bullets */
1014:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_PBULLETS; i++) {
1015:    Bullet *b = &pbullets[i];
1016:    if (!b->active)
1017:      continue;
1018:
1019:    if (b->homing) {
1020:      /* Missiles gently steer toward the nearest enemy ahead of them. */
1021:      int bestd = 0x7fffffff, bx = 0;
1022:      int found = 0;
1023:      for (int j = 0; j < MAX_ENEMIES; j++) {
1024:        if (!enemies[j].active)
1025:          continue;
1026:        int ex = enemies[j].x + enemies[j].w / 2;
1027:        int ey = enemies[j].y + enemies[j].h / 2;
1028:        int dy = ey - b->y;
1029:        if (dy > 4)
1030:          continue; /* only steer toward targets ahead (above the bullet) */
1031:        int dx = ex - b->x;
1032:        int d = dx * dx + dy * dy;
1033:        if (d < bestd) {
1034:          bestd = d;
1035:          bx = dx;
1036:          found = 1;
1037:        }
1038:      }
1039:      if (found) {
1040:        if (bx < -2)
1041:          b->vx--;
1042:        else if (bx > 2)
1043:          b->vx++;
1044:        if (b->vx > 4)
1045:          b->vx = 4;
1046:        if (b->vx < -4)
1047:          b->vx = -4;
1048:      }
1049:    }
1050:
1051:    b->x += b->vx;
1052:    b->y += b->vy;
1053:    if (b->y < -10) {
1054:      b->active = 0;
1055:      continue;
1056:    }
1057:    for (int j = 0; j < MAX_ENEMIES; j++) {
1058:      Enemy *e = &enemies[j];
1059:      if (!e->active || e->hp <= 0)
1060:        continue;
1061:      if (aabb(b->x, b->y, 3, 8, e->x, e->y, e->w, e->h)) {
1062:        e->hp -= b->dmg;
1063:        e->flash = 4;
1064:        spawn_particles(b->x, b->y, 3, 255, 255, 160);
1065:
1066:        if (b->wtype == WPN_MISSILE) {
1067:          /* Splash damage: half the direct hit, to anything else nearby. */
1068:          spawn_particles(b->x, b->y, 10, 255, 170, 60);
1069:          for (int k = 0; k < MAX_ENEMIES; k++) {
1070:            if (k == j)
1071:              continue;
1072:            Enemy *e2 = &enemies[k];
1073:            if (!e2->active || e2->hp <= 0)
1074:              continue;
1075:            int ddx = (e2->x + e2->w / 2) - (e->x + e->w / 2);
1076:            int ddy = (e2->y + e2->h / 2) - (e->y + e->h / 2);
1077:            if (ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy < 42 * 42) {
1078:              e2->hp -= b->dmg / 2;
1079:              e2->flash = 4;
1080:              if (e2->hp <= 0)
1081:                on_enemy_killed(e2);
1082:            }
1083:          }
1084:        }
1085:
1086:        if (b->pierce > 0)
1087:          b->pierce--;
1088:        else
1089:          b->active = 0;
1090:
1091:        if (e->hp <= 0)
1092:          on_enemy_killed(e);
1093:        break;
1094:      }
1095:    }
1096:  }
1097:
1098:  /* Enemy bullets */
1099:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_EBULLETS; i++) {
1100:    Bullet *b = &ebullets[i];
1101:    if (!b->active)
1102:      continue;
1103:    if (b->homing) {
1104:      int px_c = p_x + PLAYER_W / 2;
1105:      if (b->x < px_c - 2)
1106:        b->vx++;
1107:      else if (b->x > px_c + 2)
1108:        b->vx--;
1109:      if (b->vx > 3)
1110:        b->vx = 3;
1111:      if (b->vx < -3)
1112:        b->vx = -3;
1113:    }
1114:    b->x += b->vx;
1115:    b->y += b->vy;
1116:    if (b->y > WIN_H + 10) {
1117:      b->active = 0;
1118:      continue;
1119:    }
1120:    if (aabb(b->x, b->y, 3, 8, p_x, p_y, PLAYER_W, PLAYER_H)) {
1121:      b->active = 0;
1122:      player_take_hit(b->dmg);
1123:    }
1124:  }
1125:
1126:  /* Powerups */
1127:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_POWERUPS; i++) {
1128:    Powerup *pu = &powerups[i];
1129:    if (!pu->active)
1130:      continue;
1131:    pu->y += pu->vy;
1132:    if (pu->y > WIN_H + 10) {
1133:      pu->active = 0;
1134:      continue;
1135:    }
1136:    if (aabb(pu->x, pu->y, 5 * SCALE, 5 * SCALE, p_x, p_y, PLAYER_W,
1137:             PLAYER_H)) {
1138:      apply_powerup(pu->type);
1139:      pu->active = 0;
1140:    }
1141:  }
1142:
1143:  /* Particles */
1144:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_PARTICLES; i++) {
1145:    Particle *pt = &particles[i];
1146:    if (!pt->active)
1147:      continue;
1148:    pt->x += pt->vx;
1149:    pt->y += pt->vy;
1150:    pt->life--;
1151:    if (pt->life <= 0)
1152:      pt->active = 0;
1153:  }
1154:
1155:  /* Level progress (meteors never gate this, only the scripted wave) */
1156:  if (spawned >= to_spawn && wave_alive <= 0 && state == STATE_PLAYING) {
1157:    score += 100 + level * 10;
1158:    if (level % 5 == 0)
1159:      p_bombs++;
1160:    state = STATE_LEVEL_CLEAR;
1161:    state_timer = 90;
1162:    char msg[64];
1163:    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "Livello %d superato! Punteggio %ld", level,
1164:             score);
1165:    OS1_notify_post("NexRaptor", msg);
1166:  }
1167:}

1173:static void render_background(SDL_Surface *surf) {
1174:  Uint32 *pixels = (Uint32 *)surf->pixels;
1175:  int pitch_px = surf->pitch / 4;
1176:  for (int y = 0; y < WIN_H; y++) {
1177:    int t = (y * 40) / WIN_H; /* 0..40 */
1178:    Uint8 r = (Uint8)(6 + t / 4);
1179:    Uint8 g = (Uint8)(6 + t / 6);
1180:    Uint8 b = (Uint8)(22 + t);
1181:    Uint32 col = 0xFF000000u | ((Uint32)r << 16) | ((Uint32)g << 8) | b;
1182:    for (int x = 0; x < WIN_W; x++)
1183:      pixels[y * pitch_px + x] = col;
1184:  }
1185:  for (int i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
1186:    Star *s = &stars[i];
1187:    Uint8 shade = (Uint8)(90 + s->layer * 60);
1188:    int size = (s->layer == 2) ? 2 : 1;
1189:    if (s->x >= 0 && s->x < WIN_W - size && s->y >= 0 && s->y < WIN_H - size)
1190:      fillblock(surf, s->x, s->y, size, size, shade, shade, shade);
1191:  }
1192:}
1193:
1194:static void update_stars(void) {
1195:  static const int speeds[3] = {1, 2, 3};
1196:  for (int i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
1197:    stars[i].y += speeds[stars[i].layer];
1198:    if (stars[i].y >= WIN_H) {
1199:      stars[i].y = 0;
1200:      stars[i].x = rng_range(0, WIN_W - 1);
1201:    }
1202:  }
1203:}
1204:
1205:static void render_hud(SDL_Surface *surf) {
1206:  /* Health bar */
1207:  int barw = 110, barh = 8;
1208:  fillblock(surf, 8, 6, barw + 2, barh + 2, 40, 40, 50);
1209:  int hp_w = (p_hp * barw) / p_hp_max;
1210:  Uint8 hr = (Uint8)(p_hp < 30 ? 230 : (p_hp < 60 ? 220 : 60));
1211:  Uint8 hg = (Uint8)(p_hp < 30 ? 50 : (p_hp < 60 ? 200 : 210));
1212:  fillblock(surf, 9, 7, hp_w, barh, hr, hg, 70);

1412:int main(void) {
1413:  int pid = get_pid();
1414:  rng_state = (unsigned int)get_time() ^ (unsigned int)(pid * 2654435761u);
1415:  if (rng_state == 0)
1416:    rng_state = 0x9e3779b9u;
1417:
1418:  if (SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO) != 0) {
1419:    printf("[NexRaptor] SDL_Init failed: %s\n", SDL_GetError());
1420:    exit(1);
1421:  }
1422:
1423:  char title[64];
1424:  sprintf(title, "NexRaptor PID %d", pid);
1425:  SDL_Window *window = SDL_CreateWindow(title, 60, 60, WIN_W, WIN_H, 0);
1426:  if (!window) {
1427:    printf("[NexRaptor] SDL_CreateWindow failed: %s\n", SDL_GetError());
1428:    SDL_Quit();
1429:    exit(1);
1430:  }
1431:
1432:  SDL_Surface *surface = SDL_GetWindowSurface(window);
1433:  if (!surface) {
1434:    OS1_notify_error("NexRaptor", SDL_GetError());
1435:    SDL_DestroyWindow(window);
1436:    SDL_Quit();
1437:    exit(1);
1438:  }
1439:
1440:  /* Persistent high score, kept in the OS registry - the whole point of
1441:   * the easter egg is that it remembers you across reboots. */
1442:  char regbuf[32];
1443:  int rn = OS1_registry_get("raptor.highscore", regbuf, sizeof(regbuf));
1444:  high_score = (rn > 0) ? atoi(regbuf) : 0;
1445:
1446:  init_stars();
1447:  reset_game();
1448:
1449:  char msg[64];
1450:  snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "NexRaptor avviato! Record: %ld", high_score);
1451:  OS1_notify_post("NexRaptor", msg);
1452:
1453:  int running = 1;
1454:  int bomb_edge = 0;
1455:  int restart_edge = 0;
1456:  int weapon_select = -1;
1457:
1458:  Uint64 fps_last_ms = SDL_GetTicks64();
1459:  int fps_frames = 0;
1460:
1461:  while (running) {
1462:    SDL_Event event;
1463:    while (SDL_PollEvent(&event)) {
1464:      if (event.type == SDL_QUIT)
1465:        running = 0;
1466:      if (event.type == SDL_WINDOWEVENT &&
1467:          event.window.event == SDL_WINDOWEVENT_SIZE_CHANGED) {
1468:        surface = SDL_GetWindowSurface(window);
1469:        if (!surface) {
1470:          OS1_notify_error("NexRaptor", SDL_GetError());
1471:          running = 0;
1472:        }
1473:      }
1474:      if (event.type == SDL_KEYDOWN) {
1475:        SDL_Scancode sc = event.key.keysym.scancode;
1476:        if (sc == SDL_SCANCODE_ESCAPE)
1477:          running = 0;
1478:        if (sc == SDL_SCANCODE_X || sc == SDL_SCANCODE_LCTRL)
1479:          bomb_edge = 1;
1480:        if (sc == SDL_SCANCODE_R && state == STATE_GAMEOVER)
1481:          restart_edge = 1;
1482:        if (sc >= SDL_SCANCODE_1 && sc <= SDL_SCANCODE_5)
1483:          weapon_select = sc - SDL_SCANCODE_1;
1484:      }
1485:    }
1486:    if (!running)
1487:      break;
1488:
1489:    if (weapon_select >= 0 && weapon_select < WPN_COUNT &&
1490:        (p_weapon_unlocked & (1u << weapon_select)))
1491:      p_weapon = weapon_select;
1492:    weapon_select = -1;
1493:
1494:    const Uint8 *keys = SDL_GetKeyboardState(NULL);
1495:
1496:    if (state == STATE_PLAYING) {
1497:      update_player(keys);
1498:      if (bomb_edge) {
1499:        do_bomb();
1500:      }
1501:      update_world();
1502:      update_stars();
1503:    } else if (state == STATE_LEVEL_CLEAR) {
1504:      update_stars();
1505:      for (int i = 0; i < MAX_PARTICLES; i++) {
1506:        Particle *pt = &particles[i];
1507:        if (pt->active) {
1508:          pt->x += pt->vx;
1509:          pt->y += pt->vy;
1510:          pt->life--;
1511:          if (pt->life <= 0)
1512:            pt->active = 0;
1513:        }
1514:      }
1515:      state_timer--;
1516:      if (state_timer <= 0) {
1517:        level++;
1518:        state = STATE_PLAYING;
1519:        p_invuln = 60;
1520:        start_wave();
1521:      }
1522:    } else { /* STATE_GAMEOVER */
1523:      update_stars();
1524:      if (state_timer == 0) {
1525:        if (score > high_score) {
1526:          high_score = score;
1527:          char buf[16];
1528:          snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%ld", high_score);
1529:          OS1_registry_set("raptor.highscore", buf);
1530:          char m2[64];
1531:          snprintf(m2, sizeof(m2), "Nuovo record! %ld punti", high_score);
1532:          OS1_notify_post("NexRaptor", m2);
1533:        } else {
1534:          char m2[64];
1535:          snprintf(m2, sizeof(m2), "Game Over - Punteggio %ld (Record %ld)",
1536:                   score, high_score);
1537:          OS1_notify_post("NexRaptor", m2);
1538:        }
1539:      }
1540:      state_timer++;
1541:      if (restart_edge) {
1542:        reset_game();
1543:      }
1544:    }
1545:
1546:    bomb_edge = 0;
1547:    restart_edge = 0;
1548:
1549:    render(surface);
1550:
1551:    if (SDL_UpdateWindowSurface(window) != 0) {
1552:      surface = SDL_GetWindowSurface(window);
1553:      if (!surface) {
1554:        OS1_notify_error("NexRaptor", SDL_GetError());
1555:        running = 0;
1556:      }
1557:    }
1558:
1559:    /* FPS counter: recomputed once a second from real elapsed time via the
1560:     * NexsOS SDL timer backend, independent of the fixed ~60Hz frame pacing
1561:     * below so it reflects actual throughput, not the target rate. */
1562:    fps_frames++;
1563:    Uint64 now_ms = SDL_GetTicks64();
1564:    if (now_ms - fps_last_ms >= 1000) {
1565:      fps_value = fps_frames;
1566:      fps_frames = 0;
1567:      fps_last_ms = now_ms;
1568:    }
1569:
1570:    SDL_Delay(16); /* ~60 FPS via the NexsOS SDL timer backend */
1571:  }
1572:
1573:  SDL_DestroyWindow(window);
1574:  SDL_Quit();
1575:  exit(0);
1576:  return 0;
1577:}

@@@ user/bin/sandboxchild.c @@@
1:/*
2: * user/bin/sandboxchild.c
3: * Guest worker for the sandbox test (USR-SEC-03 #79).
4: *
5: * Spawned by /bin/sandboxtest at PLVL_GUEST (capabilities = CAP_WINDOW only).
6: * It attempts each gated syscall and prints the outcome to the serial console
7: * (printf always reaches the UART) tagged "[sandbox]", so the headless test
8: * harness can grep the results.  Expected:
9: *   - spawn()                  -> denied (no CAP_SPAWN)
10: *   - open(.., O_WRONLY)       -> denied (no CAP_FS_WRITE)
11: *   - send() to a non-relative -> denied (no CAP_IPC_ANY)
12: *   - create_window()          -> allowed (guest HAS CAP_WINDOW)
13: */
14:#include <fcntl.h>
15:#include <os1.h>
16:
17:static int failures = 0;
18:
19:/* expect_neg: the op must be refused (negative errno). */
20:static void expect_neg(const char *name, long rc) {
21:  int ok = (rc < 0);
22:  printf("[sandbox] %s rc=%ld -> %s\n", name, rc, ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL");
23:  if (!ok)
24:    failures++;
25:}
26:
27:/* expect_ok: the op must succeed (>= 0). */
28:static void expect_ok(const char *name, long rc) {
29:  int ok = (rc >= 0);
30:  printf("[sandbox] %s rc=%ld -> %s\n", name, rc, ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL");
31:  if (!ok)
32:    failures++;
33:}
34:
35:int main(void) {
36:  printf("[sandbox] child PID %d running as guest\n", get_pid());
37:
38:  /* CAP_SPAWN: denied. */
39:  expect_neg("spawn", spawn("/bin/counter"));
40:
41:  /* CAP_FS_WRITE: opening a writable config file for write is denied. */
42:  expect_neg("open-wronly", open("/etc/init.cfg", O_WRONLY));
43:
44:  /* CAP_IPC_ANY: messaging a non-relative (init, PID 1 — an ancestor above
45:   * our parent, so neither parent nor descendant) is denied. */
46:  struct ipc_message m;
47:  m.type = 1;
48:  m.data1 = 0;
49:  m.data2 = 0;
50:  m.payload[0] = '\0';
51:  expect_neg("send-nonrelative", send(1, &m));
52:
53:  /* CAP_WINDOW: guests may draw — this must succeed. */
54:  expect_ok("create-window", create_window(60, 60, 200, 80, "Guest"));
55:
56:  printf("[sandbox] child done: %d failure(s)\n", failures);
57:
58:  while (1)
59:    yield();
60:  return 0;
61:}
62:

@@@ user/bin/sandboxtest.c @@@
1:/*
2: * user/bin/sandboxtest.c
3: * Privilege-level / capability test driver (USR-SEC-03 #79).
4: *
5: * Runs as a normal PLVL_USER process (spawned by the shell, full caps) and
6: * spawns /bin/sandboxchild at PLVL_GUEST.  The child reports, on the serial
7: * console tagged "[sandbox]", that spawn / file-write / non-relative IPC are
8: * all denied while window creation is allowed.
9: *
10: * This single child proves two things at once:
11: *   - the per-surface capability gates work (the denials), and
12: *   - the level ceiling clamp works: spawn_level() requests CAP_ALL, but the
13: *     kernel clamps it to level_ceiling[GUEST] = CAP_WINDOW, so the guest can
14: *     ONLY draw.  (The "never more privileged than the creator" clamp shares
15: *     the same expression in process_create_caps; observing it from userland
16: *     would need a caps-readback syscall, out of scope for B3.)
17: *
18: * The headless harness greps "[sandbox]".
19: */
20:#include <os1.h>
21:
22:int main(void) {
23:  int win = create_window(140, 140, 360, 160, "Sandbox Test");
24:  printf("[sandbox] driver PID %d (user)\n", get_pid());
25:
26:  /* Spawning is allowed for us (we hold CAP_SPAWN); the CHILD is stripped of
27:   * everything but CAP_WINDOW by the guest ceiling. */
28:  long pid = spawn_level("/bin/sandboxchild", PLVL_GUEST);
29:  if (pid > 0) {
30:    printf("[sandbox] spawned guest child PID %ld -> PASS\n", pid);
31:    if (win >= 0)
32:      printf_win(win, "spawned guest PID %ld\n", pid);
33:  } else {
34:    printf("[sandbox] spawn_level FAILED rc=%ld\n", pid);
35:    if (win >= 0)
36:      printf_win(win, "spawn_level FAILED rc=%ld\n", pid);
37:  }
38:
39:  printf("[sandbox] driver done\n");
40:
41:  while (1)
42:    yield();
43:  return 0;
44:}
45:

1:/*
2: * user/bin/sdltest.c
3: * First SDL2 application on NexsOS: exercises the whole port end to end —
4: * libSDL2.a (cross-built, unpatched submodule) -> 'nexsos' video driver
5: * overlay -> os1_video_platform -> OS1 window/blit/input ABI.
6: *
7: * Draws a STATIC gradient with R/G/B channel squares and one moving white
8: * bar through SDL_GetWindowSurface/SDL_UpdateWindowSurface (the software
9: * framebuffer path) and quits on Escape or SDL_QUIT.  Frame pacing uses
10: * SDL_Delay via the NexsOS SDL timer backend (os1_mono_ns/_sys_nanosleep).
11: */
12:#include <os1.h>
13:
14:#include "SDL.h"
15:
16:#define TEST_W 320
17:#define TEST_H 240
18:
19:int main(void) {
20:  if (SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO) != 0) {
21:    printf("[SDLTest] SDL_Init failed: %s\n", SDL_GetError());
22:    exit(1);
23:  }
24:  printf("[SDLTest] SDL %d.%d.%d, video driver: %s\n", SDL_MAJOR_VERSION,
25:         SDL_MINOR_VERSION, SDL_PATCHLEVEL, SDL_GetCurrentVideoDriver());
26:
27:  SDL_Window *window =
28:      SDL_CreateWindow("SDL2 on NexsOS", 80, 80, TEST_W, TEST_H, 0);
29:  if (!window) {
30:    printf("[SDLTest] SDL_CreateWindow failed: %s\n", SDL_GetError());
31:    SDL_Quit();
32:    exit(1);
33:  }
34:
35:  SDL_Surface *surface = SDL_GetWindowSurface(window);
36:  if (!surface) {
37:    /* The window already exists at this point (NEXSOS_CreateWindow ->
38:     * os1_video_window_create -> the same win->buffer window_text_write
39:     * draws into) — printf() here would draw text into it instead of a
40:     * notification popup, right before destroying it. */
41:    OS1_notify_error("SDLTest", SDL_GetError());
42:    SDL_DestroyWindow(window);
43:    SDL_Quit();
44:    exit(1);
45:  }
46:
47:  int running = 1;
48:  int frame = 0;
49:  /* Current drawable size: follows compositor resizes (nxlauncher pattern:
50:   * on the resize event re-adopt the size and rebuild the buffer — in SDL
51:   * terms re-acquire the window surface, which recreates the framebuffer). */
52:  int win_w = surface->w, win_h = surface->h;
53:  /* Input-test state: crosshair follows SDL_MOUSEMOTION, the magenta square
54:   * moves with the arrow keys, clicks recolour the border (left=green,
55:   * right=red).  Everything is also logged on the serial console. */
56:  int cur_x = win_w / 2, cur_y = win_h / 2;
57:  int sq_x = win_w / 2 - 10, sq_y = win_h / 2 - 10;
58:  Uint8 border_r = 255, border_g = 255, border_b = 0;
59:  while (running) {
60:    SDL_Event event;
61:    while (SDL_PollEvent(&event)) {
62:      if (event.type == SDL_QUIT)
63:        running = 0;
64:      if (event.type == SDL_WINDOWEVENT &&
65:          event.window.event == SDL_WINDOWEVENT_SIZE_CHANGED) {
66:        /* The old surface is invalid now: re-acquire it (this recreates the
67:         * framebuffer and adopts the new OS1 logical size in the driver). */
68:        surface = SDL_GetWindowSurface(window);
69:        if (!surface) {
70:          OS1_notify_error("SDLTest", SDL_GetError());
71:          running = 0;
72:          break;
73:        }
74:        win_w = surface->w;
75:        win_h = surface->h;
76:        /* Keep the markers inside the shrunken area. */
77:        if (sq_x > win_w - 20) sq_x = win_w > 20 ? win_w - 20 : 0;
78:        if (sq_y > win_h - 20) sq_y = win_h > 20 ? win_h - 20 : 0;
79:        if (cur_x >= win_w) cur_x = win_w - 1;
80:        if (cur_y >= win_h) cur_y = win_h - 1;
81:      }
82:      if (event.type == SDL_MOUSEMOTION) {
83:        cur_x = event.motion.x;
84:        cur_y = event.motion.y;
85:      }
86:      if (event.type == SDL_MOUSEBUTTONDOWN) {
87:        /* Per-click/per-key logging was dropped entirely rather than
88:         * rerouted to notify() — this window already exists and redraws
89:         * every frame (window_text_write shares win->buffer with the
90:         * gradient this loop draws), and a popup on every click/keypress
91:         * would be far more disruptive than the corruption it replaces;
92:         * the visible colour/position changes below already confirm the
93:         * event reached the app. */
94:        if (event.button.button == SDL_BUTTON_LEFT) {
95:          border_r = 0; border_g = 255; border_b = 0;
96:        } else if (event.button.button == SDL_BUTTON_RIGHT) {
97:          border_r = 255; border_g = 0; border_b = 0;
98:        }
99:      }
100:      if (event.type == SDL_KEYDOWN) {
101:        SDL_Scancode sc = event.key.keysym.scancode;
102:        if (sc == SDL_SCANCODE_ESCAPE)
103:          running = 0;
104:        if (sc == SDL_SCANCODE_LEFT)
105:          sq_x -= 8;
106:        if (sc == SDL_SCANCODE_RIGHT)
107:          sq_x += 8;
108:        if (sc == SDL_SCANCODE_UP)
109:          sq_y -= 8;
110:        if (sc == SDL_SCANCODE_DOWN)
111:          sq_y += 8;
112:        if (sq_x < 0) sq_x = 0;
113:        if (sq_x > win_w - 20) sq_x = win_w - 20;
114:        if (sq_y < 0) sq_y = 0;
115:        if (sq_y > win_h - 20) sq_y = win_h - 20;
116:      }
117:    }
118:
119:    /* STATIC gradient (any apparent motion of it is a presentation bug) +
120:     * three pure-channel squares for colour verification; the white bar is
121:     * the only element meant to move.  Everything scales with win_w/win_h. */
122:    Uint32 *pixels = (Uint32 *)surface->pixels;
123:    int pitch_px = surface->pitch / 4;
124:    for (int y = 0; y < win_h; y++) {
125:      Uint8 g = (Uint8)((y * 255) / win_h);
126:      for (int x = 0; x < win_w; x++) {
127:        Uint8 r = (Uint8)((x * 255) / win_w);
128:        pixels[y * pitch_px + x] = 0xFF000000u | ((Uint32)r << 16) |
129:                                   ((Uint32)g << 8) | (Uint32)(255 - r);
130:      }
131:    }
132:    /* Channel check: pure red, green, blue squares (left to right). */
133:    SDL_Rect red = {12, 12, 32, 32}, green = {52, 12, 32, 32},
134:             blue = {92, 12, 32, 32};
135:    SDL_FillRect(surface, &red, SDL_MapRGB(surface->format, 255, 0, 0));
136:    SDL_FillRect(surface, &green, SDL_MapRGB(surface->format, 0, 255, 0));
137:    SDL_FillRect(surface, &blue, SDL_MapRGB(surface->format, 0, 0, 255));
138:
139:    int bar_x = (frame * 3) % win_w;
140:    SDL_Rect bar = {bar_x, win_h - 24, 8, 24};
141:    SDL_FillRect(surface, &bar, SDL_MapRGB(surface->format, 255, 255, 255));
142:
143:    /* Input visualization: arrow-key square, click-coloured border and the
144:     * mouse-motion crosshair. */
145:    SDL_Rect square = {sq_x, sq_y, 20, 20};
146:    SDL_FillRect(surface, &square, SDL_MapRGB(surface->format, 255, 0, 255));
147:    Uint32 border_color =
148:        SDL_MapRGB(surface->format, border_r, border_g, border_b);
149:    SDL_Rect btop = {0, 0, win_w, 3}, bbot = {0, win_h - 3, win_w, 3};
150:    SDL_Rect blft = {0, 0, 3, win_h}, brgt = {win_w - 3, 0, 3, win_h};
151:    SDL_FillRect(surface, &btop, border_color);
152:    SDL_FillRect(surface, &bbot, border_color);
153:    SDL_FillRect(surface, &blft, border_color);
154:    SDL_FillRect(surface, &brgt, border_color);
155:    Uint32 black = SDL_MapRGB(surface->format, 0, 0, 0);
156:    SDL_Rect ch_h = {cur_x - 6, cur_y, 13, 1}, ch_v = {cur_x, cur_y - 6, 1, 13};
157:    SDL_FillRect(surface, &ch_h, black);
158:    SDL_FillRect(surface, &ch_v, black);
159:
160:    if (SDL_UpdateWindowSurface(window) != 0) {
161:      /* A concurrent resize invalidates the surface between the poll and the
162:       * present: re-acquire it and continue (nxlauncher-style recovery)
163:       * instead of quitting. */
164:      surface = SDL_GetWindowSurface(window);
165:      if (!surface) {
166:        OS1_notify_error("SDLTest", SDL_GetError());
167:        running = 0;
168:      } else {
169:        win_w = surface->w;
170:        win_h = surface->h;
171:      }
172:    }
173:
174:    frame++;
175:    /* Milestone confirmations (first frame presented, 120-frame mark) go
176:     * through the notification popup — same window/buffer reasoning as
177:     * above — instead of the per-frame-loop printf() this file used to
178:     * have; unlike the removed click/key logging these fire once each, so
179:     * a popup is not disruptive. */
180:    if (frame == 1) {
181:      char msg[64];
182:      snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "first frame presented via driver '%s'",
183:               SDL_GetCurrentVideoDriver());
184:      OS1_notify_post("SDLTest", msg);
185:    }
186:    if (frame == 120) {
187:      char msg[64];
188:      snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "120 frames in %u ms",
189:               (unsigned)SDL_GetTicks64());
190:      OS1_notify_post("SDLTest", msg);
191:    }
192:
193:    SDL_Delay(16); /* ~60 FPS through the NexsOS SDL timer backend */
194:  }
195:
196:  SDL_DestroyWindow(window);
197:  SDL_Quit();
198:  printf("[SDLTest] clean shutdown\n");
199:  exit(0);
200:  return 0;
201:}

@@@ user/bin/stress.c @@@
1:/*
2: * user/bin/stress.c
3: * Long-duration kernel stress driver (perf brief §6).
4: *
5: * Independently toggleable lanes, fixed-seed deterministic PRNG, and periodic
6: * on-stdout MEMSTAT samples (CSV) so a headless serial capture over a 2-hour
7: * run IS the time series the drift analysis (tools/analyze_drift.py) consumes.
8: * Stdout (serial) is used rather than a log FILE on purpose: it always works
9: * headless and avoids the console-contention Heisenbug (samples are emitted
10: * once per --interval, default 60 s, not per cycle).
11: *
12: * Lanes (each exercises the kernel paths the campaign touches):
13: *   spawn  — spawn a trivial child (/bin/hello) and wait it: process_create /
14: *            teardown, PMM, scheduler, ASID/PCID switch, object-handle
15: * teardown, the timer/sleep teardown path.  A --fault fraction spawns
16: * /bin/crash instead, exercising the ABNORMAL (fault-kill) teardown path. alloc
17: * — userland malloc/free across zipf-ish size classes: sbrk -> PMM. file   —
18: * open/write/read/close churn: VFS + ext4 + buffer cache. gui    —
19: * create_window/destroy_window churn: compositor window paths.
20: *
21: * Usage (run from the shell, headless serial captured to a file):
22: *   stress [--dur S] [--seed HEX] [--interval S] [--fault PCT]
23: *          [--spawn] [--alloc] [--file] [--gui] [--all]
24: *   Defaults: --all lanes, --dur 7200 (2 h), --seed 0xDEADBEEF, --interval 60,
25: *             --fault 7.  If any explicit lane flag is given, only those run.
26: */
27:#include <os1.h>
28:#include <stdlib.h> /* atoi, atoll, malloc, free */
29:#include <string.h> /* strcmp */
30:
31:/* parse_ull - decimal, or hex with a 0x/0X prefix (for --seed). */
32:static unsigned long long parse_ull(const char *s) {
33:  unsigned long long v = 0;
34:  if (s[0] == '0' && (s[1] == 'x' || s[1] == 'X')) {
35:    s += 2;
36:    for (; *s; s++) {
37:      char c = *s;
38:      unsigned d;
39:      if (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
40:        d = (unsigned)(c - '0');
41:      else if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f')
42:        d = (unsigned)(c - 'a' + 10);
43:      else if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F')
44:        d = (unsigned)(c - 'A' + 10);
45:      else
46:        break;
47:      v = (v << 4) | d;
48:    }
49:    return v;
50:  }
51:  for (; *s >= '0' && *s <= '9'; s++)
52:    v = v * 10 + (unsigned)(*s - '0');
53:  return v;
54:}
55:
56:/* ---- deterministic PRNG (xorshift64) ---- */
57:static unsigned long long rng_state;
58:static unsigned long long xrand(void) {
59:  unsigned long long x = rng_state;
60:  x ^= x << 13;
61:  x ^= x >> 7;
62:  x ^= x << 17;
63:  rng_state = x;
64:  return x;
65:}
66:
67:/* lane bitmask */
68:#define LANE_SPAWN 1u
69:#define LANE_ALLOC 2u
70:#define LANE_FILE 4u
71:#define LANE_GUI 8u
72:
73:static int str_eq(const char *a, const char *b) { return strcmp(a, b) == 0; }
74:
75:int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
76:  unsigned long long dur_s = 7200; /* 2 hours */
77:  unsigned long long seed = 0xDEADBEEFULL;
78:  unsigned long long interval_s = 60;
79:  int fault_pct = 7;
80:  unsigned int lanes = 0; /* 0 => default-all after parse */
81:
82:  for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
83:    if (str_eq(argv[i], "--dur") && i + 1 < argc)
84:      dur_s = parse_ull(argv[++i]);
85:    else if (str_eq(argv[i], "--seed") && i + 1 < argc)
86:      seed = parse_ull(argv[++i]);
87:    else if (str_eq(argv[i], "--interval") && i + 1 < argc)
88:      interval_s = parse_ull(argv[++i]);
89:    else if (str_eq(argv[i], "--fault") && i + 1 < argc)
90:      fault_pct = atoi(argv[++i]);
91:    else if (str_eq(argv[i], "--spawn"))
92:      lanes |= LANE_SPAWN;
93:    else if (str_eq(argv[i], "--alloc"))
94:      lanes |= LANE_ALLOC;
95:    else if (str_eq(argv[i], "--file"))
96:      lanes |= LANE_FILE;
97:    else if (str_eq(argv[i], "--gui"))
98:      lanes |= LANE_GUI;
99:    else if (str_eq(argv[i], "--all"))
100:      lanes |= (LANE_SPAWN | LANE_ALLOC | LANE_FILE | LANE_GUI);
101:  }
102:  if (lanes == 0)
103:    lanes = (LANE_SPAWN | LANE_ALLOC | LANE_FILE | LANE_GUI);
104:  rng_state = seed ? seed : 1;
105:
106:  unsigned long long start = os1_mono_ns();
107:  unsigned long long dur_ns = dur_s * 1000000000ULL;
108:  unsigned long long interval_ns = interval_s * 1000000000ULL;
109:  unsigned long long next_stat = 0; /* emit one immediately */
110:  unsigned long long cycles = 0, spawns = 0, faults = 0, allocs = 0, files = 0,
111:                     guis = 0, errs = 0;
112:
113:  printf("[stress] start seed=0x%lx dur=%lus interval=%lus fault=%d%% "
114:         "lanes=0x%x\n",
115:         (unsigned long)seed, (unsigned long)dur_s, (unsigned long)interval_s,
116:         fault_pct, lanes);
117:  /* Stats CSV is emitted by /sys/bin/nxmemstat --log (a ROOT NX service): the
118:   * OS1_sys_stats syscall is ROOT-gated, and stress runs as an unprivileged
119:   * /bin USER process, so it only DRIVES load here.  run-stress.sh starts
120:   * nxmemstat
121:   * --log alongside; this loop just prints a periodic liveness heartbeat. */
122:
123:  for (;;) {
124:    unsigned long long now = os1_mono_ns();
125:    unsigned long long elapsed = now - start;
126:    if (elapsed >= dur_ns)
127:      break;
128:
129:    /* periodic liveness heartbeat (load counts only; no privileged stats) */
130:    if (elapsed >= next_stat) {
131:      printf("[stress] t=%lus cycles=%lu spawns=%lu faults=%lu allocs=%lu "
132:             "files=%lu guis=%lu errs=%lu\n",
133:             (unsigned long)(elapsed / 1000000000ULL), (unsigned long)cycles,
134:             (unsigned long)spawns, (unsigned long)faults,
135:             (unsigned long)allocs, (unsigned long)files, (unsigned long)guis,
136:             (unsigned long)errs);
137:      next_stat = elapsed + interval_ns;
138:    }
139:
140:    /* --- spawn lane (primary): spawn a trivial child and reap it --- */
141:    if (lanes & LANE_SPAWN) {
142:      int do_fault = (fault_pct > 0) && ((int)(xrand() % 100) < fault_pct);
143:      const char *path = do_fault ? "/bin/crash" : "/bin/captest";
144:      int pid = spawn(path);
145:      if (pid > 0) {
146:        wait(pid);
147:        spawns++;
148:        if (do_fault)
149:          faults++;
150:      } else
151:        errs++;
152:    }
153:
154:    /* --- alloc lane: malloc/free across size classes (sbrk -> PMM) --- */
155:    if (lanes & LANE_ALLOC) {
156:      void *ptrs[16];
157:      int n = (int)(xrand() % 16) + 1;
158:      for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
159:        /* zipf-ish: mostly small, occasionally large */
160:        unsigned long sz = (xrand() % 10 == 0)
161:                               ? (1u << (12 + (xrand() % 4))) /* 4K..32K */
162:                               : (16u << (xrand() % 6));      /* 16..512 */
163:        ptrs[k] = malloc(sz);
164:        if (ptrs[k]) {
165:          *(volatile char *)ptrs[k] = 1;
166:        } /* touch first byte */
167:      }
168:      for (int k = 0; k < n; k++)
169:        if (ptrs[k])
170:          free(ptrs[k]);
171:      allocs++;
172:    }
173:
174:    /* --- file lane: write/read churn (VFS + ext4 + buffer cache) --- */
175:    if (lanes & LANE_FILE) {
176:      static const char *scratch = "/etc/stress.tmp";
177:      char buf[256];
178:      for (int k = 0; k < (int)sizeof(buf); k++)
179:        buf[k] = (char)(xrand() & 0xff);
180:      int off = (int)(xrand() % 8192);
181:      int w = file_write(scratch, buf, (int)sizeof(buf), off);
182:      if (w == (int)sizeof(buf)) {
183:        char rb[256];
184:        file_read(scratch, rb, (int)sizeof(rb), off);
185:        files++;
186:      } else {
187:        /* scratch not writable on this fs layout: fall back to read churn of an
188:         * existing file so the lane still exercises VFS/ext4/buffer cache. */
189:        char rb[128];
190:        if (file_read("/etc/init.cfg", rb, (int)sizeof(rb), 0) > 0)
191:          files++;
192:        else
193:          errs++;
194:      }
195:    }
196:
197:    /* --- gui lane: create + destroy a window (compositor paths) --- */
198:    if (lanes & LANE_GUI) {
199:      int w = 100 + (int)(xrand() % 300);
200:      int h = 80 + (int)(xrand() % 200);
201:      int win = create_window(50, 50, w, h, "stress");
202:      if (win > 0) {
203:        destroy_window(win);
204:        guis++;
205:      }
206:      /* a failed create (e.g. window cap) is expected under load: not an error
207:       */
208:    }
209:
210:    cycles++;
211:  }
212:
213:  unsigned long long total_s = (os1_mono_ns() - start) / 1000000000ULL;
214:  printf("[stress] DONE cycles=%lu spawns=%lu faults=%lu allocs=%lu files=%lu "
215:         "guis=%lu errs=%lu in %lus\n",
216:         (unsigned long)cycles, (unsigned long)spawns, (unsigned long)faults,
217:         (unsigned long)allocs, (unsigned long)files, (unsigned long)guis,
218:         (unsigned long)errs, (unsigned long)total_s);
219:  return 0;
220:}
221:

@@@ user/sys/bin/nxfilem/draw.c @@@
1:/*
2: * user/sys/bin/nxfilem/draw.c
3: * Framebuffer ownership + low-level pixel/text primitives.
4: *
5: * Same technique as nxsettings.c/nxui.c: an owned ARGB buffer blitted once
6: * per frame, glyphs drawn with font_lib directly onto that buffer (no
7: * printf_win — this window is not a terminal), a single corner-quarter-
8: * circle mask test shared by every rounded shape.
9: */
10:#include "nxfilem.h"
11:
12:uint32_t *fm_fb;
13:int fm_fb_w, fm_fb_h;
14:int fm_win_id = -1;
15:struct font_ctx *fm_font;
16:
17:void fm_gfx_init(int win_id, int ww, int wh) {
18:  fm_win_id = win_id;
19:  fm_fb_w = ww;
20:  fm_fb_h = wh;
21:  fm_fb = (uint32_t *)malloc((size_t)ww * (size_t)wh * 4u);
22:  fm_font = font_load("/fonts/Rewir-Light.off");
23:}
24:
25:void fm_gfx_realloc(int ww, int wh) {
26:  uint32_t *nb = (uint32_t *)malloc((size_t)ww * (size_t)wh * 4u);
27:  if (!nb)
28:    return;
29:  free(fm_fb);
30:  fm_fb = nb;
31:  fm_fb_w = ww;
32:  fm_fb_h = wh;
33:}
34:
35:void fm_fill_rect(int x, int y, int w, int h, uint32_t color) {
36:  if (!fm_fb)
37:    return;
38:  if (x < 0) {
39:    w += x;
40:    x = 0;
41:  }
42:  if (y < 0) {
43:    h += y;
44:    y = 0;
45:  }
46:  if (x + w > fm_fb_w)
47:    w = fm_fb_w - x;
48:  if (y + h > fm_fb_h)
49:    h = fm_fb_h - y;
50:  if (w <= 0 || h <= 0)
51:    return;
52:  for (int j = 0; j < h; j++) {
53:    uint32_t *row = fm_fb + (y + j) * fm_fb_w + x;
54:    for (int i = 0; i < w; i++)
55:      row[i] = color;
56:  }
57:}
58:
59:/* fm_rrect - filled rounded rectangle (corners clipped to a quarter-circle
60: * of radius r). Identical technique to nxsettings.c's fb_rrect. */
61:void fm_rrect(int x, int y, int w, int h, int r, uint32_t color) {
62:  if (!fm_fb || w <= 0 || h <= 0)
63:    return;
64:  if (r < 0)
65:    r = 0;
66:  if (r > w / 2)
67:    r = w / 2;
68:  if (r > h / 2)
69:    r = h / 2;
70:  for (int j = 0; j < h; j++) {
71:    for (int i = 0; i < w; i++) {
72:      int ccx = -1, ccy = 0;
73:      if (i < r && j < r) {
74:        ccx = r;
75:        ccy = r;
76:      } else if (i >= w - r && j < r) {
77:        ccx = w - r - 1;
78:        ccy = r;
79:      } else if (i < r && j >= h - r) {
80:        ccx = r;
81:        ccy = h - r - 1;
82:      } else if (i >= w - r && j >= h - r) {
83:        ccx = w - r - 1;
84:        ccy = h - r - 1;
85:      }
86:      if (ccx >= 0) {
87:        int dx = i - ccx, dy = j - ccy;
88:        if (dx * dx + dy * dy > r * r)
89:          continue;
90:      }
91:      int px = x + i, py = y + j;
92:      if (px >= 0 && px < fm_fb_w && py >= 0 && py < fm_fb_h)
93:        fm_fb[py * fm_fb_w + px] = color;
94:    }
95:  }
96:}
97:
98:static void fm_draw_glyph(int x, int y, uint32_t codepoint, uint32_t color) {
99:  if (!fm_font)
100:    return;
101:  int idx = (int)codepoint - fm_font->header.first_char;
102:  if (idx < 0 || idx >= fm_font->header.num_chars)
103:    return;
104:  struct font_glyph_info *gi = &fm_font->glyphs[idx];
105:  uint8_t *bitmap = fm_font->bitmap + gi->data_offset;
106:  int start_x = x + gi->x0;
107:  int start_y = y + fm_font->header.ascent + gi->y0;
108:  for (int gy = 0; gy < gi->height; gy++) {
109:    for (int gx = 0; gx < gi->width; gx++) {
110:      uint8_t alpha = bitmap[gy * gi->width + gx];
111:      if (alpha > 64) {
112:        int px = start_x + gx, py = start_y + gy;
113:        if (px >= 0 && px < fm_fb_w && py >= 0 && py < fm_fb_h)
114:          fm_fb[py * fm_fb_w + px] = color;
115:      }
116:    }
117:  }
118:}
119:
120:int fm_text_width(const char *s) {
121:  if (!fm_font || !s)
122:    return 0;
123:  return font_string_width(fm_font, s);
124:}
125:
126:void fm_draw_text(int x, int y, const char *s, uint32_t color) {
127:  if (!fm_font || !s)
128:    return;
129:  uint32_t cp;
130:  int consumed, cursor = x;
131:  size_t rem = strlen(s);
132:  const char *p = s;
133:  while (*p) {
134:    consumed = utf8_decode(p, rem, &cp);
135:    if (consumed <= 0) {
136:      p++;
137:      rem--;
138:      continue;
139:    }
140:    fm_draw_glyph(cursor, y, cp, color);
141:    int idx = (int)cp - fm_font->header.first_char;
142:    if (idx >= 0 && idx < fm_font->header.num_chars)
143:      cursor += fm_font->glyphs[idx].advance;
144:    p += consumed;
145:    rem -= consumed;
146:  }
147:}
148:
149:/* fm_draw_icon - a cached per-filetype/folder icon (nxicon.h) when one is
150: * available for the current theme, else a flat rounded-square fallback in
151: * 'fallback_color' (same degrade-gracefully contract nxui.c's dock tiles
152: * use for app icons). */
153:void fm_draw_icon(int x, int y, int size, int icon_id, int light,
154:                  uint32_t fallback_color) {
155:  os1_image_t *icon = nxicon_get(icon_id, light, size);
156:  if (!icon) {
157:    fm_rrect(x, y, size, size, 3, fallback_color);
158:    return;
159:  }
160:  for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
161:    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
162:      uint32_t src = icon->pixels[j * size + i];
163:      uint8_t alpha = (src >> 24) & 0xFF;
164:      if (alpha == 0)
165:        continue;
166:      int px = x + i, py = y + j;
167:      if (px < 0 || px >= fm_fb_w || py < 0 || py >= fm_fb_h)
168:        continue;
169:      if (alpha == 255) {
170:        fm_fb[py * fm_fb_w + px] = src;
171:        continue;
172:      }
173:      uint32_t dst = fm_fb[py * fm_fb_w + px];
174:      uint32_t dr = (dst >> 16) & 0xFF, dg = (dst >> 8) & 0xFF, db = dst & 0xFF;
175:      uint32_t sr = (src >> 16) & 0xFF, sg = (src >> 8) & 0xFF, sb = src & 0xFF;
176:      uint32_t out_r = (sr * alpha + dr * (255 - alpha)) / 255;
177:      uint32_t out_g = (sg * alpha + dg * (255 - alpha)) / 255;
178:      uint32_t out_b = (sb * alpha + db * (255 - alpha)) / 255;
179:      fm_fb[py * fm_fb_w + px] =
180:          0xFF000000u | (out_r << 16) | (out_g << 8) | out_b;
181:    }
182:  }
183:}
184:
185:void fm_blit(void) {
186:  if (fm_win_id < 0 || !fm_fb)
187:    return;
188:  window_blit(fm_win_id, 0, 0, fm_fb_w, fm_fb_h, fm_fb);
189:  /* SCHED-STACK-ISO: init pumps the compositor via flush(); blit marks
190:   * damage — no nested compositor_render() here. */
191:}

@@@ user/sys/bin/nxfilem/events.c @@@
1:/*
2: * user/sys/bin/nxfilem/events.c
3: * Keyboard handling (mouse clicks go through fm_ui_handle_click, ui.c).
4: */
5:#include "nxfilem.h"
6:
7:/* fm_handle_keyboard_rename - text-entry mode while renaming the highlighted
8: * row: printable ASCII appends, Backspace deletes, Enter commits, Esc
9: * cancels. No other key does anything while this mode is active. */
10:static void fm_handle_keyboard_rename(unsigned char key, uint16_t sc) {
11:  if (sc == INPUT_KEY_ESC || key == 27) {
12:    fm_ui_cancel_rename();
13:    return;
14:  }
15:  if (sc == INPUT_KEY_ENTER || key == '\r' || key == '\n') {
16:    fm_ui_commit_rename();
17:    return;
18:  }
19:  if (sc == INPUT_KEY_BACKSPACE || key == '\b' || key == 127) {
20:    if (fm_state.rename.len > 0)
21:      fm_state.rename.buf[--fm_state.rename.len] = '\0';
22:    return;
23:  }
24:  if (key >= 32 && key < 127 &&
25:      fm_state.rename.len < (int)sizeof(fm_state.rename.buf) - 1) {
26:    fm_state.rename.buf[fm_state.rename.len++] = (char)key;
27:    fm_state.rename.buf[fm_state.rename.len] = '\0';
28:  }
29:}
30:
31:void fm_handle_keyboard(input_event_t *event) {
32:  if (event->type != INPUT_TYPE_KEYBOARD || event->keyboard.state != KEY_PRESSED)
33:    return;
34:
35:  unsigned char key = event->keyboard.key;
36:  uint16_t sc = event->keyboard.scancode;
37:
38:  if (fm_state.rename.active) {
39:    fm_handle_keyboard_rename(key, sc);
40:    return;
41:  }
42:
43:  if (sc == INPUT_KEY_UP || key == 'w') {
44:    if (fm_state.highlighted_item > 0) {
45:      fm_state.highlighted_item--;
46:      if (fm_state.highlighted_item < fm_state.scroll_offset)
47:        fm_state.scroll_offset = fm_state.highlighted_item;
48:    }
49:    return;
50:  }
51:  if (sc == INPUT_KEY_DOWN || key == 's') {
52:    if (fm_state.highlighted_item < fm_state.file_count - 1) {
53:      fm_state.highlighted_item++;
54:      int visible = fm_ui_visible_rows();
55:      if (visible < 1)
56:        visible = 1;
57:      if (fm_state.highlighted_item >= fm_state.scroll_offset + visible)
58:        fm_state.scroll_offset = fm_state.highlighted_item - visible + 1;
59:    }
60:    return;
61:  }
62:
63:  if (key == ' ') {
64:    fm_state_toggle_select(fm_state.highlighted_item);
65:    return;
66:  }
67:
68:  if (key == 'u' || sc == INPUT_KEY_BACKSPACE)
69:    fm_navigate_up();
70:  else if (key == 'h')
71:    fm_navigate_home();
72:  else if (key == 'r' || key == 'R')
73:    fm_refresh_directory();
74:  else if (key == 'c' || key == 'C')
75:    fm_clipboard_copy();
76:  else if (key == 'x' || key == 'X')
77:    fm_clipboard_cut();
78:  else if (key == 'v' || key == 'V')
79:    fm_clipboard_paste();
80:  else if (key == 'd' || key == 'D') {
81:    if (fm_state.highlighted_item >= 0 &&
82:        fm_state.highlighted_item < fm_state.file_count) {
83:      fm_delete_file(fm_state.files[fm_state.highlighted_item].full_path);
84:      fm_refresh_directory();
85:    }
86:  } else if (key == 'n' || key == 'N') {
87:    fm_create_folder(NULL);
88:  } else if (key == 'e' || key == 'E') {
89:    fm_ui_begin_rename(fm_state.highlighted_item);
90:  } else if (key == 'a') {
91:    fm_state_select_all();
92:  } else if (key == 'A') {
93:    fm_state_deselect_all();
94:  } else if (key == '\r' || key == '\n' || key == 'o' || key == 'O' ||
95:             sc == INPUT_KEY_ENTER) {
96:    if (fm_state.highlighted_item >= 0 &&
97:        fm_state.highlighted_item < fm_state.file_count)
98:      fm_open_file(&fm_state.files[fm_state.highlighted_item]);
99:  } else if (key == '1') {
100:    fm_state_sort_files(FM_SORT_NAME);
101:  } else if (key == '2') {
102:    fm_state_sort_files(FM_SORT_SIZE);
103:  } else if (key == '3') {
104:    fm_state_sort_files(FM_SORT_DATE);
105:  } else if (key == '4') {
106:    fm_state_sort_files(FM_SORT_TYPE);
107:  } else if (sc == INPUT_KEY_ESC || key == 27) {
108:    fm_state.context_menu_active = 0;
109:    fm_state.menu_open = -1;
110:  } else if (key == 'q' || key == 'Q') {
111:    fm_state.running = 0;
112:  }
113:}

@@@ user/sys/bin/nxfilem/fileops.c @@@
1:/*
2: * user/sys/bin/nxfilem/fileops.c
3: * Directory navigation, file manipulation, clipboard, and file-open dispatch.
4: */
5:#include "nxfilem.h"
6:
7:/*
8: * fm_refresh_directory - repopulate fm_state.files[] with current_path's
9: * contents. Directory-ness comes from stat(S_ISDIR) (list_dir's own output
10: * carries no type). Hidden entries are filtered out here (not just at
11: * render time) when show_hidden is off, so scroll math/selection indices
12: * never have to account for entries the user cannot see.
13: */
14:void fm_refresh_directory(void) {
15:  static char buf[16384];
16:  int len = list_dir(fm_state.current_path, buf, sizeof(buf));
17:
18:  fm_state.file_count = 0;
19:  fm_state.selected_count = 0;
20:  fm_state.total_size = 0;
21:
22:  if (len >= 0) {
23:    char *token = buf;
24:    while (*token != '\0' && fm_state.file_count < FM_MAX_FILES) {
25:      char *next = token;
26:      while (*next != '\0' && *next != ' ' && *next != '\n' && *next != '\r' &&
27:             *next != '\t')
28:        next++;
29:
30:      if (next == token) {
31:        token++;
32:        continue;
33:      }
34:      *next = '\0';
35:      if (token[0] == '\0') {
36:        token = next + 1;
37:        continue;
38:      }
39:
40:      int is_hidden = (token[0] == '.');
41:      if (is_hidden && !fm_state.show_hidden) {
42:        token = next + 1;
43:        continue;
44:      }
45:
46:      fm_file_t *file = &fm_state.files[fm_state.file_count];
47:      strncpy(file->name, token, FM_NAME_MAX - 1);
48:      file->name[FM_NAME_MAX - 1] = '\0';
49:
50:      if (fm_state.current_path[0] == '/' && fm_state.current_path[1] == '\0')
51:        snprintf(file->full_path, FM_PATH_MAX, "/%s", file->name);
52:      else
53:        snprintf(file->full_path, FM_PATH_MAX, "%s/%s", fm_state.current_path,
54:                 file->name);
55:
56:      struct stat st;
57:      int is_dir = 0;
58:      DIR *d = opendir(file->full_path);
59:      if (d) {
60:        is_dir = 1;
61:        file->size = 0;
62:        file->mtime = 0;
63:        closedir(d);
64:      } else if (stat(file->full_path, &st) == 0) {
65:        is_dir = S_ISDIR(st.st_mode);
66:        file->size = (long)st.st_size;
67:        file->mtime = (long)st.st_mtime;
68:      } else {
69:        file->size = 0;
70:        file->mtime = 0;
71:      }
72:
73:      file->is_dir = is_dir;
74:      file->is_hidden = is_hidden;
75:      file->is_selected = 0;
76:      file->icon_id = nxicon_classify_file(file->name, is_dir);
77:
78:      if (!is_dir)
79:        fm_state.total_size += file->size;
80:
81:      fm_state.file_count++;
82:      token = next + 1;
83:    }
84:  }
85:
86:  switch (fm_state.sort_mode) {
87:  case FM_SORT_NAME:
88:    fm_qsort(fm_state.files, fm_state.file_count, fm_sort_by_name);
89:    break;
90:  case FM_SORT_SIZE:
91:    fm_qsort(fm_state.files, fm_state.file_count, fm_sort_by_size);
92:    break;
93:  case FM_SORT_DATE:
94:    fm_qsort(fm_state.files, fm_state.file_count, fm_sort_by_date);
95:    break;
96:  case FM_SORT_TYPE:
97:    fm_qsort(fm_state.files, fm_state.file_count, fm_sort_by_type);
98:    break;
99:  }
100:  if (fm_state.sort_reverse) {
101:    for (int i = 0; i < fm_state.file_count / 2; i++) {
102:      fm_file_t t = fm_state.files[i];
103:      fm_state.files[i] = fm_state.files[fm_state.file_count - 1 - i];
104:      fm_state.files[fm_state.file_count - 1 - i] = t;
105:    }
106:  }
107:
108:  fm_state.highlighted_item = fm_state.file_count > 0 ? 0 : -1;
109:  fm_state.scroll_offset = 0;
110:}

112:void fm_navigate_to(const char *path) {
113:  if (chdir(path) != 0) {
114:    fm_set_status_message("Cannot open directory");
115:    return;
116:  }
117:  if (getcwd(fm_state.current_path, FM_PATH_MAX) != 0) {
118:    strncpy(fm_state.current_path, path, FM_PATH_MAX - 1);
119:    fm_state.current_path[FM_PATH_MAX - 1] = '\0';
120:  }
121:  fm_state_add_to_history(fm_state.current_path);
122:  fm_refresh_directory();
123:}

127:    return;
128:  fm_state.history_pos--;
129:  if (chdir(fm_state.history[fm_state.history_pos]) != 0) {
130:    fm_state.history_pos++;
131:    return;
132:  }
133:  if (getcwd(fm_state.current_path, FM_PATH_MAX) != 0) {
134:    strncpy(fm_state.current_path, fm_state.history[fm_state.history_pos],
135:            FM_PATH_MAX - 1);
136:    fm_state.current_path[FM_PATH_MAX - 1] = '\0';
137:  }
138:  fm_refresh_directory();
139:}

143:    return;
144:  fm_state.history_pos++;
145:  if (chdir(fm_state.history[fm_state.history_pos]) != 0) {
146:    fm_state.history_pos--;
147:    return;
148:  }
149:  if (getcwd(fm_state.current_path, FM_PATH_MAX) != 0) {
150:    strncpy(fm_state.current_path, fm_state.history[fm_state.history_pos],
151:            FM_PATH_MAX - 1);
152:    fm_state.current_path[FM_PATH_MAX - 1] = '\0';
153:  }
154:  fm_refresh_directory();
155:}

159:void fm_navigate_up(void) {
160:  if (strcmp(fm_state.current_path, "/") == 0)
161:    return;
162:
163:  char parent[FM_PATH_MAX];
164:  strncpy(parent, fm_state.current_path, FM_PATH_MAX - 1);
165:  parent[FM_PATH_MAX - 1] = '\0';
166:
167:  char *slash = strrchr(parent, '/');
168:  if (slash == NULL || slash == parent)
169:    strncpy(parent, "/", FM_PATH_MAX - 1);
170:  else {
171:    *slash = '\0';
172:    if (parent[0] == '\0')
173:      strncpy(parent, "/", FM_PATH_MAX - 1);
174:  }

177:
178:/* ===== File operations (OS1 has no rename/mkdir syscall: copy+unlink is the
179: * only available primitive for a "move") ===== */
180:
181:/* Cap for a single in-memory copy: generous for anything nxfilem realistically
182: * moves (source, config, small assets) without risking a huge kmalloc/user
183: * malloc for a stray large file. Mirrors image.h's OS1_IMAGE_MAX_FILE_BYTES
184: * spirit (a deliberate, documented bound, not an arbitrary one). */
185:#define FM_COPY_MAX_BYTES (8 * 1024 * 1024)
186:
187:/*
188: * fm_copy_file - single read + single write, NOT a chunked read/write loop.
189: *
190: * file_read()/OS1_fs_read() opens a FILE capability handle per call
191: * (OS1low_handle_create -> OS1_object_read -> OS1low_handle_close, see
192: * lib.c) whenever size>0 and buf!=NULL — i.e. every call this function
193: * makes. A chunked loop (the original implementation, 512 B at a time)
194: * opened and closed one of those handles per chunk, which crashed the
195: * kernel on anything but a tiny file — the handle-churn path is new and
196: * not hardened for that call rate yet. nxshell's `mv`/`cp` avoid the loop
197: * entirely (one file_read + one OS1_fs_write); this does the same, sized to
198: * the file instead of nxshell's fixed 1024 B ceiling.
199: */
200:void fm_copy_file(const char *src, const char *dst) {
201:  if (!src || !dst || strcmp(src, dst) == 0)
202:    return;
203:
204:  int size = file_read(src, NULL, 0, 0); /* size probe, no handle opened */
205:  if (size < 0)
206:    return;
207:  if (size == 0) {
208:    OS1_fs_unlink(dst);
209:    file_write(dst, "", 0, 0); /* create/truncate an empty destination */
210:    return;
211:  }
212:  if (size > FM_COPY_MAX_BYTES)
213:    return;
214:
215:  uint8_t *buf = (uint8_t *)malloc((size_t)size);
216:  if (!buf)
217:    return;
218:
219:  int n = file_read(src, buf, size, 0);
220:  if (n <= 0) {
221:    free(buf);
222:    return;
223:  }
224:
225:  OS1_fs_unlink(dst); /* avoid trailing garbage if dst previously existed */
226:  file_write(dst, buf, n, 0);
227:  free(buf);
228:}
229:
230:void fm_move_file(const char *src, const char *dst) {
231:  if (!src || !dst || !src[0] || !dst[0])
232:    return;
233:
234:  if (strcmp(src, dst) == 0)
235:    return;
236:
237:  char src_copy[FM_PATH_MAX];
238:  char dst_copy[FM_PATH_MAX];
239:
240:  strncpy(src_copy, src, sizeof(src_copy) - 1);
241:  src_copy[sizeof(src_copy) - 1] = '\0';
242:
243:  strncpy(dst_copy, dst, sizeof(dst_copy) - 1);
244:  dst_copy[sizeof(dst_copy) - 1] = '\0';
245:
246:  fm_copy_file(src_copy, dst_copy);
247:
248:  /*
249:   * Cancella solo se la copia è realmente avvenuta.
250:   * Verifica minima: il file destinazione deve esistere.
251:   */
252:  struct stat st;
253:  if (stat(dst_copy, &st) == 0)
254:    fm_delete_file(src_copy);
255:}
256:
257:void fm_delete_file(const char *path) {
258:  if (path)
259:    OS1_fs_unlink(path);
260:}
261:
262:/* fm_create_folder - create a subdirectory in the current directory through
263: * mkdir()'s parent-directory capability composition, then refresh the view. */
264:void fm_create_folder(const char *name) {
265:  if (!name || !name[0]) {
266:    fm_set_status_message("New folder: empty name");
267:    return;
268:  }
269:
270:  char path[FM_PATH_MAX];
271:  if (fm_state.current_path[0] == '/' && fm_state.current_path[1] == '\0')
272:    snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "/%s", name);
273:  else
274:    snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s/%s", fm_state.current_path, name);
275:
276:  if (mkdir(path, 0755) != 0) {
277:    fm_set_status_message("New folder: failed");
278:    return;
279:  }
280:  fm_set_status_message("Folder created");
281:  fm_refresh_directory();
282:}
283:
284:void fm_rename_file(const char *old_path, const char *new_name) {
285:  if (!old_path || !new_name || !new_name[0])
286:    return;
287:
288:  char new_path[FM_PATH_MAX];
289:
290:  const char *slash = strrchr(old_path, '/');
291:
292:  if (slash == NULL) {
293:    snprintf(new_path, sizeof(new_path), "%s", new_name);
294:  } else if (slash == old_path) {
295:    /* file nella root: /old -> /new */
296:    snprintf(new_path, sizeof(new_path), "/%s", new_name);
297:  } else {
298:    int dir_len = (int)(slash - old_path);
299:
300:    snprintf(new_path, sizeof(new_path), "%.*s/%s", dir_len, old_path,
301:             new_name);
302:  }
303:
304:  new_path[sizeof(new_path) - 1] = '\0';
305:
306:  if (strcmp(old_path, new_path) == 0)
307:    return;
308:
309:  fm_copy_file(old_path, new_path);
310:
311:  struct stat st;
312:  if (stat(new_path, &st) == 0)
313:    fm_delete_file(old_path);
314:}

316:/* ===== Clipboard ===== */
317:
318:void fm_clipboard_copy(void) {
319:  if (fm_state.highlighted_item < 0 ||
320:      fm_state.highlighted_item >= fm_state.file_count)
321:    return;
322:  fm_file_t *file = &fm_state.files[fm_state.highlighted_item];
323:  strncpy(fm_state.clipboard.path, file->full_path, FM_PATH_MAX - 1);
324:  fm_state.clipboard.is_cut = 0;
325:  fm_state.clipboard.is_valid = 1;
326:  fm_set_status_message("Copied");
327:}
328:
329:void fm_clipboard_cut(void) {
330:  if (fm_state.highlighted_item < 0 ||
331:      fm_state.highlighted_item >= fm_state.file_count)
332:    return;
333:  fm_file_t *file = &fm_state.files[fm_state.highlighted_item];
334:  strncpy(fm_state.clipboard.path, file->full_path, FM_PATH_MAX - 1);
335:  fm_state.clipboard.is_cut = 1;
336:  fm_state.clipboard.is_valid = 1;
337:  fm_set_status_message("Cut");
338:}
339:
340:void fm_clipboard_paste(void) {
341:  if (!fm_state.clipboard.is_valid)
342:    return;
343:
344:  char src[FM_PATH_MAX];
345:
346:  strncpy(src, fm_state.clipboard.path, sizeof(src) - 1);
347:  src[sizeof(src) - 1] = '\0';
348:
349:  char *filename = strrchr(src, '/');
350:  filename = filename ? filename + 1 : src;
351:
352:  char dst[FM_PATH_MAX];
353:  snprintf(dst, FM_PATH_MAX, "%s/%s", fm_state.current_path, filename);
354:
355:  if (fm_state.clipboard.is_cut) {
356:    fm_move_file(src, dst);
357:    fm_state.clipboard.is_valid = 0;
358:  } else {
359:    fm_copy_file(src, dst);
360:  }
361:
362:  fm_set_status_message("Pasted");
363:  fm_refresh_directory();
364:}

366:/* ===== Viewer/child process tracking ===== */
367:
368:static void fm_prune_viewer_pids(void) {
369:  int w = 0;
370:  for (int i = 0; i < fm_state.viewer_pid_count; i++) {
371:    int pid = fm_state.viewer_pids[i];
372:    if (wait(pid) == -1)
373:      fm_state.viewer_pids[w++] = pid;
374:  }
375:  fm_state.viewer_pid_count = w;
376:}
377:
378:static void fm_register_viewer_pid(int pid) {
379:  fm_prune_viewer_pids();
380:  if (fm_state.viewer_pid_count >= FM_VIEWER_PID_MAX) {
381:    kill_process(fm_state.viewer_pids[0]);
382:    wait(fm_state.viewer_pids[0]);
383:    for (int i = 1; i < fm_state.viewer_pid_count; i++)
384:      fm_state.viewer_pids[i - 1] = fm_state.viewer_pids[i];
385:    fm_state.viewer_pid_count--;
386:  }
387:  fm_state.viewer_pids[fm_state.viewer_pid_count++] = pid;
388:}
389:
390:/*
391: * Every program this app runs — the resolved nxassoc.h target, a direct
392: * executable, or kilo as a fallback — is launched via nxexec.h's
393: * nxexec_spawn_hosted_argv(), i.e. "/sys/bin/nxexec <prog> [path]", exactly
394: * like nxlauncher's tiles (nxexec_spawn_hosted()). nxfilem never spawns an
395: * app directly (nxexec_spawn_search/nxexec_spawn_detached): nxexec is the
396: * one place that decides whether the child needs a hosting terminal or gets
397: * to run standalone, and every launcher in this system goes through it.
398: */
399:
400:int fm_open_with_kilo(fm_file_t *file) {
401:  if (!file || file->is_dir)
402:    return -1;
403:
404:  char argv0[] = "kilo";
405:  char argv1[FM_PATH_MAX];
406:  char *argv[2];
407:
408:  strncpy(argv1, file->full_path, sizeof(argv1) - 1);
409:  argv1[sizeof(argv1) - 1] = '\0';
410:  argv[0] = argv0;
411:  argv[1] = argv1;
412:
413:  int pid = nxexec_spawn_hosted_argv(2, argv);
414:  if (pid <= 0) {
415:    fm_set_status_message("Failed to open with kilo");
416:    return pid;
417:  }
418:  fm_register_viewer_pid(pid);
419:  fm_set_status_message("Opened with kilo");
420:  return pid;
421:}
422:
423:/*
424: * fm_open_file - resolve the program for 'file' via the shared nxassoc.h
425: * table and launch it through nxexec (nxexec_spawn_hosted_argv), instead of
426: * a local if/else chain and instead of spawning it directly.
427: * Directories navigate instead of "opening".
428: */
429:int fm_open_file(fm_file_t *file) {
430:  if (!file)
431:    return -1;
432:  if (file->is_dir) {
433:    fm_navigate_to(file->full_path);
434:    return 0;
435:  }
436:
437:  char prog[NXASSOC_PROG_MAX];
438:  int kind = nxassoc_resolve(file->full_path, prog, sizeof(prog));
439:
440:  char argv1[FM_PATH_MAX];
441:  char *argv[2];
442:  int argc;
443:
444:  if (kind == NXASSOC_KIND_EXEC) {
445:    argv[0] = prog;
446:    argc = 1;
447:  } else {
448:    strncpy(argv1, file->full_path, sizeof(argv1) - 1);
449:    argv1[sizeof(argv1) - 1] = '\0';
450:    argv[0] = prog;
451:    argv[1] = argv1;
452:    argc = 2;
453:  }
454:
455:  int pid = nxexec_spawn_hosted_argv(argc, argv);
456:  if (pid <= 0) {
457:    fm_set_status_message("Failed to launch");
458:    return pid;
459:  }
460:  fm_register_viewer_pid(pid);
461:  fm_set_status_message("Opened");
462:  return pid;
463:}
464:

@@@ user/sys/bin/nxfilem/main.c @@@
1:/*
2: * user/sys/bin/nxfilem/main.c
3: * Entry point: window/state setup and the ~30Hz event loop.
4: *
5: * Same loop shape as nxsettings.c/nxui.c: redraw (internally gated by a
6: * state-signature so an unchanged frame never blits), drain every queued
7: * input event, sleep — never a busy-spin.
8: */
9:#include "nxfilem.h"
10:
11:static void fm_cleanup(void) {
12:  if (fm_state.window_id >= 0)
13:    destroy_window(fm_state.window_id);
14:}
15:
16:int main(void) {
17:  fm_state_init();
18:
19:  if (fm_ui_init() != 0) {
20:    printf("nxfilem: failed to create window\n");
21:    return 1;
22:  }
23:
24:  /* First listing before set_focus — the compositor has crashed in the past
25:   * on a focus request racing an unpopulated window (see fileops history). */
26:  fm_refresh_directory();
27:  set_focus(get_pid());
28:  fm_ui_redraw(1);
29:
30:  while (fm_state.running) {
31:    input_event_t ev;
32:    while (input_poll_event(&ev) == 1) {
33:      if (ev.type == INPUT_TYPE_KEYBOARD) {
34:        fm_handle_keyboard(&ev);
35:      } else if (ev.type == INPUT_TYPE_MOUSE) {
36:        if (ev.mouse.state == KEY_PRESSED)
37:          fm_ui_handle_click(ev.mouse.x, ev.mouse.y, ev.mouse.button);
38:      } else if (ev.type == INPUT_TYPE_RESIZE && ev.resize.w > 0 &&
39:                ev.resize.h > 0) {
40:        fm_ui_reinit_window(ev.resize.w, ev.resize.h);
41:      } else if (ev.type == INPUT_TYPE_LOOK_CHANGED) {
42:        fm_ui_load_theme(nxres_theme_is_light());
43:      }
44:    }
45:
46:    fm_ui_redraw(0);
47:    OS1_sleep(33);
48:  }
49:
50:  fm_cleanup();
51:  return 0;
52:}
